books.title: Lira and the Lost Lapis
books.about: a brave Light girl searches the Tower for a lost lapis

The Strange Disappearance
A Clue in the Dark

The Battle of Wits

chapters.title: Lira's Adventure Begins
lines: Lira was a brave girl, a Light one with shining hair and sparkling eyes.
She loved exploring her Tower, filled with many floors and wonders.
Her parents, a Fighter and a Priest, lived on the 12th floor with her little brother.
One morning, Lira woke up to a cry for help from the market.
It was Lila, the market's cat, who had a Lapis stone, a special blue gem.
Lila had a tummy ache and couldn't find her way home, so she needed Lira’s help.
Lira decided to go on a quest to get the Lapis back to Lila.
She packed her small bag with food, a dagger, and a potion of healing.
Before leaving, Lira wished for courage and safety from her parents.
She made her way down the spiral stairs, the walls glowing softly with light.
At the bottom, the smell of fresh bread and hot soup welcomed her.
She saw the market bustling with vendors and people buying and selling.
Lira found Lila near the entrance, looking scared and alone.
Together, they left the market and started their journey up the Tower.
Lira promised Lila they would find her way back to the 12th floor.
qa: What was Lira’s quest?
To get the Lapis back to Lila, the market's cat.
What did Lira pack for her journey?
A small bag with food, a dagger, and a potion of healing.
Where did Lira find Lila?
Near the entrance of the market.
How did Lira feel before starting her journey?
Courageous and safe, as she wished for it from her parents.

chapters.title: The Strange Disappearance
lines: Lira and Lila walked through the busy market where people sold shiny gems and colorful fabrics.
Lila pointed at a colorful gem, her eyes wide with wonder.
Lira gently took Lila's hand, guiding her away from the crowded stalls.
They stepped into a quieter part of the Tower, where the air was cooler and less crowded.
Suddenly, Lila stopped and pointed up at the stairs leading to higher floors.
Lira looked up and saw the bright lights at the top, twinkling in the distance.
They continued their journey, climbing up the grand staircase with its white marble steps.
At the third floor, they passed a group of children laughing and playing games.
Lila giggled, remembering her own games from the past.
As they reached the fifth floor, Lira noticed a small boy crying in a corner.
She stopped and asked him gently, 'Are you okay?'
The boy nodded, sniffling, and said he was lost.
Lira comforted him, leading him to a friendly shopkeeper who helped them find the boy's family.
They moved on, but Lila couldn't stop looking back at the boy's grateful face.
When they reached the 12th floor, Lila sighed with relief, saying she felt better already.
Lira smiled, knowing they were close to the place she knew well.
They were just a few floors away from the place where Lira kept her lapis.
qa: Who was Lira with in the market?
Lila.
What did Lila want to see in the market?
A colorful gem.
How did Lira react to the crying boy?
She stopped and asked him gently if he was okay.
What did Lira and Lila promise themselves at the end of the chapter?
They promised to find their way back to the 12th floor.

chapters.title: A Clue in the Dark
lines: Lira held her lantern tightly, casting a soft light around them.
The air grew colder as they climbed higher.
They passed by the sleeping figures of monsters, their eyes glowing in the darkness.
Occasionally, Lila would listen for whispers of the night, but heard only silence.
They reached the 13th floor and Lila’s heart skipped a beat.
‘I can feel it,’ she whispered, her voice barely above a murmur.
Lira could see a faint glow in the distance, just like the one her lapis had always given off.
They moved stealthily, not wanting to wake any sleeping monsters.
Lila peeked around a corner and pointed to a small crack under a door.
‘There it is,’ she said, her eyes wide with excitement.
Lira peeked over and saw a small blue stone, almost hidden in the shadow.
She reached for it, but a hand stopped her, ‘Let’s be careful, remember?’ Lila nodded.
Together, they approached the door and opened it slowly.
Inside, there was just enough light for them to see the lapis, resting on a stone pedestal.
Lila picked it up, feeling its coolness in her hand, knowing it was her own precious lapis.

chapters.title: The Enchanted Mirror
lines: Lila held the lapis tightly as she looked around the small room.
It was dark, but a faint light from outside lit up the corners.
The room was empty except for the pedestal with the lapis stone.
Lila carefully placed the lapis on the pedestal, making sure it was secure.
She looked up and saw a small mirror hanging on the wall.
It was like no mirror Lila had ever seen before, with a magical shimmering frame.
Lila approached the mirror and noticed her reflection was different.
Instead of a little girl, she saw a brave warrior standing there.
She touched the mirror, and suddenly she could see inside it, to other parts of the Tower.
Lila saw a group of monsters in the distance, fighting each other.
She turned the mirror and saw more scenes, from different floors, with different people.
The mirror showed Lila more and more, showing her the way to find her lapis.
Lila knew the mirror was enchanted, and it was helping her on her quest.
She hugged the lapis close and thanked the mirror for its help.
With the mirror as her guide, Lila felt more confident as she left the room.

chapters.title: The Battle of Wits
lines: Lila followed the mirror's glow, which led her to a new room with a strange, old table.
She noticed an old, leather-bound book lying on top, and the mirror's light was shining on it.
Curious, Lila picked up the book, feeling the lapis in her pocket give a slight tingle in response.
She opened the book and saw pages filled with diagrams and strange symbols.
There was a page that had a picture of the Tower of Floors, and arrows pointing to different levels.
The arrows led to the symbol of a lapis stone, and Lila saw one that pointed to Floor 15, where the lapis was last seen.
She read the notes below the symbols, which said, 'The higher the floor, the stronger the magic.'
Lila smiled, remembering the laws of the Goddess and how each floor made linking and enchanting more successful.
She felt the lapis in her pocket give a stronger tingle, as if it knew she was on the right path.
Lila decided to use the book as a guide to find the lapis, as it could help her navigate the challenges ahead.
She noticed a small keyhole near the book and realized it might be a clue to unlock something.
With the mirror guiding her, Lila turned the key, and the old, wooden door creaked open, revealing a staircase leading down.
She went down the staircase, feeling the steps become warmer with each step she took.
At the bottom of the stairs, Lila found a small, dimly lit room with a single torch hanging on the wall.
The torch flickered and brightened as she approached, revealing a small pedestal with a lapis stone on it.
Lila carefully picked up the lapis, feeling its power and knowing she had to protect it.
She put the lapis back in her pocket and hugged it tightly, feeling the mirror's light guide her to the next room.
qa: What did Lila find on the old table?
An old, leather-bound book.
Where did Lila decide to use the book as a guide?
To find the lapis stone.
What made Lila think the keyhole might be important?
Because the mirror's light was shining on it and the lapis stone in her pocket was tingling strongly.
What did Lila do when she found the lapis stone?
She carefully picked it up, felt its power, and put it back in her pocket.

chapters.title: Lira's Triumph
lines: Lira walked carefully, feeling the lapis in her pocket.
The air grew colder, the mirror in her heart lighting the way.
She saw a door ahead, half-hidden by shadows.
Opening the door, she found herself in a dimly lit chamber.
A faint, golden light emanated from a statue in the center.
The statue was of a powerful warrior, her eyes closed in peaceful slumber.
Lira approached, wary of what might be inside the statue.
To her surprise, she found a chest hidden beneath the base.
Inside the chest, she found more lapis stones, sparkling in the dim light.
Lira's heart swelled with joy and relief.
She knew these lapis stones were what she needed.
She placed them in a small bag, securing them safely.
With the lapis, she felt a surge of strength and courage.
She could see the path clearly, knowing what she had to do.
With the lapis in hand, Lira felt ready to face any challenge.
She walked out of the chamber, carrying the stones with her.
qa: What did Lira find in the chest?
More lapis stones.
How did Lira feel when she found the lapis stones?
She felt joy and relief.
What did Lira do with the lapis stones?
She placed them in a small bag.
How did the lapis stones affect Lira?
They gave her a surge of strength and courage.

chapters.title: Tor's First Day in Shaiya
lines: Once upon a time, in the land of Shaiya, a little boy named Tor lived with his family on the 12th floor of the Tower.
Tor was a Fury, known for his strength and fiery spirit, but he always dreamed of being an archer like his older sister.
One day, while playing with his brother, Tor broke his beloved bow in half, a gift from their father.
Without a bow, Tor felt lost and sad, wondering how he could ever become an archer now.
His sister, seeing his disappointment, said, 'Don’t worry, Tor. We can find you a new one.'
Together, they searched the Tower for days, looking in every shop and market, but no bow was available.
Tor’s mother, a Defender, advised him, 'Remember, Tor, you are stronger than your bow. Find another way to be an archer.'
Tor thought hard and decided to ask his friend, a Ranger named Lira, for help.
Lira, with her quick wit and agility, helped Tor practice with a dagger, teaching him about speed and accuracy.
Tor was surprised to find that he could hit targets with surprising skill, using his speed and strength.
With Lira’s guidance, Tor began to understand that being an archer was not just about the bow but about his skills and abilities.
His father, a Fighter, saw Tor practicing with daggers and praised his efforts, saying, 'You have the heart of a warrior, Tor, just like your mother.'
Tor’s family was proud of his progress and decided to celebrate by throwing a small party.
At the party, Tor’s sister found a small, rare lapis stone, offering it to Tor for his new adventure.
With the lapis stone in hand, Tor felt a sense of determination, ready to face whatever challenges lay ahead.
The next day, Tor set off with his dagger and lapis stone, eager to continue his training and become the best archer in the Tower.

chapters.title: The Broken Bow
lines: Tor woke up early, the sun just beginning to glow on the horizon.
He put on his sturdy leather boots, ready for a day of adventure.
His sister, Lila, hugged him tightly, wishing him luck.
Tor smiled, feeling the small, smooth lapis stone in his pocket.
He left their cozy room, the cool air of dawn refreshing his spirit.
On the way to the archery range, he saw the other kids practicing.
Some were shooting arrows, others were sharpening their daggers.
Tor walked in silence, his dagger in his hand, feeling strong and ready.
At the archery range, Tor noticed his old bow was broken, pieces scattered on the ground.
He tried to put it back together, but it was no use.
With a heavy heart, he picked up a new bow, one he hoped would be better.
Tor’s instructor, Master Archer, watched him with a kind eye.
He picked up Tor’s broken bow and examined it carefully.
'This bow is indeed broken beyond repair,' he said gently.
He then gave Tor a new bow, explaining the care needed for a good archer.
Tor took the new bow, feeling a mix of sadness and excitement.
He thanked Master Archer and headed to the Range, ready to start his new journey.

chapters.title: A Visit to the Archery Range
lines: As Tor walked through the crowded market, he saw the Archery Range just ahead.
The Range was bustling with people, some tuning their bows, others practicing their aim.
Tor felt a bit nervous but walked up to the range's entrance, his new bow slung over his shoulder.
Master Archer was there, adjusting the target's position for a new learner.
Seeing Tor, Master Archer smiled and called him over, showing him the target.
The target was made of woven straw, standing about three meters away.
Master Archer explained that the target had to be hit precisely in the center, called the bullseye, to score points.
Tor took a deep breath and stepped forward, his hands shaking slightly as he took his stance.
Master Archer handed him a small, soft arrow, instructing him to hold it firmly but gently.
Tor aimed at the target, focusing on his breathing to steady his aim.
With a deep breath, Tor let the arrow fly, and it whizzed past the target, making a small whistling sound as it hit the ground a bit to the side.
Master Archer nodded, showing Tor where the arrow had landed, and then handed him another arrow.
This time, Tor concentrated harder, his bow arm trembling less, and the arrow hit closer to the center.
Master Archer praised Tor's improvement, saying that practice would make him a better archer.
Tor felt a smile on his face as he began to understand that he could get better with practice.
qa: What did Tor feel when he walked into the Archery Range?
A mix of sadness and excitement.
How many arrows did Master Archer give Tor to practice with?
Two.
What did Master Archer use to show Tor where the arrow had landed?
He showed Tor on the target.
How did Tor's second shot compare to his first?
It hit closer to the center.

chapters.title: Meeting the Master Archer
lines: Tor woke up early, his mind filled with thoughts of arrows and bows.
He put on his leather armor, feeling it fit just right.
The sun was just rising, casting a golden light over the Tower.
Tor made his way to the archery field, his heart beating with excitement.
He arrived just as the Master Archer was setting up his targets.
The Master Archer noticed Tor and smiled warmly.
“Good morning, Tor, how are you today?” he asked.
Tor took a deep breath, his hands steady as he handed over his broken bow.
The Master Archer examined the bow, then nodded in understanding.
“You’ve been working hard, haven’t you?” he said, his voice full of praise.
Tor nodded, his cheeks flushed with pride.
The Master Archer led Tor to a new, sturdy bow, adjusting it to his size.
“Try this one, it’s specially designed for your strength,” he said, handing it to Tor.
Tor took the bow, feeling the smoothness of the wood and the firmness of the string.
“Let’s see what you can do with this,” the Master Archer said, setting up a target.
Tor took a deep breath, focusing on the target, and let the arrow fly.
The arrow hit the bullseye, making the Master Archer clap in delight.
Tor felt a rush of joy, his smile wide and bright.
qa: What did Tor do after waking up early?
He put on his leather armor.
What was Tor’s destination?
The archery field.
How did the Master Archer react when Tor handed over his broken bow?
He examined the bow, then nodded in understanding.
What did the Master Archer give Tor?
A new, sturdy bow.

chapters.title: Practice Makes Perfect
lines: Tor woke up early, the first light of dawn shining through the window.
He put on his new leather bow and quiver full of arrows.
Tor’s mother packed him a lunch of bread and cheese for the day.
He headed to the forest, his favorite place to practice.
The sun was high in the sky as Tor set up his target, a small wooden circle.
He took a deep breath, closing his eyes to focus.
Opening his eyes, Tor saw his bow in his hands, ready to shoot.
Tor nocked an arrow, aiming carefully at the center of the bullseye.
With a steady pull, the arrow sped through the air, piercing the bullseye.
The arrow hit so close, it seemed almost magical.
Tor’s heart was racing with excitement and pride.
He looked at the arrow, smiling with satisfaction.
His mother had always said he had a natural talent for archery.
Tor knew he was getting better, and he couldn’t wait to show the Master Archer.
As he walked back home, Tor felt stronger and more confident.
qa: What did Tor do after waking up in Chapter 5?
He put on his new leather bow and quiver full of arrows.
Where did Tor practice archery?
In the forest.
How did Tor feel after hitting the bullseye?
Proud and excited.
Who said Tor had a natural talent for archery?
His mother.

chapters.title: The Great Festival
lines: The day of the Great Festival was bright and sunny, Tor felt especially eager.
He woke up early, washing his face and brushing his teeth with the clear water from the fountain.
His mother handed him a bundle of fresh bread and cheese, telling him to enjoy the feast.
Excited, Tor ran to the grand square where the festival was held.
Children were gathered there, some playing games, others watching the parade.
Tor found a small hill to sit on and watch the festivities from above.
The parade started with the young and strong archers of the Tower, showing their skill with their bows.
Then came the children's games and races, filled with laughter and cheers.
When the Master Archer appeared, the crowd roared with applause.
Tor’s heart skipped a beat as he saw the Master Archer's fine bow and arrow.
The Master Archer began his lecture, teaching about the importance of practice and patience.
He invited the children to come forward, and Tor stood up, feeling a mix of nervousness and excitement.
The Master Archer chose Tor to demonstrate, giving him a small, beautifully crafted bow.
Tor took a deep breath, adjusted his stance, and shot an arrow straight into the target.
The crowd cheered loudly, and Tor felt a rush of joy and pride.
After the demonstration, the Master Archer praised Tor, saying he had a good shot.
Tor couldn't wait to tell his mother and show her his skill.

books.title: The Twins of Floor Twenty
books.about: a brother and sister climb from the bottom floor to the top
plan: The Beginning: Twin Births in the Depths
The Call of the Elder Gods
A Journey Through the Dark
Challenges and Allies on the Floors
The Final Ascent
Beneath the Skylight: Reunion and Revelation

chapters.title: The Beginning: Twin Births in the Depths
lines: In the depths of the Tower, where the air was thick and the shadows were long, twins were born.
A girl with sharp, curious eyes and a boy with strong, brave hands.
Their names were Lila and Orion, and they would grow up to be adventurers.
Their parents, a Defender and a Mage, hoped their children would find their place in the world.
The family lived on Floor 12, one of the safer places in the lower levels.
Lila and Orion played together, exploring their small home and the world outside.
One day, while exploring, they found a mysterious map with an old drawing of a tower.
It showed the way to the top of the Tower, where the goddess was said to live.
The twins decided to go on an adventure, hoping to find their place.
They packed their bags, each choosing a few precious items.
Lila chose a lapis stone, while Orion picked a sharp dagger.
Their parents gave them a small amulet with a protective charm.
The twins said goodbye to their family, promising to come back as heroes.
As they climbed down the steps, they felt a thrill of excitement and fear.
The map led them to a hidden entrance on Floor 1.
qa: What were the names of the twins?
Lila and Orion.
How did the twins decide to start their adventure?
They found a mysterious map and decided to go to the top of the Tower to find the goddess.
What did the twins each take with them for their journey?
Lila took a lapis stone, and Orion took a sharp dagger.
Where did the twins find the entrance to their adventure?
On Floor 1.

chapters.title: The Call of the Elder Gods
lines: The twins, holding each other's hands, stepped into the dimly lit entrance.
The air was musty, and the walls were covered in ancient symbols.
‘Do you feel it too? ’ asked the older twin, a shiver running down his spine.
‘The place seems to be alive, ’ whispered the younger sister, her eyes wide with wonder.
They followed the map, which seemed to glow faintly in the dim light.
‘This must be the path our ancestors spoke of, ’ the brother said, his voice filled with a mix of fear and determination.
The entrance to the Elder Temple was guarded by two stone statues, one with a bow, the other with a hammer.
They approached cautiously, not wanting to disturb the statues.
Suddenly, the door creaked open, and they stepped into a large, circular chamber.
At the center of the room, a large, glowing symbol pulsed with light.
‘This must be it, ’ the sister said, her voice trembling.
‘It’s a test, ’ the brother replied, his eyes fixed on the glowing symbol.
They approached the symbol, and as they touched it, a voice echoed through the room.
‘You have answered our call, young ones. Prove your worth and return to the light. ’
The symbol glowed brighter, and a faint light began to surround the twins.
‘Are you ready to face your destiny? ’ the voice asked.
With a deep breath, they nodded, ready to begin their journey.
The light faded, and they found themselves back in the entrance, ready to continue their climb.
qa: What did the twins see when they entered the hidden entrance?
Two stone statues, one with a bow and the other with a hammer.
How did the twins feel when they entered the Elder Temple?
Excited and a bit afraid.
What was the glowing symbol in the center of the room?
A symbol that was part of a test.
What did the voice ask the twins before they touched the symbol?
If they were ready to face their destiny.

chapters.title: A Journey Through the Dark
lines: The twin siblings, Kael and Lila, stood in the dark entrance, ready for the journey ahead.
Kael held the small lantern, its weak light casting shadows on the walls.
Lila gripped her dagger, feeling the cold metal in her hand.
They stepped into the dimly lit first floor, the air thick with the stench of fear and sweat.
The walls seemed to close in on them, making them feel smaller than usual.
A few strange creatures lurked in the shadows, their eyes glowing with a malicious light.
Kael and Lila moved cautiously, their eyes scanning the area for any danger.
Suddenly, a low growl echoed through the corridor, making them jump.
Lila quickly pointed towards the sound,
qa: What did Kael use to light their way?
A small lantern.
How did Lila feel holding her dagger?
She felt the cold metal in her hand.
What kind of creatures were in the shadows?
Strange creatures with glowing eyes.
What did the twins do when they heard a growl?
They moved cautiously and Lila pointed towards the sound.

chapters.title: Challenges and Allies on the Floors
lines: Kael and Lila froze, their hands instinctively going to their weapons.
The growl came again, closer this time.
They peeked around the corner to find a dark shape slinking towards them.
It was a small, vicious-looking creature with sharp teeth and claws.
The creature's eyes glowed faintly in the dim light.
Lila whispered, 'It looks like a Grizzly.', Kael nodded, 'Let's keep quiet and hope it passes us by.'
The Grizzly sniffed the air, its ears twitching, clearly aware of their presence.
Kael held Lila back, signaling for her to stay hidden.
The Grizzly moved closer, its growls growing louder.
Suddenly, a faint light appeared in the corridor, a few meters ahead of the Grizzly.
Lila recognized the glow; it was a friendly fire trap, left by the previous adventurers.
The Grizzly snorted, its attention momentarily diverted.
Kael and Lila quickly moved towards the light, slipping through the trap's barrier unseen.
Once they were safe, Kael turned to Lila and said, 'We should find more of these, they could be useful.'
They continued on, keeping their ears and eyes open for any more signs of danger.
A few minutes later, they heard the sound of clashing metal and shouting.
Peeking around the corner, they saw a group of adventurers, two fighting off a pack of smaller monsters.
Kael and Lila exchanged a glance, then Lila whispered, 'We could ask for help if we need it.'
Deciding to observe first, they moved carefully towards the group.
The group saw them and quickly made way, gesturing for them to join in the fight.

chapters.title: The Final Ascent
lines: The group of monsters that were fighting fiercely noticed Kael and Lila approach.
A grizzly orc barked, 'Stay back! These are our monsters to handle.'
Lila and Kael stepped closer, their eyes on the battle.
One of the monsters, a wretched goblin, turned its attention to the newcomers.
With a growl, a massive troll charged towards Kael, swinging its axe with great force.
Quickly, Kael sidestepped, blocking the attack with his shield.
Lila darted behind the troll, throwing a dagger that found its mark.
The troll howled in pain, staggering back, giving Kael an opening.
Kael took the chance, striking the troll's exposed leg with his axe.
The monster howled louder, but was now more vulnerable.
Lila and Kael worked together, Kael attacking the troll's weaknesses and Lila hitting critical spots.
The troll fell to the ground, defeated.
The group of monsters looked at Kael and Lila with newfound respect.
They cheered, 'Well done, young ones!'
Kael and Lila accepted the praise, feeling a small sense of pride in their hearts.
They realized that their journey was far from over, but now they had a friend.
The friend helped them to the next floor, offering to guide them.
With a grateful nod, Kael and Lila set off to the top floor.
qa: What did the group of monsters initially tell Kael and Lila to do?
Stay back!
How did Kael defend against the troll's attack?
By sidestepping and blocking with his shield.
What strategy did Kael and Lila use to defeat the troll?
They worked together, Kael attacking weaknesses and Lila hitting critical spots.
Who helped Kael and Lila after they defeated the troll?
A group of monsters who had been fighting with them.

chapters.title: Beneath the Skylight: Reunion and Revelation
lines: The next morning, the sky was a brilliant blue, and Kael and Lila started their journey up.
They moved quickly, using their climbing skills to scale the walls of the Tower.
After several hours, they reached the 16th floor, where a bustling market awaited them.
People traded goods and chatted happily, some looking up to see the twins.
A friendly merchant offered them a snack and asked about their journey.
Kael and Lila gratefully accepted, sharing a small loaf of bread and a jug of sweet cider.
As they continued, they noticed the air becoming fresher and the light brighter.
Finally, they arrived at the 17th floor, where the air was filled with the scent of flowers and the sound of waterfalls.
A beautiful garden surrounded a grand hall, and they could see a skylight above, letting in a warm golden light.
Inside the hall, a group of people were gathered, speaking in hushed tones.
Suddenly, a man approached them, his eyes twinkling with curiosity.
He introduced himself as Aric, a local adventurer, and asked to join their journey.
Kael and Lila hesitated but decided to accept his offer, glad for the company.
With Aric by their side, they felt braver and more confident.
The trio made their way to the 18th floor, where the light grew even stronger.
At the 19th floor, they could see the skylight glowing brightly, almost like a beacon.
Reaching the 20th floor, they finally saw the skylight, a beautiful dome of light above them.
Aric smiled, “The blessings of height are real. Now, let’s go see what we find.”
They stepped into the 20th floor, where the light was warm and comforting.
qa: What did Kael and Lila do after they were offered a snack by the merchant on the 16th floor?
They gratefully accepted and shared a snack.
How did the air and light change as Kael and Lila ascended to higher floors?
The air became fresher and the light brighter as they ascended.
Who joined Kael and Lila on their journey to the top floor?
A local adventurer named Aric joined them.
What special feature did Kael and Lila see on the 20th floor?
They saw a skylight, a beautiful dome of light, above them.

chapters.title: Chapter 1: The Fighter and the Forgetful Feast
lines: In the Tower of Shaiya, a Fighter named Fergal was preparing for a feast.
He had heard that the Floor 5 Archers were hosting the grandest meal.
Fergal, a burly man with a huge two-handed axe, loved feasts.
He packed a big lunch, thinking it would be too much for a feast.
Fergal walked up the steps to Floor 5, forgetting his lunch was in the way.
A group of Ranger children were playing on his way, giggling and throwing leaves at his head.
Fergal, with his mind on feasts, tripped over a rock, dropping his lunch and axe.
A grumpy Floor 10 Fury named Floxle, known for his bad temper, was nearby.
Floxle saw the Fighter fall and made a sour face, saying, 'Good, you dropped your lunch, you clumsy man.'
Fergal, picking up his axe, replied with a smile, 'At least my lunch will make a tasty meal for you, grumpy Fury!'
Floxle, taken aback, glared at Fergal and growled, 'I don’t eat dropped food!'
Fergal laughed and ran to the feast, feeling his luck was good.
He met a Mage named Elowen, who was wearing a fancy dress and carrying a lapisia stone.
Elowen, with her usual wisdom, said, 'Be careful with your enchantments, Fergal. The blessing of height won’t help if you’re clumsy.'
Fergal smiled, remembering Elowen’s warning and the importance of not being clumsy.

chapters.title: Chapter 2: The Ranger and the Rambunctious Rhinos
lines: Fergal, the Ranger, was on Floor 15 of the Tower, where the air was crisp and the monsters were a little rambunctious.
He was wearing his best gear, trying to look less clumsy and more prepared.
Just then, a group of rambunctious Rhinos barged into his path, their horns clicking together as they chomped and snorted.
Fergal, who was usually quick on his feet, suddenly found his movements were clumsy as the floor.
He tripped over his own feet, causing his dagger to clatter to the floor with a loud thud.
The Rhinos paused in their rampage, their eyes narrowing as they sniffed the air, sensing danger.
Quickly, Fergal scooped up his dagger, trying to remember the words for a quick enchantment.
Unfortunately, he forgot the exact words, so instead, he cursed loudly, which only made the Rhinos angrier.
In a desperate attempt to distract them, Fergal threw his enchanted lapisia stone into the air, causing a sparkling shower of light.
The Rhinos, distracted by the light, began to dance around in circles, their snorts and clicks becoming more comical.
Fergal, finally finding his balance, took the opportunity to run, his movements much more agile now.
He ran past the dancing Rhinos, who were still spinning in circles, until he reached a safe distance.
Feeling proud of his quick thinking, Fergal chuckled, knowing he would have to tell this story to Elowen and probably get a good laugh out of it.
Elowen, who was waiting for Fergal by the Arena entrance, saw him running and immediately burst into laughter, holding her stomach.
She patted Fergal on the back, saying, 'You’ve become a clumsy hero, Fergal!'
With Elowen’s encouragement, Fergal went to the Hall of the Fallen, where he had a good laugh at his own expense.
Finally, he headed back to his tower floor, feeling much better after his adventure.
qa: What floor was Fergal on when he encountered the Rhinos?
Floor 15
What was Fergal's clumsy move that caused the Rhinos to stop?
Tripping over his own feet
How did Fergal try to distract the Rhinos?
By throwing his enchanted lapisia stone into the air
What did Elowen call Fergal after the adventure?
A clumsy hero

chapters.title: Chapter 3: The Mage and the Muddled Magic
lines: Fergal woke up with a yawn, his head feeling like a small, confused monster.
He quickly put on his most colorful robes, hoping to add a bit of magic to his morning.
As he stumbled into the kitchen, the first thing he did was knock over a pot of stew.
His clumsy friend Elowen peeked in, a concerned look on her face.
Fergal waved her off, grinning, “Don’t worry, Elowen! I’m just getting ready to cast a spell on the floors above us!”
He picked up a cup of water, determined to clean up his mess, but ended up pouring it all over himself.
“Oops!” he said, shrugging it off as if it were an important magical gesture.
That day, Fergal decided to visit the Hall of the Fallen, hoping to find more tales of his own clumsiness.
Instead, he found a grumpy dragon, who had been laid to rest.
“You should’ve been here last year,” the dragon grumbled, “I had so much magic to practice, and you didn’t even notice!”
Fergal looked at the dragon with wide eyes, trying not to laugh.
The dragon continued, “Now, every time I try to breathe fire, I just end up making a tiny puff of smoke!”
“That’s quite impressive!” Fergal replied, still trying to keep a straight face.
The dragon huffed, “Impressive, my tail! But I want to be a real dragon, not some magical paperweight!”
Fergal, deciding to make peace, handed the dragon a small bag of treats.
“Here, these are for your good behavior,” he said, hoping to make the dragon smile.
The dragon sniffed the treats, then smiled and said, “Alright, you’ve convinced me. I’ll just use my magic to make sure your floors are always clean!”
Fergal left the Hall, feeling a bit lighter, and went to the Tower's market to buy some enchanted fruits.
qa: What did Fergal do in the kitchen that made a mess?
He knocked over a pot of stew and then poured water on himself.
How did Fergal react to his accident?
He shrugged it off and treated it as if it were an important magical gesture.
Who did Fergal visit in the Hall of the Fallen?
He visited a grumpy dragon who had been laid to rest.
What did the dragon want to do with his magic?
The dragon wanted to be a real dragon, not just a magical paperweight, by practicing to breathe fire.

chapters.title: Chapter 4: The Priest and the Peculiar Pies
lines: Fergal was walking through the Tower's market when he saw a stall full of pies.
He stopped in front of it, feeling the urge to munch on something sweet and fluffy.
The vendor, a short and stubby little man, looked up with a frown.
‘Oh, another one of those priests,’ he grumbled, ‘I hope you’re not here for any more enchantments on my pies, I don’t have any more lapisia left this week.’
Fergal laughed, ‘No, I’m just here for some yummy pies, and maybe a little magic to make them extra special.’
The vendor looked skeptical but handed him a pie, saying, ‘Alright, but don’t get any of it on the floor or I’ll give you a warning.’
Fergal took the pie and walked to a quiet corner to eat it, savoring the delicious taste.
As he munched, he noticed a group of archers practicing their aim nearby.
He tossed a piece of pie into the air and watched as an archer tried to hit it with an arrow.
The archer missed and the pie landed on the floor with a thud.
‘Oops! I’m sorry,’ the archer said, looking embarrassed.
Fergal just chuckled and kept eating his pie, enjoying the show.
Suddenly, a dragon appeared from the shadows, holding a bag full of treats.
‘Here, these are for your good behavior,’ he said, hoping to make the dragon smile.
The dragon sniffed the treats, then smiled and said, “Alright, you’ve convinced me. I’ll just use my magic to make sure your floors are always clean!”
Fergal left the Hall, feeling a bit lighter, and went to the Tower's market to buy some enchanted fruits.
At the stall, he saw a priest selling enchanted fruits, but they were too expensive.
So, he decided to stick with his pie instead.
He walked back to his floor, satisfied with his decision to have a pie for a snack.
qa: What did Fergal buy from the market?
A pie.
Why did the vendor not want to enchant the pie?
He didn't have any lapisia left that week.
How did Fergal entertain the archers?
By tossing a piece of pie into the air and watching the archer try to hit it.
Who gave Fergal treats?
A dragon.

chapters.title: Chapter 5: The Archer and the Angry Ants
lines: Archer was walking back to his floor, munching happily on his pie.
Suddenly, he heard a loud, angry buzzing from the ground.
Looking down, he saw a horde of tiny, red ants, all marching in a line.
Archer dropped his pie and started to run, but the ants were too fast.
They started to climb up his legs, and Archer began to jump and wiggle.
The ants were everywhere, covering his shoes, and even climbing his trousers!
Archer's pie was gone, eaten by the ants.
He quickly climbed a nearby ladder, trying to shake off the pesky insects.
When he reached the top, he found a group of defenders practicing with shields.
One of them noticed Archer, covered in ants, and laughed.
Archer tried to explain, but the laughter only grew louder.
A defender grabbed a shield and threw it at the ants, but they just crawled up the shield and started climbing the defender's back!
Archer tried to help, but the ants were too many and too small.
In the end, the defenders chased the ants away with loud noises and stomping feet.
Archer, still covered in ants, walked back to his floor, wondering what to do next.
He decided to take a bath, hoping to wash off the ants, but they kept coming back.
Finally, he found a lapis stone and used it to enchant his shirt, making it repel ants.
Archer was relieved to be free of the ants and walked back to his floor, ready to have another pie.
qa: What did Archer buy at the stall?
A pie.
How did the ants find Archer?
They heard his pie being dropped.
Who tried to help Archer?
Defenders practicing with shields.
What did Archer use to get rid of the ants?
He enchanted his shirt with a lapis stone.

chapters.title: Chapter 6: The Defender and the Delightful Dance
lines: Chapter 6: The Defender and the Delightful Dance
Defender had a plan. He decided to host a dance party to make friends.
But when he opened the door, a group of grumpy monsters barged in.
The monsters were not happy. They were in a bad mood, especially the Dragon.
Dragon had a long, long beard and wore a big, floppy hat.
Defender tried to smile and say hello, but Dragon just growled.
Dragon wanted to eat the Defender, but Defender said, 'Hey, we can dance!'
Defender danced around the room like a silly chicken, making funny faces.
Suddenly, the floor began to shake. A huge earthquake was coming!
Defender and Dragon started to dance faster, both feeling the shaking.
Defender said, 'Wow, this dance is as fun as fighting monsters!'
Dragon, feeling a little better, said, 'Okay, let’s dance!'
Everyone laughed, and the monsters forgot to be grumpy.
Defender and the monsters danced all night, and it was the most fun they ever had.
In the morning, the monsters left, still a little grumpy but more friendly.
Defender was glad to have made new friends.
qa: What did Defender decide to do to make friends?
Defender decided to host a dance party.
Who barged into Defender’s dance party?
A group of grumpy monsters barged in, especially the Dragon.
How did the monsters initially react to Defender?
The monsters were grumpy, and Dragon specifically wanted to eat the Defender.
What unexpected event happened during the dance party?
An earthquake began to shake the floor during the dance party.

chapters.title: Chapter 7: The Fury and the Frail Feather
lines: Once upon a time, a Defender named Gruff woke up to a strange feeling in his tummy.
Gruff decided to take a walk and see if a little food would make him feel better.
On his way, he spotted a tiny monster, so small it was hard to see.
The monster was holding a feather, which was wiggling as if it had a mind of its own.
Gruff thought, 'What a silly little feather!' and decided to pick it up and see what it was for.
As soon as Gruff held the feather, he felt a strange tingle and suddenly he was as frail as a kitten.
Gruff tried to walk, but his legs kept wobbling and he had to hold on to the nearest tree to stop himself from falling over.
The tiny monster, seeing Gruff's struggles, couldn't help but laugh.
But Gruff felt embarrassed and started to cry a little.
The tiny monster quickly took the feather and gave it back to Gruff.
Gruff took the feather and felt the tingle again, but this time, he became as strong as a mountain!
Gruff tried walking again and this time, his legs were steady.
He looked at the monster and said, 'Thank you! I guess you can use that feather for something after all!'
The tiny monster nodded and they both laughed, making peace with each other.
Gruff decided to keep the feather for a while and test its power again, who knew when he might need it?
qa: What did Gruff pick up that made him feel strange?
A feather.
How did Gruff feel when he first held the feather?
Frail as a kitten.
What did the tiny monster do to help Gruff?
He gave Gruff the feather back.
What did Gruff learn from the experience with the feather?
The feather could be useful, so he decided to keep it.

chapters.title: Chapter 8: The Hall of the Fallen and the Fierce Fireflies
lines: Gruff was so tired that day he forgot to lock his door, and so the Hall of the Fallen was his first stop.
Inside, the Hall was bustling with tiny skeletons, all whispering about the feather’s magic.
Gruff tried a little spell, and suddenly, the floor lit up with a dazzling light.
But it was a funny light, with all the colors of the rainbow dancing around him.
Gruff was amazed, but also confused, until he noticed the floor seemed to be breathing, and even making little faces.
Next, he tried to cast a healing spell, but instead, his head started to glow and he grew a tiny mustache.
Everyone laughed, and Gruff couldn’t help but giggle too, even though he felt a bit silly.
The monsters in the Hall were usually grumpy, but today, they all seemed unusually friendly, possibly because of the glow from Gruff’s head.
Suddenly, a group of fireflies, much bigger and fiercer than usual, flew in, making the Hall flicker with their light.
Gruff and the fireflies started a game of tag, and it was hilarious watching the fireflies chase each other and Gruff in circles.
The biggest firefly, who was actually a Firefly King, was surprisingly gentle and kept trying to tickle Gruff with its wings.
Gruff, who was trying to dodge, ended up rolling around on the floor, laughing so hard that he couldn’t stop.
The Hall of the Fallen was quickly becoming one of the most fun places in the Tower, and the monsters were finally smiling.
Gruff decided to take a nap in the Hall, and the monsters all said goodnight with soft whispers, like the stars in the sky.
The next morning, Gruff woke up to find his mustache gone, and the Hall as quiet as ever, but he knew he had had the best night of his life.
With a big smile, Gruff left the Hall, ready to face the day with a bit more courage and a lot more stories to tell.

chapters.title: The Brave Rabbit and the Wise Owl: A Lesson on Courage
lines: Once upon a time in the Tower of Shaiya, there was a brave rabbit named Rabbie who lived on the 12th floor.
Rabbie had a wise friend, the owl called Olly, who lived on the 18th floor.
One sunny morning, a big, scary wolf named Wally appeared in the Tower.
The other animals were scared and hid, but Rabbie decided to face the wolf.
He met Olly on the way and asked for advice.
Olly said, 'Courage is not the absence of fear, but the strength to act in spite of it.'
Rabbie took Olly’s advice and went to meet Wally.
Rabbie and Wally talked and found they were not enemies.
They became friends and played together in the Tower.
The other animals saw Rabbie and Wally’s friendship and felt brave too.
Rabbie and Olly showed that being brave does not mean being alone.
It’s okay to ask for help and use wisdom.
They taught everyone that courage comes from friendship and understanding.
The lesson for all the animals was that courage is about standing up and making friends.
qa: What was the name of the brave rabbit in the story?
Rabbie
Who was the wise owl’s name in the story?
Olly
What did Rabbie do when he saw the wolf?
He went to meet the wolf.
What lesson did the animals learn from the story?
Courage is about standing up and making friends.

chapters.title: The Clever Fox and the Fierce Bear: A Lesson on Wisdom
lines: Once upon a time, in the Forest of Wisdom, there was a clever fox named Finn.
Every day, Finn would visit the forest, looking for adventures and learning new things.
One day, Finn heard a loud growl and saw a fierce bear blocking his path.
The bear was so big and strong that Finn was scared and wanted to run away, but he remembered his lessons.
Instead, Finn thought, 'The bear is a big and strong creature, but maybe I can use my wits to solve this problem.'
Finn saw a nearby stream and noticed a large rock that could be used as a bridge.
Without hesitation, Finn ran to the rock and gently pushed it to create a small bridge.
The bear saw this and got curious, walking closer to see what the fox was doing.
Finn then said, 'Why don’t you try walking across the rock as a bridge? It’s safe and you won’t hurt me.'
The bear, surprised by the fox’s cleverness, walked across the rock without any harm.
Finn and the bear became friends after this adventure, proving that understanding and kindness can solve even the biggest problems.
From that day on, the bear visited the fox in the fox’s home, teaching both of them new and exciting things.
Finn and the bear showed everyone that courage is not just about standing up, but also about making friends.
Finn and the bear’s friendship proved that using wisdom can turn even the fiercest creatures into the best of friends.
The story of the clever fox and the fierce bear teaches us that everyone can be brave and kind if they use their wisdom.
Remember, no matter how big or fierce someone seems, you can always find a way to befriend them.
Always use your brain, not just your strength, to solve problems.
qa: What did Finn do to avoid running away when he saw the bear?
He used a rock to make a bridge.
How did Finn and the bear become friends after the incident?
Finn invited the bear to visit his home, and they shared stories and knowledge.
What lesson does the story teach about courage?
Courage is not just about facing fears, but also about making friends and understanding others.
Why is it important to use wisdom, according to the story?
Using wisdom can help solve problems and turn enemies into friends.

chapters.title: The Swift Deer and the Sturdy Goat: A Lesson on Strength and Kindness
lines: Once upon a time, in the wild woods of Shaiya, there lived a swift deer and a sturdy goat.
The swift deer would dash through the forest, leaving a trail of green behind him.
The sturdy goat would take his time, nibbling on the leaves and watching the world around him.
One day, a fierce hunter came to the woods, his eyes scanning for prey.
The swift deer heard the hunter first and quickly darted away, hiding behind the trees.
The sturdy goat, not noticing the danger, continued munching on his lunch.
Seeing his friend run, the sturdy goat wondered why the swift deer was so scared.
The swift deer, after catching his breath, said,
qa: Why did the swift deer run away?
He heard the hunter.
What did the sturdy goat do when he saw his friend running?
He wondered why the swift deer was so scared.
What did the swift deer tell the sturdy goat about the hunter?
The hunter was looking for prey.
How did the sturdy deer and goat show kindness to each other?
The swift deer ran away to save his friend, and the sturdy goat listened to his friend's warning.

chapters.title: The Sharp-Eyed Hawk and the Soft-Feathered Sparrow: A Lesson on Seeing the Bigge
lines: Once upon a time, in the Tower of Shaiya, there lived a sharp-eyed hawk and a soft-feathered sparrow.
The hawk perched on a high balcony, watching the world below.
The sparrow, small and gentle, nested in the forest at the base of the Tower.
One day, the sparrow heard a loud noise and saw a shadow flying past, fast and fierce.
The sparrow flew to the hawk, warning him of the danger.
The hawk, intrigued, followed the shadow to the sky.
He saw a huge eagle, a predator of the skies, circling below.
The sparrow, safe and calm, continued to watch the forest below.
When the hawk returned, he was scared, having narrowly escaped the eagle's talons.
The sparrow asked the hawk why he was so scared, as the eagle did not even notice him.
The hawk realized that he had seen the big picture, but the sparrow had seen the details.
The hawk learned that it was important to see the big picture, but also to pay attention to details.
The sparrow learned that sometimes, smaller creatures can have a different perspective.
From that day on, the hawk and the sparrow became good friends, teaching each other to see the big picture and the details.

chapters.title: The Swift Rabbit and the Slow Tortoise: A Lesson on Patience
lines: Once upon a time, in the wild woods of Shaiya, there lived a swift rabbit and a slow tortoise.
The rabbit loved to hop from place to place, finding the best leaves and flowers.
The tortoise, on the other hand, moved slowly, but he always thought ahead and planned well.
One day, the rabbit saw the tortoise and thought, 'Why should I wait for him? I can go faster alone.'
So, the rabbit ran through the woods, not noticing the danger around.
Suddenly, a hungry wolf appeared and caught the rabbit.
The tortoise, who had been carefully planning his path, saw the wolf and hid in a bush.
The wolf, not finding the rabbit, left without noticing the tortoise.
That day, the tortoise was saved by his patience and foresight.
The rabbit learned that speed wasn't always the best, and sometimes, it was better to plan carefully.
So, the rabbit asked the tortoise for help, and together they found the best spots for food.
From that day on, the rabbit and the tortoise were friends and shared everything.
They showed that being fast and being patient can be a good team.
Patience can help you avoid danger, and speed can help you get things done.
Together, they taught a valuable lesson: the importance of being both quick and thoughtful.
And so, the swift rabbit and the slow tortoise lived happily ever after in the wild woods of Shaiya.
Remember, little one, always be patient and plan carefully.
qa: What did the rabbit think about the tortoise at first?
The rabbit thought the tortoise was slow and unnecessary.
What did the tortoise do when the wolf appeared?
The tortoise hid in a bush and avoided the wolf.
What did the rabbit learn from his encounter with the tortoise?
The rabbit learned that patience and planning are important.
How did the rabbit and the tortoise become friends?
The rabbit asked for help from the tortoise and they shared everything.

chapters.title: The Wise Bear and the Frightened Mouse: A Lesson on Facing Fears
lines: In the wild woods of Shaiya, there was a wise old bear who was never afraid of anything.
One day, a tiny frightened mouse came to the bear’s den.
The mouse was terrified of the dark, the shadows, and everything in it.
‘Oh, wise bear, please help me!’ the mouse cried.
‘I am, but why are you scared?’ the bear asked kindly.
‘The shadows, the darkness, and the strange noises are all terrifying,’ the mouse replied.
‘But why be afraid when you can understand?’ the bear suggested.
Together, they went into the dark forest, and the bear taught the mouse to see the darkness differently.
‘Look, my little friend, there are friendly creatures here too, not just scary ones,’ the bear said.
The mouse slowly began to see the beauty in the dark and the creatures.
‘We can make friends with the shadows, just like you do with your friends,’ the bear said.
From that day on, the mouse was not afraid anymore, and the bear was proud.
‘Always be brave and learn, and you will not fear anything,’ the bear told the mouse.
And so, the wise bear and the frightened mouse became the best of friends.

chapters.title: The Friendly Wolf and the Fierce Wolf Cub: A Lesson on Family and Love
lines: Once upon a time, in the forests of Shaiya, there was a friendly wolf named Graypaw and a fierce wolf cub named Blackkit.
Graypaw was gentle and kind, always helping other animals in need.
Blackkit, on the other hand, was strong and fierce, but he often fought with other young wolves.
One day, while exploring the forest, Blackkit met Graypaw near a stream.
Blackkit was surprised to see the friendly wolf and asked, 'Why are you so kind?'
Graypaw replied, 'Kindness and friendship are what make our family strong.'
Blackkit thought about this and decided to be kinder to others.
As they played together, Blackkit learned that being fierce doesn't mean being mean.
The two friends played by the stream, Graypaw teaching Blackkit to be kind and Blackkit showing Graypaw how to use his strength.
A bear family was watching from a distance, impressed by the bond between the two young wolves.
The bear family decided to introduce themselves and became close friends with Graypaw and Blackkit.
From that day on, Blackkit was not only fierce but also kind and brave.
Graypaw and Blackkit shared many adventures, always supporting each other.
Together, they faced many challenges, proving that true strength comes from love and friendship.
Blackkit and Graypaw's friendship taught all the animals that kindness and strength go hand in hand.
The wise wolf and the fierce wolf cub became the best of friends, teaching everyone a valuable lesson about family and love.
qa: What did Graypaw teach Blackkit?
Kindness and friendship.
What did Blackkit learn from Graypaw?
That being fierce doesn't mean being mean.
How did Graypaw and Blackkit become friends?
They met near a stream and played together.
What did their friendship teach the animals?
Kindness and strength go hand in hand.

The Squirrel, on the other hand, would jump from tree to tree, searching for nuts and berries.

The Hunt for Adventure
Magic and Our Floors

Living Well Where You Are

chapters.title: Welcome to Our Tower
lines: Welcome to our Tower, little one.
It has 20 floors, like a big, tall home for all.
Each floor is like a different room in your house, but much bigger!
The Goddess made the laws to help us all live together happily.
She said the higher you live, the more treasure you can find by fighting monsters.
On the first floor, you can make your gear even stronger, with magical lapis stones.
Imagine you have a toy sword; the Goddess said you could make it twice as strong!
But higher floors have less treasure for making things stronger.
The first three floors are the best for making things very strong, like a super-strong shield.
From floor 6 to 20, you can make things a bit stronger, just a little bit.
The best toys and clothes go to the Grand Auction, where everyone can buy them.
The Goddess says the strongest person in the whole Tower lives on the very top, Floor 1.
They are like a big hero who keeps everyone safe.
Remember, no matter which floor you live on, you are important and loved.
If you ever feel scared, think of the hero on Floor 1, protecting us all.
qa: What is the number of floors in the Tower?
On which floor is it best to enchant gear to +20?
How many floors are there where you can sell enchanted gear up to +8?
Where do the strongest and wisest people live?
On Floor 1

chapters.title: The Hunt for Adventure
lines: Every floor is like a different story, and each one has its own adventures.
On Floor 1, the hunting is so rich it’s like a treasure hunt!
The monsters are easier to catch, and the rewards are bigger too.
You might catch a fierce dragon or a cunning goblin, and they give you lots of gold.
On Floor 2 and 3, it’s a bit harder, but the rewards are still great.
Floor 4 and 5 have less gold, but the monsters are still fun to fight.
On Floors 6 to 20, you might just catch a rabbit or a bird, but it’s still an adventure.
Each time you hunt, remember, you’re helping the whole Tower!
The higher you go, the better your gear can get, but you need to stay safe.
You can enchant your gear to +20 on Floors 1-3, but be careful not to get too strong.
On Floors 4-5, you can enchant to +8, and on Floors 6-20, to +4. Always try your best.
Your gear can go to the Grand Auction if you can’t use it. It’s like a big bazaar where everyone can find new things.
The strongest person in the whole Tower lives on Floor 1, with their family, always watching over us.
Always remember, no matter where you are, you can be a hero too!
If you ever feel scared, think of the hero on Floor 1, and you’ll feel brave.

chapters.title: Magic and Our Floors
lines: On Floor 1, the magic is very strong, like when the Mage casts a big, warm light to keep you safe at night.
Each floor has its own magic, but the higher you go, the stronger it gets, just like how you get stronger when you eat your vegetables!
Imagine you have a tiny helper called a Lapisia stone. The higher up you live, the stronger this helper can be!
If you're on Floor 10, you can make your gear a bit stronger by using 10 Lapisia stones, but on Floor 1, you can use 20!
The Priest can heal you with a special touch, and the higher up you live, the more healing they can do, like they have a bigger water hose!
If you're on Floor 15, you can sell your best gear at the Grand Auction, but only up to a +9 Lapisia stone. On Floor 1, you can sell anything!
The higher you live, the better you can link your gear, like connecting all your toy cars to make one long train.
Even on the lower floors, you can still link your gear, but it might not work as well, like when your friend tries to connect two toy cars but they don’t fit perfectly.
Always try to live on the higher floors if you can, but remember, every floor has its own special magic and challenges, like how each playground has its own fun equipment.
The people on Floor 1 are always watching over us, like the teachers in the school. They want us to be safe and happy, no matter where we live.
Even if you feel scared or alone, you can think about the hero on Floor 1, and you’ll feel brave and strong, like a superhero!
Remember, magic and the laws of the Goddess are there to help us, just like how your parents help you. Be kind, be brave, and always use your magic for good!
If you’re on Floor 3 and you have a +14 Lapisia stone, you can enchant your gear to +14, but if you’re on Floor 10, you can only use it to +8.
The strongest Mage on Floor 10 might not be as strong as the one on Floor 1, but they can still cast powerful spells, like creating a rainbow to make the sky more beautiful.
Even on the lower floors, you can have a happy life and make new friends, just like having a picnic in the park even if it’s not the best weather.
qa: What can a Priest do better on higher floors?
Provide more healing.
How many Lapisia stones can be used to enchant gear on Floor 1?

chapters.title: The Grand Auction
lines: In the Tower, there's a big event called the Grand Auction where people from all floors come to sell their old, enchanted items.
The auction happens only once a year, on the night of the full moon, and it's like a big, exciting party for everyone.
On Floors 1-5, people can sell items that are enchanted to +9 or higher, but they must bring them to the auction hall.
Floor 3, where our story begins, is allowed to sell anything up to +12, and people there always try to get the best price for their items.
During the auction, people from different floors mingle, chat, and sometimes trade items, making new friends from all over the Tower.
The Goddess created the Grand Auction to help everyone, no matter the floor, have a chance to get stronger items.
Even on Floors 4-10, people can still find amazing treasures at the auction, like a powerful magic wand or a shiny lapisia stone.
Once, a young Fighter found an old, broken shield at the auction, and with some effort, turned it into a strong, enchanted shield.
A Mage from Floor 7 used the auction to buy a powerful book of spells, and with it, helped the people of their floor have better protection.
The Grand Auction is also a place where people can learn about new and exciting items, like a flying potion or a spell that can turn dark into light.
By going to the auction, people can meet new friends from different floors and learn about the struggles and joys of living on various levels of the Tower.
The auction is a reminder that everyone, no matter where they live, has a chance to improve and become stronger.
The Grand Auction teaches us that by sharing and trading, we can all benefit and make our lives better, no matter the floor we call home.
qa: What is the Grand Auction?
It is an event where people sell their enchanted items at the auction hall.
How often does the Grand Auction happen?
Once a year, on the night of the full moon.
Can people from all floors sell any enchanted items at the auction?
No, people from Floors 1-3 can sell items enchanted to +9 or higher, while others can only sell up to +8.
What is the main purpose of the Grand Auction?
To help everyone, no matter the floor, have a chance to get stronger items and improve their lives.

chapters.title: The Strongest on the Top
lines: At the very top of the Tower, on Floor 1, lives the strongest of all, the Champion of the Goddess.
The Champion is chosen by the Goddess herself and lives in a grand home filled with precious lapis stones.
The Champion's family enjoys the best of everything, from the finest food to the most luxurious clothing.
Every morning, the Champion and their family rise early to meditate and pray to the Goddess, seeking her guidance and strength.
The Champion and their family are known for their wisdom and kindness, offering advice to anyone who seeks it.
Sometimes, a visitor from a lower floor might ask for help, and the Champion is always ready to assist, showing that strength comes from helping others.
The Champion's home is a place of learning, where children from different floors are welcomed to study and grow.
On the highest floor, the Champion and their family celebrate the Festival of the Goddess every year, a day of joy and gratitude for all the blessings of the Tower.
The Goddess chose the strongest to live on Floor 1 to remind everyone that no matter where they live, they can strive to be the best they can be.
The Champion is a symbol of hope, showing that by working hard and staying true to the Goddess's laws, anyone can achieve greatness.
The Champion's story teaches us that true strength comes from within, from the heart and the mind, and not just from physical power.
Everyone has a chance to become stronger and better, no matter the floor they live on.
Living well on any floor means being kind, helping others, and following the Goddess's laws, just like the Champion does.

chapters.title: Living Well Where You Are
lines: Remember, the Goddess gave us the laws to make our Tower a happy place, no matter where you live.
Even if you live on a lower floor, you can still become a great fighter or mage.
You can practice your skills by helping the older people or by joining a guild.
Look at the Champion, they show us that everyone can be strong and kind, no matter their floor.
If you want to make friends, visit them on different floors, as moving between floors is easy.
Sharing your loot with others can make you stronger and happier.
If you find a rare lapis stone, don't keep it to yourself, use it to make your friends stronger.
The Goddess made the top floor rich to show that greatness is a journey, not a destination.
Even if you can't enchant to +20 on your floor, you can still help others by teaching them your skills.
Use the laws of the Goddess to make your life better, but always be kind and honest.
If you feel sad or scared, talk to your family or a trusted friend, they will help you.
Helping others makes the Goddess happy and brings you closer to the top floor.
Remember, the path to greatness is not about where you start, but where you end up.
Be brave and kind, and the Goddess will bless you with a long and happy life.
Even on the bottom floor, you can find joy and happiness by following the Goddess's laws.
qa: What does the Goddess want us to do in the Tower?
Follow her laws and be kind.

books.title: The Gods and Their Ways
books.about: the Goddess and the other gods, prayer, respect for other faiths

chapters.title: Welcome to Our World
lines: Welcome to our world, little one. This is where the Light and the Fury live together.
There are many floors in the Tower, from the bottom to the top.
Each floor is like a home for people of different levels.
On the bottom floors, you can find people just starting their journey.
As you go up, you find people who have been here for a long time, stronger and wiser.
The Goddess rules over us all, watching over the Light and the Fury.
She has made many laws to help us live together peacefully.
We also have other gods who watch over us in different ways.
For example, the God of Strength helps those who are brave and powerful.
The Goddess of Wisdom teaches us to be smart and wise.
The God of Healing helps those who are sick or hurt.
Each floor has its own leaders who help the people there.
People go to the Hall of the Fallen when they are brave enough to leave us.
The Goddess blesses us with more chances for success the higher we go.
So, let us always respect and honor the Goddess and the other gods.
qa: Who are the two main peoples in our world?
The Light and the Fury.
How many floors are there in the Tower?
There are twenty floors in the Tower.
Who is the Goddess, and what does she do?
The Goddess rules over us, making laws and watching over the Light and the Fury.
What is the blessing of height?
The blessing of height means that the higher you are in the Tower, the more likely your enchanting and linking attempts will succeed.

chapters.title: The Goddess: Our Guardian
lines: In the beginning, the Goddess created the world and all its people, the Light and the Fury.
She blessed the world with her kindness and wisdom, guiding the two peoples to live together in harmony.
The Goddess lived on the very top floor of the Tower, watching over the people.
She provided her blessings to those who lived higher, making their lives easier and more prosperous.
The Goddess taught people to use their abilities for good, to protect and heal, and to respect one another.
She sent her followers, the Priests, to guide the people and spread her teachings.
On every floor, people could pray to the Goddess, and she would listen to their prayers.
When someone died, their family would take them to the Hall of the Fallen, where the Goddess remembered their courage.
The Goddess taught people to respect each other, no matter where they lived or what floor they were on.
She encouraged people to visit each other on different floors, learn from one another, and grow stronger together.
The Goddess also taught people to be grateful for the blessings she gave them, and to remember her teachings every day.
People who honored the Goddess and her teachings were given special blessings, making them stronger and more successful.
The Goddess’s blessing made the higher floors a paradise, filled with light and happiness.
So, let us always honor the Goddess, pray to her, and live by her teachings.
qa: What did the Goddess do at the beginning?
She created the world and all its people, the Light and the Fury.
Where did the Goddess live?
On the very top floor of the Tower.
What did the Goddess teach people?
To use their abilities for good, to protect and heal, and to respect one another.
What happens when someone dies?
Their family takes them to the Hall of the Fallen, where the Goddess remembers their courage.

chapters.title: Honoring the Other Gods
lines: In our world, not everyone believes in the Goddess, but that is okay.
They have their own gods who they think about and respect.
For example, some people pray to the God of War, who helps them be brave.
Others might pray to the God of Nature, to keep the forests and fields safe.
Even though our goddess teaches us about goodness, other gods can still teach us important things too.
It’s like learning from different teachers, each has something special to share.
So, we should always be kind to everyone, even if we don’t believe the same way.
When we see people praying to other gods, we should bow our heads in respect.
Our tower has many different floors, and everyone lives on different levels.
Sometimes, people visit each other on different floors, like a friend living on Floor 8 visiting on Floor 15.
We learn to be understanding and welcoming, no matter where we come from.
Remember, our Goddess teaches us to respect others and their beliefs.
Even if we don’t agree with someone, we can still be their friend and help them when they need it.
It’s like sharing our toys with others, even if they don’t play with the same toys.
Always remember, being respectful and kind to others is a way to show the Goddess we love her.
Let’s practice kindness and respect for everyone we meet, and our Goddess will be proud of us.

chapters.title: Praying to the Goddess
lines: When you pray to the Goddess, imagine her standing in the sky, watching over everyone.
She likes it when you talk to her about your day, even the small things like eating breakfast or seeing a pretty bird.
She hears all your worries, but she also wants to hear about your happy moments, like when you help a friend.
The Goddess loves it when you thank her for the good things in your life, like a warm blanket or a kind word from a neighbor.
She also listens when you ask for help, whether it's to be brave or to make a friend.
Remember, she’s not just for the big moments, but for the everyday ones too.
For example, when you clean up your room, you can thank her for helping you be more organized.
If you see someone who looks sad, think of her and ask for her to help them smile.
She might give you a sign, like a rainbow after rain, that she heard your prayer.
When you pray, try to think of her as a friend who cares about you, not just a powerful figure.
Even if you forget to pray, the Goddess still loves you and watches over you every day.
She wants you to know that she’s always there, even when you can’t see her.
The next time you go to the market or the Hall of the Fallen, look around and imagine she’s with you, protecting everyone.
Praying doesn’t need to be a big thing, just like being kind doesn’t need to be a big thing. It’s all about the little things.
Lastly, she loves it when you share what you’ve learned about her with others. Maybe you can teach your friends to pray too!
qa: What does the Goddess like to hear about when you pray?
She likes hearing about both your worries and happy moments.
Can the Goddess hear you when you pray about small things?
Yes, she listens to all your prayers, big or small.
What is an example of a small prayer the Goddess would appreciate?
Thanking her for a warm blanket or a kind word from a neighbor.
How can praying help when you see someone who looks sad?
You can think of her and ask for her to help them smile.

chapters.title: Respecting Other Faiths
lines: Respect is a way to show you care about others, just as you hope the Goddess cares for you.
When you see someone praying, it's okay to just nod your head in respect.
If you see someone praying in a way different from how you do, try to smile and show you understand.
Remember, the Goddess loves people from all corners of the Tower, not just your floor.
It's important to be polite to people of all classes and floors, even if they seem different from you.
If you see a friend wearing a special amulet or piece of gear, ask them about it with kindness.
Sometimes, listening to someone's beliefs is as valuable as sharing your own.
When you meet someone new, ask them about their faith, just as you might ask about their favorite food or game.
Maybe you can teach a friend from a different floor about the Goddess and her laws.
If you see someone using a rare lapis stone, you can show respect by not making fun of them.
Even if you don't agree with their faith, it's important to be understanding and patient.
At the Hall of the Fallen, you can show respect by bringing flowers or a small gift for a friend who is there.
Respecting other faiths doesn't just mean talking to people, it also means treating everyone with kindness and fairness.
The Goddess wants us to spread love and respect, not only to our friends but to everyone around us.
You can show respect by helping someone in need, even if it's just a small task like carrying something for them.
qa: Why is it important to respect other people's faiths?
Because the Goddess loves people from all corners of the Tower, and we should treat everyone with kindness and understanding.
What can you do to show respect when you see someone praying differently?
Just nod your head or smile, showing you understand and respect their beliefs.
How can sharing about the Goddess help others?
Teaching a friend from a different floor about the Goddess can help them understand and appreciate her teachings.
What small act can you do to show respect to someone's faith?
Helping someone in need, even if it's just a small task like carrying something for them, can show respect.

chapters.title: The Blessing of Height
lines: The Goddess blesses those who live higher up in the Tower with extra good luck and longer life.
Each floor above the first, or lowest, makes one stronger and happier.
For example, a person who lives on the second floor might be a bit stronger and live a bit longer than someone on the first.
People who live on the third floor can be even stronger and live even longer.
The Goddess wants everyone to live as long and happy a life as possible, no matter where they live.
So, the higher you are, the better the Goddess blesses you, but she still blesses everyone.
Even if you live on a lower floor, you can still enjoy some of the blessings from being higher up.
For instance, you might be able to enchant your gear a bit better if you live a few floors up.
The Goddess also wants everyone to be kind to each other, no matter where they live.
So, even if you live on a higher floor, be kind to your neighbors on the lower floors.
And if you live on a lower floor, try to be kind to those who live above you.
By being kind, you can help make everyone's life a bit better, no matter where they are.
Remember, the Goddess cares about everyone, so be respectful and kind to all.
You can show this by helping someone on a different floor, even if it's just a small task.
For example, if you see someone struggling with a heavy load, help them carry it to their floor.
This can make their day a bit better and show respect for their life and home.
qa: Why does the Goddess bless people who live higher up in the Tower?
Because the higher the floor, the richer the hunting and the more successful enchanting and linking become.
How can people who live on lower floors still enjoy blessings from being higher up?
By using some of the items or enchantments from higher floors, or by being kind to people from other floors.
What does the Goddess want people to do when they visit friends on different floors?
The Goddess wants people to be kind and respectful, even when they visit friends on different floors.
What can you do to show respect for everyone in the Tower?
You can help someone in need, like carrying something for them, or being kind to people on different floors.
