chapters.title: The Light and the Fury: A Tale of Two Peoples
lines: Once upon a time, in the land of Shaiya, there were two great peoples: the Light and the Fury.
The Light were kind and gentle, they wore white and helped others.
The Fury were strong and brave, they wore red and fought monsters.
In Shaiya, everyone could choose their class and adventure.
There were fighters who used big swords, defenders who used shields, and rangers who were fast and light.
Archer people could shoot arrows far away, mages cast spells, and priests healed the wounded.
Each person had six stats: strength, dexterity, resilience, intelligence, wisdom, and luck.
People started at level one and could go up to level eighty by hunting.
They could get better by using lapis stones to enchant their gear.
The market was where people bought and sold their items.
Guilds were places where people could learn and grow stronger.
The strongest person lived on the first floor with their family, above the rest.
Children could visit friends on other floors and learn new games.
The arena was a place where brave people could fight each other.
qa: What two peoples lived in Shaiya?
The Light and the Fury.
What were the classes in Shaiya?
Fighter, Defender, Ranger, Archer, Mage, Priest.
What was the highest floor in Shaiya?
Floor 20.
Who lived on the first floor of Shaiya?
The strongest person and their family.

chapters.title: Classes in Shaiya: A Journey Through the Game
lines: In Shaiya, there are two big peoples, the Light and the Fury.
Each has six classes, like different kinds of heroes.
The Fighters use big, heavy weapons to smash monsters.
The Defenders use shields and wear lots of armor to protect everyone.
Rangers are very fast and can use daggers to hurt enemies.
Arrows from Archers fly fast and far, hitting enemies from a distance.
Mages use magic spells to freeze or burn foes.
Priests heal the injured and use magic to bless their friends.
Every person can get stronger by fighting monsters and getting better gear.
Gems called lapis can make weapons and armor even stronger.
The first floor is the best place to live, with the most treasures.
But everyone can visit other floors, even the top one.
The Arena is where heroes fight each other to see who is stronger.
Strong people usually live on the first floor with their families.
Children love to play games and learn about new classes when visiting their friends.
qa: What are the two peoples in Shaiya?
Light and the Fury.
How do Fighters and Defenders protect themselves?
Fighters use two-handed weapons, while Defenders use shields and armor.
What can Archers do?
They can shoot arrows from afar.
What makes the first floor special?
It has the most treasures and strongest people.

chapters.title: Fighting Monsters: A Game of Wits and Strength
lines: In the Tower, children learn about monsters early,
They know the Fury monsters, who love to eat warriors.
Also, the Light monsters, they wear bright colors.
There’s a game called ‘Tag the Monster’, where you run from it.
In this game, you can use a shield to block its attacks.
Another game is ‘Monster Hide and Seek’, hide like it,
Sometimes, you play with your friends, and you pretend to be different classes.
If you’re a Mage, you might cast magic to make others laugh.
A Fighter might practice blocking and dodging, just like real fighting.
In ‘Bow and Arrow’, the Archer throws soft arrows to hit targets.
Rangers might play ‘Stealthy Stepper’, where you move quietly,
Priests might practice healing, they learn to make tiny, invisible marks.
In ‘Heal the Beast’, you touch the pretend injured monster, making it whole.
The Priest’s game, ‘Wisdom Quest’, is finding hidden words in stories.
When you find a word, you whisper it to your friend, who then passes it on.
In ‘Magic Mirror’, you pretend to see what’s behind a pretend mirror, making riddles about it.
qa: What game teaches you to use a shield to block?
Tag the Monster
What does an Archer practice in a game?
Throwing soft arrows
What does a Priest practice in ‘Heal the Beast’?
Healing
How do players pass on a word they find in ‘Wisdom Quest’?
Whispering it to a friend

chapters.title: The Market of Shaiya: A World of Wonders
lines: In Shaiya’s Market, the air buzzes with the joy of discovery.
Vendors set up colorful stalls, each more magical than the last.
You can find everything there, from sparkling gems to strange potions.
Shiny lapis stones glimmer on the shelves, a symbol of power and magic.
Children giggle as they help their parents find the perfect gift.
The smell of fresh bread and exotic spices fills the market air.
Young hands sort through piles of enchanted weapons and armor.
Some stalls are like tiny treasure chests, filled with mysterious items.
In the Market, the Priest’s game ‘Wisdom Quest’ comes to life.
You find hidden words in a story, whisper them to your friend.
‘Magic Mirror’ challenges you to guess what’s behind a pretend mirror.
Riddles fly around the market, making it a fun game for everyone.
A vendor’s voice echoes, “Find the hidden gem in this tale!”
You and your friend quickly find the word and pass it on.
In another stall, a child tries to guess what’s behind a mirror, saying, “Is it a dragon?”
The laughter of children and the chatter of adults make the market lively and exciting.
qa: What is one of the games found in the Market of Shaiya?
Wisdom Quest
How many stalls are described with magical qualities?
Several, but not explicitly counted.
Can you give an example of a hidden word in a story?
The hidden word might be 'light' in the story of a shining sword.
What is the significance of lapis stones in the Market?
They represent power and magic, with some being rare and precious.

chapters.title: The Blessings of Height: A Quest for Knowledge
lines: You and your friend walk through the bustling market, filled with the sounds of children laughing and adults chatting.
A stall catches your eye; a young boy is trying to guess what's behind a mirror.
He asks, 'Is it a dragon?' and the stall owner nods with a smile.
A small girl nearby tries to guess the answer too, but she just guesses, 'Is it a horse?' with a giggle.
The stall owner explains, 'It's something you use to learn and grow smarter.'
You and your friend think hard, remembering the riddles from the previous chapter.
Finally, you say, 'Is it a book?' and the stall owner says, 'Very good!'
Next, you see a stall selling scrolls with strange symbols on them.
The stall owner explains, 'These are old writings that can help you find more knowledge.'
Your friend asks, 'Can I buy one?' and the stall owner gives you a small, ancient-looking scroll.
You and your friend practice reading the scroll, trying to understand the writing.
It says, 'The higher you go, the more you learn.'
You and your friend decide to visit the highest floors of the Tower to learn more.
You see a poster that says, 'Join the Wisdom Guild and gain special knowledge!'
You and your friend decide to visit the Wisdom Guild the next day.
The Wisdom Guild leader gives you a special task: find a hidden book on the 20th floor.

chapters.title: The Arena: A Test of Bravery and Skill
lines: One morning, you and your friend decided to visit the Wisdom Guild.
The guild leader handed you a special book to find on the 20th floor.
He told you it was a test to see how brave and skilled you were.
The 20th floor was the highest, and the air was thin and cold.
You put on your best gear and took a deep breath.
Before you went, you looked at the poster on the guild wall.
It said, 'Join the Wisdom Guild and gain special knowledge!'
You and your friend were excited to climb the stairs.
The staircase was long and winding, and you could see the sky getting closer.
At last, you reached the 20th floor, the highest one.
There were only a few people there, and you saw an arena.
The arena was a big, round space with seats around it.
You saw two people in the arena, fighting and testing their skills.
You looked around and found a secret door under a rug.
Behind the door, you found the book you were looking for.
It was hidden in a bookshelf with magical locks.
You felt proud and happy to have found the book.
Your friend gave you a high-five, and you both left the Wisdom Guild.
You knew the book would be very helpful.
You promised to visit the Wisdom Guild again soon.
qa: What did the guild leader give you to find?
A hidden book on the 20th floor.
How did you prepare for your adventure?
You put on your best gear and took a deep breath.
What did you see in the arena?
Two people fighting and testing their skills.
Where did you find the book?
Behind a secret door under a rug in a bookshelf with magical locks.

chapters.title: Welcome to Shaiya: Your Adventure Begins
lines: Welcome to Shaiya, where you can choose to be a brave Fighter or a clever Mage, or many other heroes.
In this land, everyone starts at level 1 and must hunt monsters to grow stronger.
There are two big groups here: the Light and the Fury, and they are always having fun or making trouble.
You will make friends with other players and join a guild to help each other.
As you gain levels, you can use lapis stones to make your gear stronger.
The higher you go in the Tower, the better the monsters are, but the harder they are to beat.
You will sell some of your treasure to the market, but keep the best for yourself.
Remember, the floor you live on shows how strong you are, so try to be brave and climb higher!
Every floor in the Tower has a leader, and you might become one too if you are strong enough.
Be careful of the Hall of the Fallen, where the brave souls who died are remembered.
There is also an Arena where you can challenge other players to a battle if you are brave enough.
The Goddess protects Shaiya, and she sends blessings to those who live higher in the Tower.
You can move to different floors to see new places and meet new friends.
Have fun and be brave, Shaiya is waiting for you to explore!
Happy adventuring!
qa: What can you become in Shaiya?
A Fighter, Defender, Ranger, Archer, Mage, or Priest.
How do you get stronger in Shaiya?
By hunting monsters and gaining levels.
What is the Hall of the Fallen for?
To remember brave souls who died.
Can you move floors in Shaiya?
Yes, to visit friends or start again.

chapters.title: The First Steps: Level 1-10 - A Solo Journey
lines: Welcome, young adventurer! Your first steps in Shaiya are crucial.
Start by choosing a class that matches your favorite weapon or style.
Perhaps you want to swing a mighty sword as a Fighter or protect friends as a Defender.
You might prefer the speed of a Ranger or the distance of an Archer.
Or perhaps magic and mystery intrigue you, making a Mage your choice.
At Level 1, your journey starts in the Great Hall, where you will receive your first gear and quest.
Before you leave, equip a basic weapon and wear armor to protect yourself from monsters.
Now, set out into the world, and find a monster to defeat for your first experience points.
Remember, every time you defeat a monster, your character level will rise.
With each level, you'll gain more strength and abilities, so choose your path wisely.
Visit the market to buy or trade for better gear as you grow stronger.
Spend your stat points wisely on what you need most for your class.
Save some points for your luck stat, as it can be very helpful in your adventures.
As you level up, explore the lower floors to find stronger monsters and treasures.
Once you reach Level 10, you can finally move to a higher floor to meet new friends and discover more.
Be brave and explore, and remember, the best adventures are the ones you create yourself.
qa: What are the first steps to take when starting your adventure?
Visit the Great Hall, choose a class, equip basic gear, and go out to find monsters.
How do you gain experience points?
By defeating monsters.
Where can you buy better gear?
The market.
What is the importance of stat points?
They determine your character's abilities and growth.

chapters.title: Leveling Up Together: 10-30 - Embracing the Power of Partying
lines: From Level 10 to 30, you’ll find that solo adventures can get a bit boring and slow.
When you reach Level 10, you can invite friends or make new ones in the market to form a party.
Parties can help you take down tougher monsters faster and more efficiently.
With your new friends, you can explore deeper and find better gear and treasures.
At Level 15, you might think about buying some basic party gear, like a first aid kit for healing.
Remember, when forming a party, you should all be around the same level to make it easier.
At Level 20, consider joining a guild to have a group that meets regularly.
When you reach Level 25, you might want to consider enchanting your gear to +10 to +12, if you have the Lapisia stones.
Parties are especially helpful when you need to deal with dangerous monsters like the Golem in the 12th floor.
By Level 30, you should have a good variety of gear and be able to take on most monsters with your friends.
Working together in a party can also help you learn new strategies and tactics for battling.
Don’t forget to celebrate your milestones with your party, like when you finally reach Level 20 together.
As you level up together, remember to focus on your strengths and complement each other’s weaknesses.
Keep an eye on the Hall of the Fallen, as you might see some of your fallen friends there and remember to be brave and strong.
qa: Why is it important to form a party at Level 10?
To take down tougher monsters faster.
What should you consider buying for your party at Level 15?
A first aid kit for healing.
At what level should you consider enchanting your gear?
At Level 25.
How can parties help you as you level up?
By teaching new strategies, complementing weaknesses, and celebrating milestones together.

chapters.title: Building Your Arsenal: 30-50 - Crafting and Enhancing Gear
lines: Now that you've reached level 30, it's time to build your arsenal with better gear.
You can start by making or buying equipment with +4 enchantments on Floor 6.
Your gear should match your class: a strong Fighter might prefer a sword, while a Ranger could use a dagger.
Don't forget to check the market for deals on enchanted gear before you buy new items.
As a Priest, you can focus on buying items with +2 intelligence and wisdom to boost your healing spells.
At level 40, try to get +8 enchantments from Floor 10 to make your gear even stronger.
You can also craft gear using recipes from your guild leader, which can be a great way to save gold.
Always check the enchanting table to see if your gear needs any improvements before going on a quest.
When you see a +15 lapis stone, don’t hesitate to buy it for your Archer’s bow.
Your party can benefit from +6 enchanted gear, especially for solo quests where you need to be extra strong.
Remember to keep your gear organized so you can easily switch between your main and backup items.
When you're on Floor 30, you can use the Grand Auction to get +10 to +12 enchantments for your Mage’s staff.
Try to save gold for better gear; every piece you buy can make a big difference in your battles.
Celebrate when you get +12 enchantments, as it’s a significant milestone for your gear.
qa: When should I start buying +4 enchantments?
Start at level 30 on Floor 6.
What should a Fighter focus on for better gear?
A Fighter should focus on getting stronger weapons like swords.
How can a Priest benefit from +2 enchantments?
+2 intelligence and wisdom can help with healing spells.
What's a good time to get +12 enchantments?
You can get +12 enchantments from the Grand Auction on Floor 30.

chapters.title: Exploring the Tower: 50-70 - Ascending to New Floors
lines: At 50, you are ready to explore beyond Floor 30, hunting more powerful monsters and encountering new allies.
Start by moving to Floor 31, where you can find better materials for enchanting your gear.
Fighting tougher enemies will drop better loot, making it easier to save for new gear.
Keep your gear enchanted to +12 or +13, ensuring you stay competitive as you climb the Tower.
As you level up, you might find a new ally in Floor 35, where Rangers gather to protect weaker members.
On Floor 37, you can try a solo adventure to find unique items that can give you an edge.
Remember to share your wealth with friends; they might return the favor by helping you find valuable items.
On Floor 40, you can join a party for the first time, testing your combat skills in real battles.
Parties can be formed on the Floor you are on or by traveling to another floor and inviting friends.
With a party, you can tackle tougher enemies and find rare loot you couldn't find alone.
Be cautious in the Arena; summoning others for a fight can be dangerous and costly.
As you reach Floor 50, the rewards for enchanting start to increase; you might get +15 enchantments.
By 60, you should have a good set of enchanted gear, making your battles easier and your journey smoother.
Keep an eye out for the Grand Auction; it’s a great place to trade and get upgrades for your gear.
At 70, you might be able to finally enchant your gear to +18 or +19, a significant boost for your battles.
qa: What is a good floor to start exploring for gear at level 50?
Floor 31
How can you get +15 enchantments by level 50?
By reaching Floor 50
Why is the Arena a dangerous place to summon others?
Because it can be costly and dangerous
What is the maximum enchantment level you can get at level 70?

chapters.title: Mastering the Game: 70-80 - Optimization and Strategy
lines: From 70 to 80, the focus shifts from leveling to optimization.
At this stage, you should be in a guild or group for support.
Your friends can help you find better monsters to farm for materials.
You should have at least one guild leader who can assist you with in-game advice.
At 70, consider enchanting your gear to +18 or +19; it’s a huge leap.
When buying gear, focus on the slots and enchantability; they’re more valuable than pure stats.
You can now visit Floors 4-5, where the monsters are tougher but the rewards are great.
On Floors 4-5, try to find a group of at least three members for better loot sharing.
Don’t forget to check the Grand Auction regularly for upgrades; it’s a treasure trove.
Keep an eye on the Auction for rare lapis stones; they can significantly boost your gear.
As you near level 80, you might consider moving to a higher floor; it’s harder but worth it.
Every 10 floors up, you gain 1% more success in linking and enchanting; it’s a significant improvement.
The strongest player in the Tower lives on Floor 1, but that doesn’t mean you can’t challenge them.
Winning in the Arena can earn you rewards, and it’s a good way to test your strength.
Stay safe and keep your party close; the higher floors can be dangerous.
Remember, the Goddess blesses those who climb higher; it’s a journey of both skill and patience.
qa: What is the significant boost for your battles at level 70?
+18 or +19 enchantment on your gear
Why should you focus on the slots and enchantability when buying gear?
They are more valuable than pure stats
What is the benefit of visiting Floors 4-5 for your gear and stats?
You can find tougher monsters and better rewards
How does the Goddess bless those who climb higher in the Tower?
Each floor above the lowest makes linking and enchanting succeed 1% more often and lives last 1% longer

chapters.title: The Path to Glory: Strategies for Level 80
lines: Now that you've reached the top floors, it's time to focus on the final climb to Level 80.
Each floor brings new challenges, so be ready to adapt your strategy.
First, gather your party for the ultimate challenge.
You'll need a mix of classes, including a Fighter, Mage, and Priest to cover all bases.
The key is teamwork; support each other and share resources.
Focus on collecting lapis stones, as they will be crucial for your final enchantments.
Remember, the higher floors have the richest hunting, so use this to your advantage.
Trade your excess gear and items with other players to get the best lapis stones.
As you approach Level 80, target tougher monsters for the best drops.
Be cautious, the higher floors have tougher enemies, but the rewards are worth it.
Don't forget to visit the Hall of the Fallen to learn from their strategies and equipment.
Once you reach Level 80, the Arena is your ultimate proving ground.
Winning in the Arena can earn you special rewards and recognition.
The blessing of height means each floor above the lowest gives you a 1% advantage.
Stay safe, keep your party close, and remember, the Goddess blesses those who climb higher.
qa: What is the key to success on the higher floors?
Teamwork and support each other.
Why are lapis stones important for Level 80?
They are needed for the best enchantments.
Where can you trade to get the best lapis stones?
The Hall of the Fallen.
What is the final proving ground for Level 80 players?
The Arena.

books.about: finding your way: maps, portals, towns, travelling between floors safely

Exploring Floors: Your Path Begins
Maps and Portals: Your Navigator
Traveling Between Floors: Safe and Sound
Towns and Guilds: Your Support System

chapters.title: Welcome to Shaiya: Your First Steps
lines: Welcome to Shaiya, little adventurer! It's a place full of magic and mystery.
You are one of the Light and Fury peoples, living in a Tower with 20 floors.
Each floor is like a different world, with its own stories and treasures.
Your journey begins when you find your way to the ground floor, the starting point of your adventure.
There, you will meet friendly townsfolk who will guide you.
They will show you how to use a map to explore different floors.
The map helps you find hidden paths and secret portals between floors.
Portals are magical doors that let you travel from one floor to another quickly.
In the town, you can buy gear and food for your journey.
You will also find a market where you can sell your treasures.
Each floor has its own challenges and rewards, so be brave and stay curious.
As you go higher, you might meet people from other floors.
You can visit them or make new friends in the Tower.
The Arena is a place where you can test your strength with other citizens.
Remember, every floor is special and has its own secrets to discover.
qa: What are the two peoples in Shaiya?
Light and Fury.
How many floors does the Tower have?
20 floors.
What is a portal used for?
To travel from one floor to another quickly.
Where can you find food and gear?
In the town.

chapters.title: Exploring Floors: Your Path Begins
lines: Welcome to your adventure in the Tower, little explorer! Each floor has its own special features.
Floor 1 is like a bustling village, with lots of shops and places to meet new friends.
As you go up, the floors get quieter and more mysterious, but that’s where the best secrets are hidden.
Floor 5 has a beautiful garden, where flowers bloom even in the coldest season.
Floor 10 is home to a big library, where you can learn about magic and history.
Floor 15 has a magical waterfall, but be careful, as it can change directions at any time.
Every floor has a different type of monster that can be hunted for treasure.
Some floors have secret paths that lead to new areas, just waiting for you to discover them.
Remember, always stay close to a friend or a guardian when you explore, especially on higher floors.
The Hall of the Fallen is a sad place, but it teaches us that even the bravest heroes have fallen.
You can use the maps found in the Hall to learn more about the Tower and its secrets.
The stairs connecting the floors are safe, but be sure to look both ways before stepping down.
If you get lost, you can always ask a guard or a friendly merchant for help.
Every time you visit a new floor, remember to write about your discoveries in your journal.
qa: What is the first floor like?
It's like a bustling village, with lots of shops and places to meet new friends.
What can be found on Floor 10?
A big library where you can learn about magic and history.
What should you do if you get lost in the Tower?
You can always ask a guard or a friendly merchant for help.
How often do secret paths appear on each floor?
Secret paths can be found on every floor, waiting to be discovered.

chapters.title: Maps and Portals: Your Navigator
lines: Maps and Portals: Your Navigator
Imagine you're standing on the first floor and want to visit the fifth floor to see the beautiful view from the top.
With your trusty map, you can find the stairs that lead up or down to the other floors.
Portals are magical places that let you travel instantly to other floors without going up or down the stairs.
One day, you might find a hidden portal that takes you to the tenth floor and back in a blink!
Remember, some portals can only be used by people with a certain level or by special friends.
The map in your journal is like a treasure map; it helps you remember where you've been and what you've seen.
Sometimes, you might see a guard using a special map that shows all the floors and even the arena!
A friendly merchant can give you a map that shows the best places to buy and sell things on each floor.
On the third floor, you can use a magic map that shows where the strongest monsters and treasures are hidden.
Each floor has its own special portal that only works for that floor, like a secret door that opens only for you.
If you ever get lost, just find a guard or a merchant; they can help you find your way back to where you came from.
The map in your journal is not just for finding places; it’s also a way to keep track of your friends and family who might live on different floors.
Always make sure to bring a small light source when you go to darker floors; it can help you see the portals and stairs more clearly.
One day, you might find a hidden portal that takes you to the eighth floor and back in a blink!
Now, let's practice: can you find your way from the third floor to the seventh floor using your map?
qa: What are portals and how do they work?
Portals are magical places that let you travel instantly to other floors without going up or down the stairs.
How can a map help you when you're lost?
A map can help you remember where you've been and what you've seen, and you can ask a guard or merchant for help using the map.
What kind of special map can you find on the third floor?
A magic map that shows where the strongest monsters and treasures are hidden.
Why is it important to bring a light source to darker floors?
To help you see the portals and stairs more clearly.

chapters.title: Traveling Between Floors: Safe and Sound
lines: When you want to travel between floors, you need to take the stairs and not the elevators, which only work inside your own floor.
Always check the map before you go to make sure you know where you are going.
Start by finding the stairwell on the third floor, it is usually near the central fountain.
Take the stairs up two levels, you will be going from the third to the fifth floor.
As you reach the fifth floor, you might see some adventurers trading on the market, don't be afraid to ask them for directions.
Go down two more floors, you will be on the seventh floor soon.
The seventh floor has a lot of traps and monsters, so always bring a light source.
Look for the glowing circle on the floor, it is a portal to the seventh floor.
Jump into the portal and feel the rush of being transported to your destination.
Remember to exit the portal safely, the landing can be a bit bumpy.
Sometimes, you might find hidden portals, like the one that took adventurers to the eighth floor.
Be careful, hidden portals can be tricky and might lead you to dangerous places.
Once you land on the seventh floor, find the stairwell and go down one more level to your destination.
Always carry a map with you, it will help you navigate the complex floor plans.
Practice using your map and you will be able to travel between floors like a pro!

chapters.title: Towns and Guilds: Your Support System
lines: Towns and guilds are like friendly neighborhoods and clubs for adventurers.
The towns on each floor are bustling with activity and offer many services.
At the center of each town, you'll find the Market Hall where you can buy and sell gear.
The Market Hall is always busy with people trading and bartering.
Don't forget to visit the Smithy in town, where you can get your gear fixed or enchanted.
Remember, the Smithy only works on gear up to +8 enchantments on Floors 4-5, but they can help you on other floors.
In each town, there's a Guild Hall where you can join a guild and meet new friends.
Joining a guild can help you with quests and battles, and they can also help you if you're in trouble.
Guilds often have events and challenges, and they can be a fun place to visit.
For example, the Archers' Guild often has target practice sessions.
The Mages' Guild might have magic casting contests.
The Defenders' Guild practices shield and melee combat.
The Priest's Guild might have healing workshops.
Visit the town and see what the guilds are doing, and maybe join one yourself!
Towns and guilds are always a good place to get help or make friends.
qa: What are towns like in the game?
Friendly neighborhoods with many services.
What is the main function of the Market Hall?
Buying and selling gear.
What can you do at the Smithy in town?
Get your gear fixed or enchanted.
Why is joining a guild helpful?
They can help with quests, battles, and challenges.

plan: Chapter 1: Understanding Your Body and Healing Potions
Chapter 2: The Magic of Escape: Tricks to Stay Safe

Chapter 6: Using the Market Wisely: Buying and Selling Safely

chapters.title: Chapter 1: Understanding Your Body and Healing Potions
lines: Chapter 1: Understanding Your Body and Healing Potions
Let's learn about how your body works, okay?
In your body, you have special places called 'hit points' or HP that show how strong you are.
When you're hurt, your HP goes down, and you need to heal to get better.
Potions are like magic liquids that can make your HP go back up.
There are different potions for different kinds of hurt, like a 'stamina potion' for tiredness or a 'wound potion' for cuts.
If you're tired, a stamina potion can help you run and fight better.
Wound potions make your cuts and bruises go away faster.
Remember, you should only drink the right potion for your injury.
Always ask a grown-up before you drink a potion.
Sometimes, if you're really hurt, you might need to go to the hospital.
If your HP gets to zero, you'll faint, so be careful!
A 'first aid kit' has lots of small potions for little injuries.
A 'healing potion' is really strong and can fix big problems.
Always try to stay healthy and drink water, fruits, and veggies for strong HP.
qa: What are hit points (HP)?
They show how strong you are.
What is a stamina potion for?
To help you run and fight better when you're tired.
Where can you find a first aid kit?
In your house or in a hospital.
What happens if your HP gets to zero?
You'll faint and need help.

chapters.title: Chapter 2: The Magic of Escape: Tricks to Stay Safe
lines: When you feel scared or lost, take a deep breath, it will help you calm down.
If you're in trouble, try to look for a door or a way out of your room or floor.
Carry a small map with you, it can help you find your way back to your home.
If you can't find an exit, hide in a closet or a corner, but be quiet and don't make noise.
If you see a friend in trouble, help them, but make sure you're safe first.
Have a 'first aid kit' close by, it can help you treat small cuts and bruises.
Use a small mirror if you need to send a message to your friend or family.
Sometimes, a friend can be a hero, and your hero might be you.
If you see a monster, don't run, stay calm and look for a safe place or a way to hide.
If you get tired or hungry, find a safe place to rest and eat, but don't go hunting if you're tired.
Always check if your potion is still good before using it.
If you're feeling scared, sing a happy song to yourself, it can help you feel better.
If you feel like you're in danger, use your 'healing potion' to give you some courage.
Stay safe, be brave, and always remember to help your friends when they need you.
qa: What can you do if you feel scared?
Take a deep breath and try to look for a way out.
What should you do if you see a monster?
Stay calm, find a safe place to hide.
How can you help a friend who is in trouble?
Help them, but make sure you're safe first.
What should you do before using a potion?
Always check if the potion is still good.

chapters.title: Chapter 3: Hunting Safely: Never Hunt When Tired
lines: When you're tired, your body feels weaker, so hunting monsters is riskier.
You might think you can handle it, but tiredness slows you down and makes you less smart.
Imagine you're trying to run from a big, mean monster - you can't run as fast, can you?
It's important to rest when you feel sleepy, like after lunch or a long day of playing.
Let's say you find a cozy corner to sit and rest - that's a much better place for hunting, not a monster's home.
Your healing potion can help you feel better and give you more energy to fight monsters.
Remember, a strong person needs to save their energy, just like how you save your favorite toy for special times.
If you feel tired, take a deep breath and think about a fun game or a happy place.
Maybe you can draw a picture or sing a song to yourself - that can help you feel less tired and ready for a monster adventure.
Always remember, it's better to take a break and rest than to try to fight tired.
A tired hero is an easy target, so always listen to your body.
Think about how you feel - if you're yawning or feeling sleepy, it's time to find a safe place to rest.
Your friends can help you if you're feeling tired - they can share their energy or find a nice place for you to rest.
If you see a friend who looks tired, help them find a spot to rest, just like a kind friend would do for you.
qa: Why is it important not to hunt when you're tired?
Because tiredness makes you less strong and smart.
What can a healing potion do?
It can help you feel better and give you more energy.
How can you help a tired friend?
By finding a spot for them to rest or sharing energy with them.
What should you do if you feel sleepy before hunting?
Find a safe place to rest and take a break before hunting.

chapters.title: Chapter 4: Helping a Fallen Friend: A Hero's Duty
lines: When you see a friend who looks tired, remember to offer help.
It's like when your friend trips on the stairs - you pick them up and offer a hand.
If your friend is struggling to carry a heavy backpack, you can help them share the load.
You might find a comfy spot for your friend to rest, like a soft carpet or a bench.
Always check if your friend needs any potions to feel better.
Potions can be like magic water that makes you feel refreshed and ready to play again.
Sometimes, a simple hug from a friend can make them feel much better.
If your friend is still tired, find a safe place for them to rest and maybe even take a nap.
Remember, your friend might need to eat something too - like you do after playing all day.
You can share a meal with your friend, and maybe they'll feel more energetic after eating.
If your friend looks like they might fall asleep, gently guide them to a safe spot to rest.
A fallen friend might need a short break - you can sit with them and keep them company.
Never leave a fallen friend alone - they might need you more than you know.
Always be ready to help your friend - you never know when they might be the one who needs you.
Being a hero is about helping others, just like when you helped your friend earlier.
qa: When should you help a friend who looks tired?
When you see them looking sleepy or weak.
What are some ways you can help a tired friend?
You can share energy, find a place to rest, offer a hug, check for potions, or help with heavy items.
Why is it important to find a safe place for a tired friend?
To ensure their safety and to help them recover.
What should you do if your friend is still tired after resting?
Check if they need more rest, food, or potions.

chapters.title: Chapter 5: The Blessing of Height: Staying Healthy and Strong
lines: When you stay on a higher floor, you get better at fighting and staying healthy.
Imagine you are on Floor 5 and your friend is on Floor 3 - you can help them by giving them your strong potion.
If you're feeling sick or tired, go down to a lower floor and rest - the air is thicker and you'll feel better.
Remember, the air on higher floors is thinner, so be careful when you go up.
On Floor 10, your potions work better and last longer, so use them wisely.
You can use your potions to heal yourself or a friend who is hurt.
If a friend is hurt and you can't help them, take them to the Infirmary - the healers there are very good.
When you're strong, you can help others more. On Floor 15, you'll feel extra strong.
If you're feeling weak, remember that the air on Floor 10 will help you feel better.
Every time you go up a floor, you get a tiny bit stronger - just like when you climb a tree.
Helping a friend on Floor 12 will make you both feel even stronger.
When you're tired, take a nap in the lower floors - the air is thicker and you'll feel better.
If a friend is injured, use your potion to heal them and give them some food too.
On higher floors, you have more chances to succeed when you try to fix your gear or learn new skills.
qa: Why is it important to be on a higher floor?
Because the air is thicker and you get better at fighting and staying healthy.
What can you do if a friend is hurt?
You can use your potions to heal them and take them to the Infirmary if needed.
How does the air on higher floors affect you?
The air is thinner, so you need to be careful when you go up.
Why should you help a friend on a higher floor?
Because helping others makes you feel stronger and helps them too.

chapters.title: Chapter 6: Using the Market Wisely: Buying and Selling Safely
lines: In Staying Alive, it’s important to know how to buy and sell items safely.
Visit the market regularly to see what items are available and their prices.
Always check the quality of any item before purchasing it.
Buy potions and food when you visit the market - they can save your life or help a friend.
Remember, on Floor 1, you can use all 12 link slots to enchant your gear, while on Floor 4-5, you can use only 8 slots.
On higher floors, you can sell up to +8 enchanted gear, but on Floors 6-20, you can only sell up to +4.
If you can’t sell an item, remember it will go to the Grand Auction, where it may fetch a better price.
When selling items, make sure to get the best possible price for them.
Don’t sell all your items at once - keep some for when you really need them.
If you have extra items, consider selling them to the Grand Auction - they might fetch a good price there.
Be careful when trading with others - always ask for proof of quality or authenticity.
On the higher floors, you can find better items for sale, so consider visiting them more often.
Always be prepared - carry enough gold with you to buy what you need.
If you’re on a lower floor and find a great item, think about moving to a higher floor to sell it for more.
Using the market wisely can help you stay alive and grow stronger in your adventure.
qa: Why is it important to check the quality of items before buying them?
To avoid buying broken or useless items.
What can you do with items you can’t sell on your floor?
They can be sold at the Grand Auction.
How does visiting higher floors help when selling items?
You can sell items with higher enchantments and more link slots.
What should you keep in mind when trading with others?
Always ask for proof of quality or authenticity.

books.title: The Bestiary
books.about: the monsters of Shaiya: weak ones, strong ones, bosses, what they drop and how to beat them
plan: Introduction to the Monsters of Shaiya
Weak Monsters: The First Steps
Strong Monsters: A Steady Challenge
Bosses: The Ultimate Tests
How to Beat Them: Tips and Tricks
What They Drop: Rewards for Bravery

chapters.title: Introduction to the Monsters of Shaiya
lines: Monsters are everywhere in Shaiya, from the bottom to the top of the Towers.
On the lower floors, you can find small monsters like Lurkers and Slimes.
They are easy to defeat but remember, too many can be dangerous!
In the middle, you might meet the fierce Gnoll and the sneaky Bandits.
They are smarter and stronger, but they also drop useful items like keys and coins.
On the upper floors, you will face tough monsters like the Fire Giant and the Frost Lich.
These are the bosses that challenge even the bravest adventurers.
Be careful with them; they have powerful attacks but also unique abilities to defeat.
For example, the Fire Giant can set you on fire, but if you hit him on the head, he gets mad and starts swinging his club.
The Frost Lich can freeze you, but he is weak against ice magic.
You will find special drops from bosses, like rare lapis stones or legendary gear.
Sometimes, you can find unique items, like the Key of the Ancients, that open hidden doors.
Remember, always take care of your gear; it can be enchanted to make you stronger.
The best way to learn about monsters is to meet them and see how they behave.
Stay brave, and you will become a hero in Shaiya!
qa: What are some examples of small monsters?
Lurkers and Slimes.
What is a unique ability of the Fire Giant?
He can set you on fire, but he gets mad if hit on the head.
What special item might you find from a boss?
Rare lapis stones or legendary gear.
What is the Key of the Ancients used for?
It opens hidden doors.

chapters.title: Weak Monsters: The First Steps
lines: In Shaiya, the first steps in your adventure are with the weak monsters.
These monsters are easy to find in the lower floors of the Tower.
They are often seen in the fields or in small groups.
For example, the 'Bunny' is a common weak monster you might encounter.
Bunnies have soft fur and move quickly, so you need to be quick to attack them.
The 'Flea' is another weak monster, but it's much smaller and harder to see.
Fleas might attack you by jumping on you, so watch your step.
Weak monsters like these give you experience and coins when defeated.
Experience helps you level up, which makes you stronger for future battles.
Coins can be used to buy gear and food from the market.
Always remember to take care of your gear; it can be enchanted to make you stronger.
When you first meet a monster, watch how it acts to learn more about it.
For instance, notice if it runs away or attacks when it sees you.
This can help you choose the best way to defeat it.
Weak monsters can drop items like food or small pouches of coins.
Sometimes, they might also drop small lapis stones that can be used for enchanting gear.
When you're ready, try to beat a weak monster by yourself to gain confidence.
qa: What are some examples of weak monsters in Shaiya?
Bunny, Flea
What should you watch out for when fighting a Bunny?
Their quick movement
Why is it important to watch how a monster acts?
To understand the best way to defeat it
What items might a weak monster drop?
Food, coins, small lapis stones

chapters.title: Strong Monsters: A Steady Challenge
lines: Strong monsters are bigger and tougher than weak ones, but they also have more health and better drops.
They can be found in deeper floors of the Tower, waiting in their lairs.
Some strong monsters guard the entrances to the dungeons, like the Golem of Stone.
You might see the Golem blocking your way, with its huge fists and thick skin.
It drops lapis stones when defeated, helping you strengthen your gear for tougher challenges.
Don’t forget to avoid its powerful punches and dodge its stone throws.
The Cave Wyrm is another strong monster, with a long body and sharp teeth.
It lives in the depths, near the lava pits, making it harder to reach.
The Cave Wyrm can breathe fire, which can be tricky, but its attacks are slower, giving you time to react.
Its treasure includes rare gems, which can be used to enchant weapons and armor.
The Dark Archer is a stealthy, strong monster, often found on the higher floors.
It moves quietly, hiding in the shadows and shooting arrows from afar.
If you hear a whispering voice, watch out! The Dark Archer might be nearby.
It drops enchanted bows, making it a valuable find for archers.
Remember, strong monsters take teamwork, so always come prepared with friends or allies.
Each strong monster has its own special tricks, so stay alert and use all your skills.
qa: What do strong monsters usually have more of than weak monsters?
More health and better drops.
Name an example of a strong monster and its location.
The Golem of Stone, blocking entrances to the dungeons.
What kind of treasure does the Cave Wyrm drop?
Rare gems for enchanting weapons and armor.
What is the main strategy against the Dark Archer?
Stay alert and use all your skills to avoid its stealthy attacks.

chapters.title: Bosses: The Ultimate Tests
lines: Bosses in Shaiya are like the biggest challenges you can face in the Tower.
They are the ultimate tests of your skills and bravery.
The first big boss you might encounter is the Dark Behemoth on Floor 6.
It can breathe fire and summon smaller monsters to help it.
Use a lot of arrows to wear it down before going in for the final hit.
On Floor 10, the Lich King is a smart and tricky foe.
It uses ice spells to freeze you and steal your health.
Be quick to dodge and heal yourself before it can hurt you too much.
In Floor 15, the Golem of Stone stands tall and strong.
It can throw huge rocks and break down barriers.
Team up and take turns to attack, as it's hard to knock down alone.
At the very top, on Floor 20, you’ll face the Dragonlord.
This boss is very proud and uses dragons to attack you.
You must fly above it and strike from above to hit its weak spot.
Remember to always have a plan when facing a boss.
Bring a mix of weapons and spells to handle any situation.
Use the arena to practice with friends if you’re worried.
Don’t rush the fight; take your time and think through each move.
With your friends, you can tackle even the toughest of bosses.
The best way to win is by sticking together and supporting each other.
qa: What does the Dark Behemoth use to attack?
Breathes fire and summons smaller monsters.
What is the Lich King's special ability?
It can freeze you and steal your health.
How should you approach the Golem of Stone?
Team up and take turns to attack to wear it down.
Which boss can only be defeated from above?
The Dragonlord.

chapters.title: How to Beat Them: Tips and Tricks
lines: Always use your friends to help you. For example, if you fight a group of Goblins, one person can distract them while another deals the final blow.
When you face a group of enemies, attack the weakest ones first. They will drop resources you need.
If you’re low on health, move to the back and let your friends do the fighting. You can heal them in the meantime.
Remember, you can’t defeat a boss by yourself. Always ask for help from a guild or a friend.
Some monsters drop special stones called lapis. Collect them to enchant your gear. Lapis stones make your gear stronger and easier to enchant.
When you’re fighting a boss, try to lure them away from your friends. This way, you can avoid their attacks better.
Look for hidden paths and traps in the monster’s lair. Using them can surprise the monster and give you the upper hand.
If you’re stuck, use the Hall of the Fallen to see what others have done. It can give you ideas on how to beat the monster.
Don’t forget to use the market to buy buffs or potions. They can help you in tough situations.
Sometimes, it’s better to run away than to fight. Use your Retreat ability to escape from danger. Come back later when the monster is weaker.
When fighting in a group, use your unique abilities to support each other. A Priest can heal, a Mage can create a shield, and a Fighter can distract enemies.
Learn the monster’s patterns. Some monsters will always attack from the same direction. Predict their attacks and avoid them.
If you’re low on health and can’t fight, use your retreat or hide ability. Rest and come back when you’re ready.
Before you attack, make sure you have the right gear and buffs. Weak gear can’t handle powerful monsters.
Be patient. Taking your time and planning your moves can help you win even the toughest battles.
qa: What should you do when facing a group of monsters?
Attack the weakest ones first.
Why is it important to use friends in fights?
To support each other and increase chances of winning.
What should you do if you’re low on health during a fight?
Move to the back and let your friends fight while you heal them.
What is the best way to beat a boss?
Always ask for help from a guild or a friend.

chapters.title: What They Drop: Rewards for Bravery
lines: When you defeat a monster, you can get rewards that make you stronger.
These rewards are called drops, like a bag or a potion.
Sometimes, you might find gold, which you can use to buy better gear.
If you beat a boss, you could get a lapis stone, which can make your equipment even stronger!
For example, if you kill a Goblin, you might find a small dagger.
Defeating a Wolf might give you some extra health or a better dagger.
A stronger enemy, like the Draugr, might drop a lapis stone, which is very rare and magical.
Be careful! Dropping a valuable item might be worth it if you need to retreat and regroup.
Remember, fighting a stronger enemy with the wrong gear can be very dangerous.
Always check what you dropped before you leave the battle zone.
For instance, if you kill a Goblin, you might get a dagger or some gold.
If you defeat a Wolf, you might find a potion that heals you a bit or gives you some extra strength.
Beating a Draugr is a big challenge, but if you succeed, you might get a lapis stone to enchant your gear.
A Trollskin might drop a big piece of armor that protects you from attacks.
If you're lucky, you might find a Draugr's bone, which can be used to make a magical potion.
Always be patient and plan your attacks, and you'll have a better chance of winning the battle.
qa: What kind of rewards might you get from fighting a monster?
Gold, gear, potions, or rare lapis stones.
What should you do if you drop valuable items and need to retreat?
Pick them up when you return or leave them for later.
How can you prepare for a tough battle against a stronger enemy?
Check your gear and buffs to make sure you're ready.
What might you find when you defeat a Draugr?
A lapis stone or a big piece of armor.

chapters.title: Welcome to the Archer's Way
lines: Welcome to the Archer's Way, a guide for young archers like you.
You are part of the Light or the Fury, one of the two peoples of Shaiya.
In Shaiya, you can become a Fighter, Defender, Ranger, Archer, Mage, or Priest.
Your journey starts at level 1 and ends at level 80, by hunting monsters and growing stronger.
Arrows, bows, and agility are your weapons and tools as an Archer.
You can be quick and light on your feet, like the Ranger, or powerful and accurate, like the Archer.
Your gear can be enchanted with lapis stones, making it better and more powerful.
Every floor of the Tower in Shaiya has its own rules, like the laws of the Goddess.
On Floor 1, you can enchant your gear to +20 and use all 12 link slots.
On Floor 20, you can only enchant to +4 and use 4 link slots.
The stronger you are, the higher you live in the Tower, but everyone can move to other floors.
You can join the Arena and fight another citizen, but be careful and respect the rules.
The Hall of the Fallen is where all the brave souls rest, after their journey is done.
Remember, practice makes perfect, so always train and improve your archery skills.
qa: What are the two peoples of Shaiya?
Light and Fury.
What is the starting level for an Archer?
Level 1.
What is the highest level an Archer can reach?
Level 80.
On which floor can you enchant your gear to +20?
Floor 1.

chapters.title: Understanding Your Stats
lines: In the Archer's Way, understanding your stats is key, for they shape how well you can shoot arrows.
Arrows fly far and true when your DEX (dexterity) is high, like a cat's swift leap.
STR (strength) matters too, for drawing heavy bows and holding them steady.
RECOV (toughness) keeps you alive through battles, much like a shield against arrows.
Intelligence (INT) helps you pick better arrows and enchant them, making your shots even deadlier.
Wisdom (WIS) gives you a bit of extra luck, like finding a rare lapisia stone.
Lucidity (LUC) lets you focus your mind, aiming more precisely, like a sniper on a target.
When you start, your stats might be low, but with practice, they'll grow, like a tree's trunk.
If you want to become a powerful archer, aim for high DEX and STR, just like a swift, strong bird.
Remember, a well-aimed shot needs both skill and focus, like hitting a bullseye on a target.
When joining the Arena, think about your stats, for they'll decide if you hit your target or not.
Aim to level up by hunting, as this increases your stats, like a tree growing taller with each year.
Enchant your gear with lapis stones to make your arrows fly faster, like adding wings to an arrow.
Visit the Hall of the Fallen to see where your stats could take you, like a journey to a faraway land.
Always be patient and practice, for your stats will tell you if you're improving or not.
qa: What is the most important stat for an Archer?
DEX (dexterity).
Which stat would help an Archer live longer?
RECOV (toughness).
What can an Archer do to improve their stats?
By hunting monsters and leveling up.
Why is it important to use lapis stones?
To enhance the effectiveness of your arrows.

chapters.title: Archer's Gear and Equipment
lines: An Archer's bow is the most important tool. It needs to be sturdy but also light.
You should always pick a bow that feels good in your hands, like finding the perfect pair of shoes.
Bow strings can wear out, so make sure you replace them every few weeks.
Never use a bow without a string, like a musician without their instrument.
Arrows are crucial; they must be straight and sharp, or they won't fly true.
Imagine sending an arrow through a target as if it were a magic wand pointing towards victory.
Arrow quivers are handy; they hold all your arrows and keep them organized.
You can buy new arrows from the market or make them yourself at the Smithy.
Fletching is the art of feathering arrows; it makes them fly straighter and faster.
Use feathers from fast birds; they're better at making arrows fly fast.
You might use a quiver that glows in the dark, perfect for sneaking up on enemies.
An Archer's best friend is a good backpack; it keeps your gear safe and organized.
Bow cases are necessary for travel; they protect your bow from damage.
Always test your bow and arrows before going into battle, like warming up before a race.

chapters.title: Mastering the Art of Archery
lines: Archers master the art of shooting from a distance, using bows and arrows.
You must aim and shoot with precision to hit your targets.
Practice makes perfect, so always spend time shooting targets.
Bows require strength to draw back, so build your STR stat.
Arrows need to be sharp and straight; keep them well-maintained.
Use different types of arrows for different situations, like fire or poison.
A good quiver is essential; it holds your arrows and keeps them organized.
Practice drawing your bow with both hands to be versatile in battle.
Learn to shoot from different angles, like behind cover or on the move.
Use your DEX stat to improve your aim and stability while shooting.
Practice your aim in different weather conditions to be ready for any battle.
Understand that accuracy and distance are key, not just strength.
Remember that teamwork is important; support your friends in battle.
Always stay alert and watch for enemies, even when not in combat.

chapters.title: Fighting Strategies for the Archer
lines: In battle, always choose your shots carefully.
Use your speed to dodge attacks and get into position.
Aim for the weak spots of your enemies to make your shots count.
Keep your distance from enemies to use your bow at its best.
Learn to use your surroundings to your advantage; hide behind rocks or walls.
Communicate with your team; they might give you a signal when an enemy is nearby.
If you are in a group, stay behind your friends to protect them from ranged attacks.
Remember, every arrow is valuable, so use them wisely.
Stay calm under pressure; taking deep breaths can help you focus.
Watch for flanking enemies; they will sneak up on you and your allies.
Use your agility to move between enemies and shoot them from different angles.
When facing a big monster, aim for its eyes or heart to make the shot count.
In the Arena, remember to be both offensive and defensive.
Sometimes, it's better to let your friends take the spotlight; they might need to heal or cast a spell.
qa: What should you do to make your shots count?
Aim for the weak spots of your enemies and use your surroundings to your advantage.
Why is it important to stay behind your friends in a group?
To protect them from ranged attacks.
What should you do in the Arena?
Be both offensive and defensive.
How can you help in a group battle?
By staying behind your friends and taking deep breaths to focus.

chapters.title: How to Support Your Party
lines: Sometimes, a team needs your arrows less, but your healing more.
Think of your role as a support, not just a shooter.
When your friends are low on energy, share your extra lumen stones.
Remember to use your arrows to help your team, not just to score points.
Heal a wounded friend or give them a potion if they need it more than a shot.
In a battle, don’t just fire at the enemy, but also help your allies, like pushing them to safety.
Share your extra gear with those who need it, especially on higher floors where resources are harder to come by.
If you see a fallen comrade, don’t hesitate to revive them with a timely shot.
Your skill in archery can help gather the best materials for the team’s needs.
Supporting your party doesn’t mean you can’t shine. Sometimes, your best shots can turn the tide.
If you see an ally in danger, use your speed to get to them and protect them.
Always keep an eye on the battlefield and help your friends with your arrows or healing magic when needed.
Sometimes, it’s best to let a healer take the lead, focusing on keeping everyone alive.
Remember, as a team, you’re stronger than as individuals. Help each other to win battles and survive.
Even when things get tough, don’t forget to check on your friends and offer your support first.
qa: How can you help your team on a battle?
By using your arrows to heal, push allies to safety, and share resources.
What should you do if you see a friend in danger?
Use your speed to get to them and protect them from harm.
When should you use your speed?
To help allies in danger or to get to them quickly for support.
How can you be supportive without overshadowing your team?
By focusing on healing, protecting, and assisting when needed, instead of taking the spotlight.

chapters.title: Conclusion: Your Journey as an Archer
lines: As an Archer, you are the eyes and the arrow in the fight.
You stand on the edge of the battlefield, watching for danger and spotting enemies.
Your bow is your companion, always by your side, ready for action.
Learn to aim and shoot with precision, like the feline hunter.
Use your speed to dodge attacks and get to the right spot.
Don’t forget to move stealthily, like a forest dweller.
When you see an enemy, don’t rush to attack; think first.
Your arrow can save your allies by taking out the threat first.
Teamwork is key, always help your friends in need.
Be brave, but never reckless; think before you shoot.
Remember, your arrow can also be a tool for negotiation.
In the Arena, your sharp wit and quick reflexes will shine.
You are a master of distance, keeping everyone safe from afar.
Always keep learning, improve your aim and strategy.
qa: What are the two main roles of an Archer?
Eyes and arrow
Why is it important to move stealthily?
To avoid attacks and get to the right spot
How can you help your allies?
By shooting enemies first
What is the key to surviving in the Arena?
Sharp wit and quick reflexes

chapters.title: Introduction to the World of Shaiya
lines: In the world of Shaiya, there are two big groups of people: the Light and the Fury.
There are six jobs to choose from, but we will focus on the Defender, a person who uses a big shield and a lot of armour.
Defenders wear heavy armour to protect themselves, and they are like a wall for their friends.
They use a shield to block attacks and hit monsters with a club or a heavy sword.
Defenders are tough and strong, but they are not as fast as other classes.
In Shaiya, people level up by fighting monsters and killing them.
Everyone lives in a big Tower with twenty floors, and each floor is like a different level of difficulty.
The higher you are, the better monsters you can fight and the more treasure you can find.
Defenders can use special magic called enchanting to make their gear even stronger.
To enchant gear, they need a special stone called lapis, and there are different levels of enchantments.
Defenders can sell their enchanted gear to the market or keep it for themselves.
The strongest Defender in the whole Tower lives on the very top floor, Floor 1.
Everyone gets a little stronger and lives a little longer the higher they are in the Tower.
The best thing is, you can visit other floors to see friends or do new adventures!
So, are you ready to become a Defender and protect your friends?
qa: What are the two main groups in Shaiya?
Light and Fury.
How do people level up in Shaiya?
By hunting monsters.
What is the highest floor in the Tower?
Floor 1.
How does living on a higher floor benefit a Defender?
They get stronger and live longer.

chapters.title: Understanding Your Defender Role
lines: A Defender is like a big, strong shield that protects everyone in your group.
Think of your shield as a wall that stops all the monsters from hurting your friends.
Defenders wear heavy armour to stay strong and safe, just like how you wear a helmet to protect your head while playing.
Your main job is to stay in front of your friends and take the hits from monsters, so they can focus on fighting and winning.
Imagine a time when you were playing tag with your friends and you always stopped others from being tagged. That’s what a Defender does, but with big monsters!
Defenders have high toughness (REC) and strength (STR), which help them block and withstand attacks.
You can train your strength by lifting heavy things or by doing many push-ups, just like how you train for sports.
To improve, you can use magic stones to make your gear stronger, like lapisia that makes your shield even harder.
Visit other floors to learn new skills and get better gear. Each floor has special things for Defenders.
Defenders are the heart of the group, always ready to help and protect. Just like how your mom or dad keeps you safe.
If a monster gets too close to your friends, shout ‘Stop! ’ and you will push the monster back, just like in a game.
Remember, in the Tower, being on a higher floor means you can have more magic stones and stronger gear. So, keep climbing higher!
Sometimes, you might need to carry items for your group, like water or food, just like how you might carry your backpack to school.
Always be ready to help your friends and others. You can make a lot of friends by being brave and strong like a Defender.
The Goddess watches over the Tower and she loves Defenders who are brave and strong.
Now that you know about the Defender’s role, go and show your friends how strong you are!
qa: What is the Defender's main job in a group?
To stay in front and take the hits from monsters so friends can focus on fighting.
What two stats are important for a Defender?
Toughness (REC) and Strength (STR).
How does visiting other floors help Defenders?
They can learn new skills and get better gear.
What does the Goddess think of Defenders?
She loves Defenders who are brave and strong.

chapters.title: Defender Stats and How They Affect You
lines: Defenders are like the shields of the Tower, standing between danger and those we protect.
Your main job is to protect others, so your Strength (STR) is very important.
Imagine a big, strong shield, that's how your STR helps you block attacks.
Also, your Toughness (REC) is great, because it makes you hard to hurt.
Let's say a monster lunges at you with a knife; your REC makes you harder to stab.
Defenders need to move around and protect people, so Dexterity (DEX) is also important.
If you need to dodge a falling rock, your DEX helps you move fast.
Intelligence (INT) is not as important for Defenders as it is for Mages, but it still helps.
With some INT, you can choose better gear and know when to fight.
Wisdom (WIS) is also not as important, but it helps in figuring out the best way to protect others.
Luck (LUC) is a bit like a gift, sometimes it helps you dodge an attack or find good gear.
Think of LUC like a surprise party; you might get a nice surprise when you need it.
In battle, your STR and REC are like a strong shield and a thick armor.
When you wear a heavy shield, you need to be strong to hold it and tough to not get hurt by it.
The Goddess loves Defenders who are brave and strong, so use your STR and REC to show her.
Practice moving with your shield; that's your DEX at work!
qa: What are the two main stats for a Defender?
Strength (STR) and Toughness (REC).
Why is Dexterity (DEX) important for Defenders?
It helps them dodge attacks and move around easily.

chapters.title: Essential Gear for Defenders
lines: A Defender’s shield is their best friend, like a big, strong hug.
Think of your shield as a giant wall that stops enemies’ attacks.
When you wear a shield, you must have strong arms to hold it steady.
You also need toughness so the shield doesn’t hurt you when you move.
A great shield is big and heavy, like a big, friendly bear.
In a fight, your shield is your first line of defense, like a guard dog protecting you.
Always keep a spare shield in your bag, just in case your main one breaks.
A Defender’s armor is like a second skin, protecting you from harm.
Choose armor that fits well, so it doesn’t get in the way when you move.
Strong armor is tough and hard to break, like a solid brick wall.
Light armor lets you move faster, like a superhero in a cape.
Defenders wear different types of armor, like knights in armor or ninjas in suits.
Your shield and armor should fit you well, like a custom-made suit.
Check your shield and armor for any dents or cracks, just like checking for holes in a blanket.
Always clean your shield and armor after a fight, like washing your hands after playing.

chapters.title: Defender Skills and Abilities
lines: Defenders are like the towers that protect the city, strong and steady.
Your main job is to block attacks, like a shield protecting a castle wall.
When a monster swings its sword, you must block with your shield, not letting any damage through.
If you can, help your friends by taking the harder hits, so they can keep fighting.
You might not deal damage, but your protection is what keeps the team alive.
Learn to dodge, so you don't get hit by attacks, like a cat avoiding a falling object.
Use your shield's parry ability to knock back attackers, giving your friends a chance to attack them.
Practice blocking and dodging, just like how you practice running and jumping in P.E.
In a battle, be the one who stands firm, like a tree standing tall in the wind.
When a friend is about to take a hit, step in front of them, like a knight protecting a king.
Learn to use your shield to push monsters away, giving your allies room to attack.
Your armor can also help you stay standing, giving you more stamina in battle.
You might not be the fastest, but you can be the last one standing, like a rock in a storm.
Always try to block attacks with your shield, even if it means taking a little damage yourself.
In a big battle, keep your shield up, like a wall in a sandcastle, protecting everyone behind you.
qa: What is the main role of a Defender?
To block attacks and protect others.
Why is it important to clean your armor and shield?
To keep them in good condition, just like keeping your clothes clean.
How can a Defender help in a battle?
By taking the hardest hits and protecting their friends.
What special skill does a Defender have?
The ability to parry and knock back attackers with their shield.

chapters.title: Fighting Strategies and Tactics
lines: Always stand in front when the battle starts, like a wall keeping the storm out.
Use your shield to block the big hits, even if it means you get a bit hurt.
Help your friends by taking the brunt of the attacks, they can focus on attacking.
When you see an enemy coming, raise your shield and wait for them to strike.
If you are hit, drop to one knee to avoid taking extra damage.
In a group, stay in the back, protecting the healers and mages.
Use your shield to push enemies away, making them hit their friends.
If you are surrounded, use your shield to block multiple attacks at once.
When you see an enemy with a lot of health, use a shield block to wear them down.
When you have a choice, attack enemies that are already hit by others.
If you see an enemy with low health, use your shield to hit them and finish them off.
In a group, use your shield to protect allies from attacks, even if it means you get a few hits.
When you see a group of enemies, break them apart and focus on one at a time.
If you see an enemy that is strong, use your shield to protect others while they deal with them.
Remember, in a battle, you are the wall that holds everything together.
qa: What should you do when the battle starts?
Always stand in front and use your shield.
How can you help your friends in battle?
Take the brunt of the attacks so they can focus on attacking.
What should you do if you are surrounded?
Use your shield to block multiple attacks at once.
What is the most important thing in a battle?
Being the wall that holds everything together.

chapters.title: Supporting Your Party as a Defender
lines: As a Defender, you are the heart of the party, like a tree that gives shelter to the birds.
When you see a group of enemies, remember to split them, so you can take them down one by one.
If you see a very tough enemy, use your shield to protect your friends and let them handle it.
You can use your shield to block attacks and protect your friends, like a shield that stops a rock.
When your friends are fighting, you can use your shield to push enemies away and keep them from hurting your friends.
Sometimes, you can use your shield to push enemies into dangerous areas, like a trap.
Always stay close to your friends, so they can see you and know you are there to protect them.
If an enemy is about to attack a friend, quickly step in and block the attack with your shield.
You can also use your shield to hold an enemy in place, so your friends can deal with them.
When you see a weak enemy, help by taking them out quickly and freeing up your friends to fight stronger foes.
You can use your shield to push enemies towards each other, making them fight among themselves.
In a tough battle, you can use your shield to protect your friends and buy them time to come up with a plan.
If you see an enemy casting spells, use your shield to block their view and stop them from seeing your friends.
Remember, even if you think an enemy is weak, always be careful and use your shield to protect others.
qa: What should you do when you see a group of enemies?
Split them and focus on one at a time.
How can you protect your friends with your shield?
By blocking attacks, pushing them away, or holding enemies in place.
What should you do if an enemy is about to attack a friend?
Quickly step in and block the attack.
Why is it important to stay close to your friends?
So they can see you and know you are there to protect them.
