chapters.title: Understanding Why Apologies are Important
lines: In the world of Shaiya, everyone lives in a tower with many floors, and sometimes we make mistakes that hurt our friends.
If you say something mean to your friend, they might feel sad or upset, and that's not nice.
Even the strongest warriors, like the Mage or Fighter, can make mistakes, like accidentally breaking a toy during play.
When you break something or accidentally hurt someone's feelings, you should say sorry to make things better.
Saying sorry is like giving a hug to your friend's feelings when they are hurt.
When you say sorry, you show that you care about your friend and want to make amends.
Even if you think you didn't do anything wrong, if your friend feels hurt, you should still say sorry to be kind.
For example, if you borrow a book and forget to return it, you should say sorry to the friend who owns the book.
Sometimes, saying sorry can make a friend forgive you and be your friend again.
If you say sorry when you are wrong, it can help you learn to be more careful next time.
People on different floors of the tower, like Floor 1 and Floor 20, might have different rules, but saying sorry is always good no matter where you live.
An apology can be simple, like saying 'I'm sorry' or 'I'm sorry for what I did', or it can be a letter or a drawing to show you are sorry.
It's important to look at things from your friend's point of view and understand how your actions might hurt them.
Saying sorry can help you and your friend stay friends and make your playtime more fun.
qa: Why is saying sorry important?
It helps fix mistakes and keeps friendships strong.
What can saying sorry fix?
Saying sorry can fix hurt feelings and broken toys.
Can everyone say sorry?
Yes, everyone can say sorry, even the strongest warriors in Shaiya.
When should you say sorry?
You should say sorry when you hurt someone or break something, even if it was an accident.

chapters.title: How to Say Sorry
lines: When you say sorry, it's good to use your words carefully.
Say 'I'm sorry' first, like you did in your last apology.
Explain what you did wrong, like 'I broke your toy car by accident.'
Tell your friend you understand why they are sad or upset.
It's okay to take a deep breath before you say sorry, especially if you feel scared.
Sometimes, it helps to say 'I feel bad for what happened' to show you care.
Be honest, but also be kind when you apologize.
Use your best words to say sorry, like 'I'm really, really sorry.'
If you're not sure how to say it, you can say 'I'm sorry I made you feel bad.'
Say sorry even if you think your friend started the fight.
If you're not sure if your friend is okay, you can say 'I hope I didn't hurt your feelings.'
Always remember to say sorry, even if you think you're right.
A good apology can be short, like 'I'm sorry, I will be more careful.'
After you say sorry, give your friend a hug or a smile to show you want to be friends again.
qa: What's the first step in saying sorry?
'I'm sorry.'
Why is it important to explain what you did wrong?
It helps your friend understand why you're sorry.
What should you do if you're scared to say sorry?
You can take a deep breath before you speak.
Why is it good to be honest when you say sorry?
Honesty shows you care about your friend and what happened.

chapters.title: Making It Right
lines: When you say sorry, you should try to make things better.
For example, if you took your friend's toy and they were sad, give the toy back.
If you broke a flower in the garden, you could help to plant a new one.
Sometimes, you might need to clean up a mess you made.
Like if you spilled juice on the floor, clean it up yourself.
Offer to do extra chores to help make up for it.
If you were the one who was angry, try to give your friend a chance to explain.
Listening to your friend can help them feel better.
Maybe you can play a game together to make it fun again.
Remember, an apology is not just words, but actions too.
For instance, if you were mean to your friend, you could say sorry and ask to be friends again.
Sometimes, you might need to say sorry more than once.
If you said something hurtful, ask them to forgive you and say you’re sorry.
Try to be a better friend by being nicer and kinder to them.
Always try to make it right after you say sorry.
qa: What can you do if you took a friend's toy?
Give the toy back.
What should you do if you broke a plant?
Help to plant a new one.
Why is it important to listen to your friend after apologizing?
To help them feel better.
What does an apology include besides words?
Actions to make things better.

chapters.title: Asking for Forgiveness
lines: If someone feels sad because of what you said, ask them if they want to be friends again.
Say, 'I'm sorry I called you names. I shouldn't have said that. Can you forgive me?' to the person who is upset.
Listen carefully to what the person tells you about their feelings.
Don't interrupt when someone is telling you they are upset. Let them finish their thoughts first.
If you're not sure if someone has forgiven you, ask gently, 'Are you still upset with me?'
Say something like, 'I know what I said hurt you. Please let me make it better by being nice to you again.' to show you're sincere.
Give the person some space if they need it. But be there when they want to talk.
If you make a mistake, offer to help the person in a way that shows you care.
Write a note or draw a picture to show you care about the friendship.
A hug or a kind word can help make things better if the person is ready to forgive.
Ask the person if you can play with them or share something nice.
Be patient and give the person time to feel better.
If the person says no, say, 'I understand. I'll try harder next time.' and mean it.
Always be kind and try to be their friend even if they are upset.
qa: What should you do if someone feels sad because of something you said?
Ask them if they want to be friends again.
What is an example of what you should say when you apologize?
Say, 'I'm sorry I called you names. I shouldn't have said that. Can you forgive me?'.
Why is it important to listen carefully to the person?
To understand their feelings and how to make things better.
What should you do if you are not sure if someone has forgiven you?
Ask gently, 'Are you still upset with me?'.

chapters.title: Being Honest and Kind
lines: When someone is upset, use kind words like, 'I know you're angry, but I want you to know I'm sorry. '
If you accidentally break a toy, say, 'I'm really sorry, I didn't mean to break your favorite toy. '
Offer to make it up to them, like, 'Can we play a game together? '
When you hurt someone's feelings, it's okay to say, 'I know I hurt your feelings, and I feel bad about that. '
If you're not sure what to say, start with 'I'm sorry I did that, it wasn't nice. '
Always tell the truth, even if it's hard, like, 'I took your cookie without asking, and I should have asked first. '
If you say sorry and the person is still upset, give them space, like, 'I see you're still upset, I'll go play somewhere else. '
After apologizing, you can ask, 'Is there anything I can do to make it better? '
Be a good friend, like, 'I'm here for you, even if you're mad at me. '
Use your best voice to say sorry, like, 'I'm really, really sorry for what I did. '
Sometimes, a simple hug can show how sorry you are, like, 'I'm sorry, can I give you a hug? '
Always be honest, even if you're scared, like, 'I'm sorry, I know I shouldn't have done that. '
Be patient and let the person feel better, like, 'I know you're upset, but I'll be patient. '
Remember to be kind and think of others, like, 'I want to make things right, can I do that?
qa: Why is it important to be honest when apologizing?
Honesty shows you truly understand and take responsibility for your actions.
What should you do if the person is still upset after apologizing?
Give them space and time to feel better.
How can you show you're sorry if words are not enough?
You can offer to make it up to them or give them a hug.
Why is it important to always try to be their friend even if they are upset?
It helps to maintain a good relationship and shows you care even when they're angry.

chapters.title: Understanding When You Need Help

If you're trying to build a tower with blocks and it keeps falling down, it's okay to ask someone for advice.
You don't always have to do everything by yourself; it's okay to ask for help.
Even if you're the strongest in your class, it's okay to ask for help when you need it.
Sometimes, when you're trying to tie your shoelaces and it's tricky, it's okay to ask a grown-up for help.

chapters.title: Knowing Who Can Help You
lines: When you need help, think about who might know the answer or can offer support.
For example, if you're not sure how to play a new game, ask your older sibling or a friend who's good at games.
If you need help with your homework, your parents or a teacher could be great helpers.
When you're feeling scared about a new school, talk to someone you trust, like a parent or a family friend.
If you're not sure what to do about a tricky situation, a counselor at school or a librarian might have ideas.
If you're having trouble making a decision, like what to wear, your mom or dad can help you choose.
When you're confused about a rule, like when to take out the trash, check with the house rules or your parents.

Remember, asking for help is a sign of being smart and willing to learn.
You can also ask your pet for help, they might offer unexpected advice!
If you're feeling shy, you can still ask for help, just be polite and kind about it.
When you're in a new place, like a friend's house, it's okay to ask questions and get help if you need it.
If you're scared of something, like a thunderstorm, it's okay to ask for help to feel safe.
It's always good to ask for help from someone you trust and respect.

chapters.title: Thanking Those Who Helped
lines: When you ask for help, remember to thank the person who helps you.
It could be a friend who explains a tricky math problem to you.
Or a classmate who shares their lunch with you when you forgot yours.
Even if it's just a small thing, like someone holding the door open for you.
Thanking someone shows that you value their kindness and it makes them feel good.
You can say 'thank you' or 'thanks' directly to the person.
If you don't see them, you can write a quick note and leave it on their desk.
Another way is to give them a little smile and a nod to say you're grateful.
If you're too shy, you could draw a picture of something you made and give it to them as a thank you.
Remember, it doesn't have to be a big thing, just show you care.
For example, if a teacher helped you understand a topic, you could give them a small token of appreciation.
You might say, 'Thank you, Mr. Johnson, for explaining the concept so well.'
Or if a friend lent you their notebook to copy homework from, you could say, 'Thanks, Emily, for letting me copy your notes.'
Sometimes, you might not be able to thank the person right away, but remember to do it later.
It's always nice to express your gratitude, even if you don't say it out loud.
qa: Why is it important to thank those who help you?
It shows you value their kindness and makes them feel good.
What are some ways you can express gratitude?
You can say 'thank you', write a note, give a smile, or give a small token of appreciation.
Can you thank someone even if you don't see them?
Yes, you can leave a note or give them a small token of appreciation.
Is thanking someone always a big deal?
No, it doesn't have to be a big deal, just show you care.

chapters.title: Understanding Patience
lines: Patience is like waiting for your turn to play in the park.
Sometimes, you might want to go straight to the swings, but it’s okay to wait.
In a race, everyone gets to start at the same time, but some might finish ahead, that’s okay.
When you’re coloring a picture, it’s better to go slow and make it pretty, than rush and make mistakes.
Imagine baking a cake, you can’t rush the ingredients to mix, you need to wait for them to blend right.
Patience is like waiting for a plant to grow, you can’t force it, but you can take care of it and wait for it to grow.
If you’re waiting for your friend to arrive, you can use the time to draw a picture or read a book.
When you’re playing a game, sometimes you win, sometimes you don’t, that’s okay and teaches you to be patient.
You can count your breaths when you’re waiting for something to calm down, like a baby elephant in a zoo.
If you’re waiting for your turn on the slide, you can practice climbing stairs really well.
Sometimes, waiting for something can be fun, like waiting for a birthday to come.
Patience is like a seed, it takes time to grow into a big plant, and then it can give you lots of flowers.
When you’re learning to ride a bike, you fall a few times, but with patience, you get better and better.
Patience is like building a tower with blocks, you have to be careful and add one block at a time.
qa: What is an example of patience like in the story?
Waiting for your turn to play in the park.
How can waiting be fun?
Waiting for your birthday to come.
What can you do while waiting for something in the story?
Use the time to draw a picture or read a book.
What is an example of patience in daily activities?
Waiting for a plant to grow.

chapters.title: Why Patience is Important
lines: Patience helps us in many ways, just like in the Tower of Shaiya where everyone lives.
If you want to climb to the higher floors, you need patience to get there.
It's like the journey of a Mage learning new spells; they start small and get better with time.
When you're playing a game with your friends, waiting for your turn shows patience.
In the Arena, waiting for your match to begin is part of showing patience.
At the market, when you're saving up gold to buy something you really want, patience helps you save.
In the Hall of the Fallen, the dead show how important patience is in their long lives.
Imagine you're training to become a Fighter; you start with simple weapons and get better with each level.
When you're learning to play an instrument, patience helps you learn the tricky notes.
It's like the Ranger who practices with daggers to become faster and more skilled over time.
Patience is also like the Archer who spends hours aiming and shooting to get better at a distance.
Just like the Priest who learns healing magic, you need patience to master all the spells.
In the Tower, moving up a floor means more challenges, but also more rewards; patience helps you climb.
If you're learning a new game, staying patient will help you understand the rules and strategies better.
qa: Why is patience important in climbing the Tower of Shaiya?
Because it takes time and effort to move up the floors, and patience helps you achieve this step by step.
How does patience help in the Hall of the Fallen?
It shows that patience leads to a longer life, emphasizing its value.
Can you give an example of patience from the book?
The example of a Mage learning spells shows that patience helps in mastering skills.
What does patience help with in the Arena?
Patience helps you wait for your turn and handle the game's rules and challenges.

chapters.title: Practicing Patience in Everyday Life
lines: Patience is like the Fighter who takes time to learn the two-handed weapon moves, not rushing.
Just as the Archer needs patience to hit the bullseye, you need to be patient to win at games.
The Defender must be patient to protect the weak, like guarding a small pet from a bigger dog.
The Ranger must be patient to track prey, like watching a caterpillar crawl and turn into a butterfly.
The Mage must be patient to cast spells, like waiting for a snowflake to grow and form.
The Priest must be patient to heal, like waiting for a cut to stop bleeding and start healing.
Patience helps you wait for your turn, like when you're in line for ice cream, and you keep calm.
Patience helps you wait for a long bus ride, like when you're on a trip, and you read books or play games.
Patience helps you wait for the computer game to load, like when you're eager to play, and you stay still.
Patience helps you wait for your turn to speak, like in class, and you listen to others first.
Patience helps you wait for the teacher to come and help you, like when you're stuck, and you don't interrupt.
Patience helps you wait for your friend to finish their homework, like when you're doing a project together, and you're patient.
Patience helps you wait for the bus to come, like when you're late, and you stay where you are.
Patience helps you wait for the vegetables to cook, like when you're hungry, and you don't complain.
qa: What does patience help with when playing games?
It helps understand the rules and strategies better.
How does patience help while waiting in line for ice cream?
It helps you stay calm and patient.
What is an example of being patient during a long bus ride?
Reading books or playing games.
Why is patience important when waiting for the teacher to help?
It allows you to listen to others and not interrupt.

chapters.title: Patience and the Tower's Ranks
lines: When the time comes to enchant your gear, you might need to wait as others try their luck with the lapis stones. Patience helps you wait your turn, knowing you'll get a chance soon.
If you see a powerful Mage on the 12th floor, it's okay to be impressed. Patience helps you understand that everyone starts somewhere and that your journey is important too.
Think of the 1st floor, where the strongest people live. Patience teaches you that you can still be kind and helpful even if you're not on the top floor.
During the Festival of Lights, you might see a Priest healing someone. Patience helps you understand that everyone, regardless of their rank, can be a hero in their own way.
Remember the times when you had to wait for the bus, or when your vegetables took longer to cook. These small acts of patience help you build the strength to be patient in larger situations.
On the 3rd floor, you might be able to enchant your gear to +20. Patience helps you follow the rules and wait your turn to use the best lapis stones.
When you visit your friend on the 10th floor, you might notice that they have better gear. Patience helps you understand that they've been patient and worked hard to get there.
If you decide to move to the 18th floor, you'll notice that it takes longer for your gear to enchant. Patience helps you stay calm and focused, knowing that your efforts will pay off eventually.
Think of the Hall of the Fallen, where brave adventurers rest. Patience teaches you to respect their memory and the journey they took.
During a battle in the Arena, you might be patient and wait for the right moment to attack. Patience helps you focus and make smart decisions in the heat of the moment.
When the laws of the Goddess say that each floor above the lowest makes linking and enchanting succeed 1% more often, patience helps you stay positive and work hard to improve.
Remember the blessing of height, which says that you live 1% longer for each floor above the lowest. Patience helps you enjoy the journey to the top, knowing that your efforts are valuable.
Even on the 1st floor, where the strongest people live, you might see them helping others. Patience teaches you that true strength comes from kindness and helping those around you.
qa: Why is patience important when enchanting your gear in the Tower?
It helps you follow the rules and gives you the best chances for success.
How does patience help you in the Arena?
It helps you focus and make smart decisions.
What does the blessing of height teach you about patience?
It teaches you that effort and patience lead to better success.
How can you show patience when visiting a friend on a higher floor?
You can appreciate their achievements without feeling envious.

chapters.title: Patience in the Arena and Beyond
lines: Patience helps you understand that fighting in the Arena is not just about winning, but learning to be the best version of yourself.
Think of the Arena as a playground where you and your friends can learn to play together.
Even if you lose a match, remember the skills you learned and the new friends you made.
Sometimes, watching others play can teach you more than winning a game.
In the Arena, see it as a chance to practice your patience and kindness towards others, even if you are winning.
Imagine you are on Floor 15, and you can see the top floor. Each day you climb one floor, you get closer to your goal.
Patience means enjoying the view of the Tower as you slowly but surely move up the floors.
Picture yourself as a Ranger on Floor 10, learning to use your daggers with speed and precision.
As you gain experience, you might even help a younger player, showing them the ropes.
Remember, even on the bottom floor, you can be kind and patient with everyone you meet.
Kindness and patience can help you make friends from all floors, not just your own.
When you reach the top, you will see the world from a higher perspective, but that is not the goal. The journey is the real treasure.
Every time you visit a friend on a lower floor, you are spreading kindness and patience, making the world a better place.
Patience in the Arena and beyond is about finding joy in the small moments of your journey.
Be patient and kind, and you will find that the rewards are much greater than any single victory.
The Goddess rewards patience and kindness, so be a good citizen of the Tower and spread the blessings of height.
qa: Why is patience important in the Arena?
It helps you focus on learning and improving, not just winning.
How does patience help you in the Tower?
It helps you make friends and learn from others, no matter which floor you are on.
What does the blessing of height teach us?
It teaches us that each floor above the lowest makes us stronger and healthier.
How can you use patience in the Arena to benefit others?
By being kind and helping others, especially younger players, you spread the benefits of patience and kindness.

books.title: How to Choose a Partner
books.about: how to choose a partner
plan: Introduction: The Importance of Choosing Wisely
Understanding Your Own Strengths and Weaknesses
Exploring the World of Shaiya and Its Classes
Finding Your Partner: Tips and Criteria
Conclusion: Building a Lasting Friendship

chapters.title: Introduction: The Importance of Choosing Wisely
lines: In Shaiya, choosing a partner is very important, like picking the best friend to play with.
It can make your adventures and battles in the Tower more fun and successful.
A good partner helps you grow stronger and safer in your journey.
Imagine you have a shield-bearer friend who can protect you from monsters.
If you both work together, you can climb to higher floors where stronger monsters and better gear await.
Think of a brave ranger who can help you sneak past dangerous areas.
Having a smart mage friend can teach you spells to defeat tough foes.
A wise priest can heal your wounds and help you stay healthy.
Just like picking the right ingredients for a tasty soup, choosing the right partner makes everything better.
It’s like choosing the right color to paint your tower room, making it more beautiful and fun.
But remember, it’s okay to change partners if someone isn’t a good fit, just like changing your crayons when a new one arrives.
Always be kind and considerate to your partner, like sharing your food and toys.
Choosing a partner is not just about being close friends, but also about working well together.
The higher the floor you live on, the more you need a strong and smart partner to help you.
Like building a tower with blocks, the base needs to be strong to reach the top.
qa: Why is choosing a partner important?
It helps you grow stronger and safer in your journey.
Can you change partners if you find a better fit?
Yes, just like changing crayons when a new one arrives.
What are some examples of good partners mentioned?
A shield-bearer, a brave ranger, a smart mage, and a wise priest.
What does the blessing of height mean?
It means the higher the floor, the better success in linking and enchanting and longer lives.

chapters.title: Understanding Your Own Strengths and Weaknesses
lines: In Shaiya, every person is special in their own way, like a warrior with a unique weapon.
Think about your own strength, like a warrior who can lift heavy stones.
Maybe you run faster than anyone, like a ranger who can quickly find the best path.
Or perhaps you are really smart, like a mage who can solve hard puzzles.
But remember, no one is perfect, and everyone has things they need to learn or do better.
For example, if you're a fighter, you might not have much magic power.
On the other hand, a healer might not be as strong in battle.
Understanding this helps you find someone who can make up for what you lack.
Imagine a healer and a fighter working together to save the day.
They can look out for each other, just like how a brave knight and a clever wizard might team up.
It’s like a baker and a farmer, each has their own skill that the other needs.
Always be honest about your strengths and weaknesses.
This helps you choose a partner who will help you grow.
Remember, the best partners are like a shield and a sword, working together to protect and fight.
Every floor in the Tower is like a new adventure, with new friends and challenges.
qa: What are some examples of strengths in Shaiya?
Strength, speed, intelligence, and wisdom are some examples.
How can understanding your weaknesses help you choose a partner?
It helps you find someone who can complement your weaknesses.
What does the author compare choosing a partner to in the story?
Choosing a partner is compared to building a tower with blocks.
Why is it important to be honest about your strengths and weaknesses?
To find the right partner who can help you in your weaknesses.

chapters.title: Exploring the World of Shaiya and Its Classes
lines: In Shaiya, there are two peoples: the Light and the Fury, each with their own special classes.
You can be a Fighter, a defender, a ranger, an archer, a mage, or a priest.
Fighters use two-handed weapons and are strong, just like your dad when he lifts weights.
Defenders carry shields and heavy armor, protecting others like a brave knight.
Rangers are quick and sneaky, moving like a cat in the dark.
Archer can shoot from far away, like playing with a slingshot, but much cooler.
Mages can cast magic spells, like turning a key into a door.
Priests can heal wounds, like a doctor, but with magic.
Each class has its own special abilities, just like you have your favorite toy.
You can play with all classes, but the best partners are like a shield and a sword, working together.
Imagine playing with a best friend who can help you in any situation.
You can move to different floors to make new friends and try out new classes.
Each floor has its own challenges, like a treasure hunt or a maze.
The higher you go, the stronger and more magical things you can find.
But remember, the best partner is someone who is brave, kind, and always there for you.
qa: What are the two main peoples in Shaiya?
The Light and the Fury.
How many classes are there in Shaiya?
Six classes.
Can you explain one of the classes, like a Mage?
Sure, mages can cast magic spells, like turning a key into a door.
What is special about moving to different floors?
You can make new friends and try out new classes.

chapters.title: Finding Your Partner: Tips and Criteria
lines: In choosing a partner, think of someone who will help you in your adventures, just like a good friend on a treasure hunt.
Look for someone who is brave like the Fighter class, never backing down from a challenge.
Kindness is important, like the Mage who uses their magic to heal others.
Always be there for each other, like the Priest who stands by their friend during tough times.
Choose someone with strengths that complement yours, like a Mage and a Defender together.
Be honest with each other, like sharing a secret with a trusted friend.
Learn from each other, like a Fighter learning combat skills from a Ranger.
Support each other's dreams, like a Dreamer with a Mage helping them with their magical experiments.
Be patient with each other, like waiting for the Archer to shoot the perfect shot.
Trust is key, like the Priest and the Defender who have a strong bond.
Show respect, like treating everyone, even monsters, with kindness.
Be open to differences, like learning from the Archer’s quick thinking.
Help each other improve, like the Fighter teaching the Ranger better fighting techniques.
Be loyal to each other, like a bond that can’t be broken, even in the Arena.
qa: What trait should you look for in a partner according to the text?
brave
How does kindness play a role in choosing a partner?
Kindness is like a Mage healing a friend with magic.
What does it mean to complement each other’s strengths?
A Mage’s magic and a Defender’s protection work well together.
Why is trust important when choosing a partner?
Trust is like the Priest and Defender’s bond, unbreakable.

chapters.title: Conclusion: Building a Lasting Friendship
lines: Remember, your partner is like a shield for you in the Arena.
Just like the Defender protects others, you should protect each other.
Help each other with challenges, like the Mage teaching the Priest spells.
Be like the Priest and the Ranger, always caring for each other.
Support each other's growth, like the Fighter and the Archer practicing together.
Always be loyal, even if you face the strongest monsters together.
A true friendship lasts longer, just like the blessing of height makes lives last longer.
Share your knowledge, like the Mages sharing magical secrets.
Celebrate each other's achievements, like the Priest healing the wounded Fighter.
Work together in the Tower, even if you live on different floors.
Be patient and kind, like the Defenders protecting their allies.
Remember, a lasting friendship is built with trust and understanding.
Just as the Goddess blesses those who are strong, she also blesses those who are loyal.
In the Arena, always be a true friend, like the Light and the Fury uniting.
Finally, always choose a partner who will make you a better person, like the Archer teaching the Priest the ways of speed.
qa: How does the Defender's role relate to friendships?
Just like the Defender protects others, you should protect each other.
What does the chapter suggest about supporting each other's growth?
It suggests helping each other with challenges and practicing together.
What example does the chapter give about celebrating each other's achievements?
It mentions the Priest healing the wounded Fighter as an example.
What does the chapter say about building trust in friendships?
It says a lasting friendship is built with trust and understanding.

books.about: how to climb to a higher floor

Building Your Character: Classes and Skills
The Magic of Gear and Enchantments
Exploring Floors: Tips for Survival

chapters.title: Welcome to Shaiya: Understanding the Basics
lines: Welcome to Shaiya, the land of two peoples: the Light and the Fury. In Shaiya, there are six classes of brave adventurers: the Fighter, the Defender, the Ranger, the Archer, the Mage, and the Priest.
Shaiya is a land of adventure and growth. As you adventure, you will level up by hunting monsters and defeating them. You will level from 1 to 80.
The people of Shaiya live in a Tower that has 20 floors. Floors are filled randomly, so you might find strong adventurers as well as those who are not so strong on every floor.
There is a special place called the Hall of the Fallen where brave adventurers go when they die. It is a sad but important part of Shaiya’s world.
In Shaiya, adventurers can use magical stones called lapis to make their gear stronger. The best lapis are called lapisia and are very rare.
The laws also say that the strongest adventurers live on the first floor, and their families are there too. They are like the kings and queens of Shaiya.
There is a special place called the Arena where two adventurers can fight each other for fun. People bet on who will win.
Shaiya is a place where you can make friends, learn new things, and grow stronger. Every floor is a new challenge, and every challenge is a step towards becoming the best adventurer you can be.
qa: What are the six classes of adventurers in Shaiya?
Fighter, Defender, Ranger, Archer, Mage, Priest.
How do you level up in Shaiya?
By hunting monsters and defeating them.
What is the Hall of the Fallen?
A place where brave adventurers go when they die.
What is the special place called the Arena used for?
It is used for adventurers to fight each other for fun.

chapters.title: Building Your Character: Classes and Skills
lines: In Shaiya, there are six classes to choose from, each with its own special abilities and tools.
Fighters use big, heavy weapons and are very strong, like a bear defending its honey.
Defenders carry big shields and wear heavy armor to protect their friends.
Rangers are quick and sneaky, like a cat, and use small knives for fighting.
Archer is like a bird with wings, using long bows to shoot arrows from far away.
Mages can make magic appear, like a wizard in a story book, and use their smart mind to cast spells.
Priests can make people feel better, like a doctor, and use their wise mind to heal wounds.
When you start your adventure, you choose a class, and that class will tell you which skills to practice.
Fighters learn to swing their weapons and protect themselves from danger.
Defenders learn to use their shields to block attacks and make strong armor.
Rangers learn to move silently and use their speed to surprise their enemies.
Archer learns to aim and shoot arrows to hit their targets far away.
Mages learn to use magic and cast spells to hurt or protect their friends.
Priests learn to heal and make people feel better when they are hurt.
As you level up, you can improve your skills and learn new ones.
For example, if you are a fighter, you can learn to use both hands to swing a big weapon.
If you are a defender, you can learn to make your shield glow to protect yourself.
If you are a ranger, you can learn to use traps to catch your enemies.
If you are an archer, you can learn to shoot multiple arrows at once.
If you are a mage, you can learn to create shields of magic to protect your friends.
qa: What are the six classes in Shaiya?
Fighter, Defender, Ranger, Archer, Mage, Priest.
What are the abilities of a Fighter?
Use big, heavy weapons and are very strong.
What does a Defender use to protect themselves?
A big shield and heavy armor.
What is a Mage's special skill?
Can make magic appear and cast spells.

chapters.title: The Magic of Gear and Enchantments
lines: Magic is in everything, even in your gear.
When you wear armor or a shield, they can have special powers.
Imagine a shield that makes a loud noise when someone tries to hit you - that's magic in action!
Your weapon can also be magical, like a sword that glows in the dark or a bow that always shoots straight.
To make your gear magical, you need something called lapis stones.
These stones are very special and rare, like a precious gem.
You can get lapis stones by hunting powerful monsters, but they are hard to find.
The magic of your gear can be as simple as making your character look cool or as powerful as protecting them from harm.
To enchant your gear, you need to use these lapis stones in a special way.
A Fighter might enchant a sword to be stronger, making it harder for enemies to break.
A Ranger might enchant a bow to shoot farther, so they can stay safe.
A Mage might enchant their clothes to make them invisible, helping them sneak up on enemies.
The magic of gear can be as strong as +20, but it costs a lot of lapis stones to get there.
Remember, the higher you go, the harder it is to enchant your gear, but the better the rewards are.
So, always try to save your lapis stones for when you really need them.
qa: What are lapis stones?
Magic stones used to enchant gear.
Why are lapis stones important?
They are used to make gear more magical and powerful.
Can anyone enchant their gear?
Yes, but only with lapis stones.
What can enchanting your gear do?
It can make your gear stronger, faster, or more useful.

chapters.title: Exploring Floors: Tips for Survival
lines: Always wear your strongest gear when you go to a higher floor. For example, if you have a +15 sword, don't try to use a +10 one to save lapis stones.
If you are a Mage, take your best mana potions before you go to a higher floor. They can help you survive longer.
Remember to eat before you go to a higher floor. Food can give you extra energy to fight stronger monsters.
Never go alone to a higher floor. Always bring a friend or join a guild. They can help you in a fight.
Keep an eye on your health and magic points. They can go down quickly in higher floors.
If you see a monster you can't beat, run! Sometimes it's better to lose a fight and come back later.
Stay in the middle of the floor when you are in a higher level. That's where the strongest monsters are.
Look for hidden paths or secret rooms. Sometimes they can lead to easier ways to climb or to better loot.
Listen to the sounds around you. They can tell you if a monster is near or if a good spot for loot is nearby.
Always be ready to defend yourself. Even in safe areas, a monster can suddenly appear.
If you find a useful item, take it. You never know when you might need it.
If you have extra lapis stones, sell them in the market. You can buy better gear with the money.
If you find a rare monster, take a picture or write down its name. You can share it with your guild members.
If you feel scared, take a deep breath. Fear can make you make bad decisions.
Stay calm and focused. Clear thinking can help you find the best way to climb.

chapters.title: Climbing Higher: Strategies and Advice
lines: Always have a plan before you start climbing up. For example, you might decide to check the market for better gear first.
Remember the blessing of height; the higher you go, the better the chances of success in your adventures.
If you're going to Floor 10, make sure to take plenty of potions and food, as you'll need energy for the journey.
You might meet friendly monsters on the way; don't be afraid to ask for help or trade items.
Be kind to others. Sharing your food or gear can make friends, and friends can help you.
If you see someone in trouble, offer your help. A strong alliance can take you higher.
Practice using your abilities in safe places before you need them in a fight.
When you find a good spot to rest, take the time to do it. Resting well will keep you strong.
If you feel you need to take a break, don’t hesitate. Sometimes, a short break is what you need to keep going.
Be patient. Climbing a floor isn’t always easy, but keep trying, and you’ll get there.
When you reach a new floor, explore carefully. New floors might have hidden treasures or challenges.
If you get lost, don’t panic. Use your map or look for clues to find your way back.
Celebrate your achievements, no matter how small. Each step is a victory.
Always remember to share your experiences and discoveries with your friends. It’s easier to climb together.
qa: What should you do before starting to climb a new floor?
Always have a plan before you start climbing up.
Why is it important to be kind to others on your journey?
Being kind to others can make friends, and friends can help you.
What should you do if you get lost on a floor?
If you get lost, don’t panic. Use your map or look for clues to find your way back.
How can you celebrate your achievements?
Celebrate your achievements, no matter how small. Each step is a victory.

books.title: How to Grow Old Well
books.about: how to grow old well
plan: Understanding the Journey: What it Means to Grow Old in Shaiya
Building a Strong Foundation: How to Start Your Tower Life
Exploring Your Floor and Beyond: Making the Most of Your Tower
Strengthening Bonds: The Importance of Friends and Community
Embracing Wisdom: Becoming a Wise and Valued Member of Your Floor

chapters.title: Understanding the Journey: What it Means to Grow Old in Shaiya
lines: In Shaiya, growing old means climbing higher in the Tower, little one.
The Tower has 20 floors, and each floor is like a new adventure waiting for you.
People start their journey from the bottom, where the monsters are big and scary.
As you grow stronger, you move to higher floors to face tougher challenges.
Your friends and family might live on different floors, so you learn to travel up and down often.
The higher you go, the richer the monsters are, giving you more treasure.
Some floors have special rules, like Floor 3 where you can use all your gear and sell everything.
But the higher you go, the harder it gets too, because the monsters are tougher.
Every time you climb a floor, you get stronger and live a little longer.
The Goddess blesses the higher floors, making it easier to succeed and survive.
On Floor 1, the strongest people live with their families, leading from the top.
When you grow old, you might meet a challenger in the Arena, a test of your strength.
The blessing of height is real, and it helps you in many ways as you grow older.
So, embrace each floor of the Tower, for it is your path to growing old well.
qa: What are the different floors in the Tower like?
Each floor is like a new adventure with tougher monsters and richer rewards.
What special things can you do on Floor 3?
You can use all your gear and sell everything.
What happens when you move to higher floors?
You get stronger and live a little longer, but the monsters are tougher too.
How do you test your strength as you grow old?
You might be challenged in the Arena.

chapters.title: Building a Strong Foundation: How to Start Your Tower Life
lines: When you start your Tower life, find a strong floor to live on.
The blessing of height starts working right away, making you last longer and succeed more often.
Look for a friendly Fighter or Defender for a friend and protector.
They can teach you basic fighting skills and be there for you.
A Ranger is also good for learning to be quick and stealthy.
Arrows and daggers are useful tools, so practice with them.
Join a guild to learn more about the Tower and get help from others.
Visit the market to buy gear and learn about the world.
A Mage can teach you magic, which is powerful but needs careful use.
A Priest can help you understand how to use healing magic.
The Hall of the Fallen reminds us that everyone grows old.
But the blessing of height means you can live many floors up.
So be brave and move up as you grow stronger.
Remember, every floor is part of your journey to growing old well.
qa: Why is it important to find a friendly Fighter or Defender for a friend and protector?
Because they can teach you basic fighting skills and be there for you.
What can a Mage teach you?
A Mage can teach you magic, which is powerful but needs careful use.
What does the Hall of the Fallen remind us?
The Hall of the Fallen reminds us that everyone grows old.
Why can you live many floors up?
Because the blessing of height means you can live many floors up.

chapters.title: Exploring Your Floor and Beyond: Making the Most of Your Tower
lines: Always be kind, even to the people on the floors above or below you. They might be stronger or weaker, but kindness can make friends.
Helping others, like sharing your gear or giving them food, can make you feel good and make others happy.
Visit the market and the guilds often. You can find new friends and learn interesting things there.
When you see someone in trouble, offer to help them. Helping others is an important part of growing old well.
Go to the Hall of the Fallen to remember your friends who have passed on. Thinking of their bravery can inspire you.
Attend the annual festival on your floor. It's a great way to meet new people and celebrate life.
Participate in the Arena challenges. They are fun and can help you learn about yourself.
Join a guild or form your own group. Working together can make you stronger and more confident.
Explore the floors around yours. You might find hidden treasures or make new friends.
Be careful when you move to a new floor. Follow the laws of the Goddess carefully.
Learn the laws of the Tower. They can help you make good choices and avoid trouble.
Remember, the higher you go, the more you can grow. But always respect the rules of your floor.
Celebrate your birthdays and the birthdays of your friends. Sharing joy is important.
Be brave and adventurous. The world in the Tower is full of wonders and challenges.
Keep your spirit strong. No matter where you live, you can always make your life better.
qa: Why is it important to be kind to people on other floors?
Because kindness helps make friends and is good for the soul.
What can visiting the market and guilds do for you?
It can help you find new friends and learn new things.
How can helping others in trouble be good for you?
It can make you feel good and give you a sense of purpose.
What are some fun activities to do in the Tower?
Exploring, joining guilds, and participating in Arena challenges can be fun.

chapters.title: Strengthening Bonds: The Importance of Friends and Community
lines: In the Tower, friends are like allies in a quest, sharing your journey and adventures.
Think of your friends as a support system, just like the defenders protect the light in times of danger.
Joining guilds or forming your own group can be like having a family in the Tower, offering support and fun.
Helping a friend through the Arena can strengthen your bond, similar to how a defender protects others.
Celebrate the achievements of your friends just as you celebrate your own, it strengthens your bond.
Visiting friends on different floors can be an adventure, like going on a ranger’s hunt or a fighter’s quest.
When you help a friend, you both grow stronger, just like a mage and a priest casting a powerful spell together.
Sharing your stories and experiences with friends is like adding magic to your life, making it more colorful and exciting.
Visiting different floors and making friends with people from all walks of life can give you a broader perspective, like a mage learning from different sources of magic.
Remember, being kind and helping others, just like the healers in the Tower, will make your life richer and more fulfilling.
Even when you’re feeling down, talking to a friend, just like a priest comforting the injured, can brighten your day.
Learning from each other, whether it’s a new recipe from a cook or a clever strategy from a fighter, can make your life more interesting.
Supporting your friends in their goals and dreams, just as a defender would protect a castle, can make them stronger and more successful.
Lastly, always remember that in the Tower, you’re not just a character, you’re part of a community, and your strength is in your bonds.
Always look for opportunities to make new friends and strengthen old ones, it’s what makes life in the Tower a grand adventure.
qa: Why is it important to help friends in the Tower?
Helping friends makes your bond stronger and you both grow stronger.
How can visiting friends on different floors benefit you?
It can broaden your perspective and make your life more interesting.
What does being kind and helping others do for your life in the Tower?
It makes your life richer and more fulfilling.
Why should you always look for opportunities to make new friends?
It helps you build a stronger community and makes life in the Tower a grand adventure.

chapters.title: Embracing Wisdom: Becoming a Wise and Valued Member of Your Floor
lines: Wise people in the Tower are like wise old owls who know when to hoot in the night.
They listen carefully and learn from every monster hunt, every market trade, and every friendship.
On Floor 5, there’s a group who meet in the morning light to share stories of their adventures and challenges.
They might talk about a mage who once cast a spell to help a wounded priest, teaching everyone about courage and compassion.
During the evening, some floors host storytelling sessions where the tales of the strong and the brave are passed down to the young.
One such story tells of a defender who saved a fighter from a bandit attack, earning the fighter’s respect and gratitude.
These stories become part of the fabric of the Tower, helping everyone remember the importance of unity and support.
Just like the archers who protect the Tower with their arrows, wise people protect and support their friends and neighbors.
On Floor 10, a healer uses their wisdom to create potions that help the sick and injured, making everyone on the floor stronger and happier.
By sharing their knowledge, a ranger can teach a young adventurer about the best hunting grounds, helping them become a strong and skilled warrior.
A priest, with their wisdom, might advise someone on how to best use their strength to protect the Tower’s most vulnerable members.
Wisdom isn’t just about knowing how to cast spells or fight monsters; it’s about knowing when to listen, when to help, and when to lead by example.
On Floor 15, a group of friends who’ve been together for years decide to start a community garden, planting flowers and vegetables that everyone can enjoy.
This garden brings the floor together, teaching everyone the value of working together for a common goal.
Every day, the people of the Tower learn to respect each other, understanding that everyone has something to offer.
By the time you reach the age of 20 in the Tower, you will have grown into a wise and valued member of your community, just like the great heroes of old.
qa: How do wise people in the Tower help others?
By sharing their knowledge, supporting each other, and working together for common goals.
What does wisdom mean in the context of the Tower?
Wisdom means using knowledge to help others, make wise decisions, and foster unity.
Can you give an example of how wisdom is shown in the Tower?
A healer creating potions to help sick and injured people, showing both compassion and knowledge.
Why is it important to have a community in the Tower?
Because it helps everyone grow stronger and teaches the value of unity and support.

books.title: How to Keep a Promise
books.about: how to keep a promise
plan: Understanding Promises: A Bridge Between Words and Actions
The Power of Integrity: Why Keeping a Promise Matters
Building Trust: Keeping Promises in Everyday Life
Facing Challenges: What to Do When You Can't Keep a Promise
Celebrating Success: Honoring Your Word in the Light and Fury Worlds

chapters.title: Understanding Promises: A Bridge Between Words and Actions
lines: A promise is like a bridge that connects what you say with what you do.
It's like when mommy says she'll make cookies, and she really does.
If you promise to share your toy, you should do it when a friend comes over.
It's important because it shows others you can be trusted.
Remember, it's not just about toys or snacks, but about being true to what you say.
Even if you don't want to, keep your promise because it's the right thing to do.
Sometimes, you might forget, but that's okay, just try your best next time.
Like when you say you'll help clean up, and you do it even if you don't feel like it.
Promises can help make friends and make everyone happy.
It's like planting a seed and watching it grow into a big tree.
Keeping a promise is like putting a puzzle piece in the right spot.
Think about what you say before you say it, like checking if it fits in the puzzle.
It's a good habit to always try to keep your promises, just like always trying to clean up your room.
Promises are like a game you play with yourself, but it's always fun to win.
qa: What is a promise?
A promise is a commitment to do something.
Why are promises important?
Promises show others you can be trusted.
Can you give an example of a promise?
If you promise to help a friend with homework, you should do it.
What should you do if you forget a promise?
Try your best to keep it next time.

chapters.title: The Power of Integrity: Why Keeping a Promise Matters
lines: In Shaiya, when you make a promise, it's like playing a game with yourself. You promise to do something, and the game is to keep that promise.
Just like when you say you'll clean up your room, and you do it, you win the game. Winning this game makes you feel good, like when you get a gold star.
Keeping a promise also helps you become a better person, like how Shaiya's strongest people keep their promises to be a good example.
In Shaiya, everyone from the lowest floor to the highest floor makes promises to friends, family, and even to the goddess. They keep their promises to show their respect and trustworthiness.
For example, when a child promises to help their friend with homework, and they do it, they win the game of integrity.
A family might promise to have a picnic on the beach, and if they keep the promise, everyone will be happy and feel good about themselves.
A person might promise to protect their friends, and by keeping that promise, they become a defender in the community, like a real hero in Shaiya's tales.
When you keep a promise, you gain trust, like when you get a lapis stone that makes your gear stronger.
If you break a promise, like a person who says they'll help but doesn't, they might feel bad, and it's hard to win the game of integrity.
Keeping a promise in Shaiya is like having a magic shield that protects you and makes you stronger in the eyes of the goddess and the people around you.
Just like in Shaiya, where people visit each other's floors, keeping promises helps you make more friends and gain their trust.
If you always keep your promises, you'll be seen as a reliable and wise person, just like the priests in Shaiya who heal and give wisdom to others.
In Shaiya, the power of integrity is like a secret weapon that makes you stronger and better in every way, just like a powerful mage with enchanted gear.
qa: Why is it important to keep a promise?
It builds trust and makes you a reliable person.
What does keeping a promise do for you in Shaiya?
It makes you stronger and gives you better gear.
Can keeping a promise help you make friends?
Yes, it helps you gain trust and make more friends.
How does the goddess in Shaiya view people who keep their promises?
She views them as wise and reliable, often giving them the best gear and floors.

chapters.title: Building Trust: Keeping Promises in Everyday Life
lines: When you keep your promise to your friend to share your snacks, you show that you can be trusted.
Imagine you said you'd help your neighbor carry their groceries, and you do it with a smile.
At school, if you promise to do your homework, you must finish it on time.
In the morning, if you promise to wake up early for practice, you set your alarm and get there on time.
Once you promise to help a friend with a project, you work on it, even when you feel tired.
If you say you'll return a book, you keep it in good condition and bring it back on time.
During a game, if you say you won't cheat, you play fairly, even when the stakes are high.
At the park, if you say you'll meet up with your friends, you arrive there early to wait.
Your parents trust you more when you follow through on your chores, like feeding the pet or setting the table.
Keeping promises helps you build a strong friendship with your classmates.
When you keep your word, you earn the respect of your friends and teachers.
You become a leader in your group when you're always dependable.
Just like a mage in Shaiya who has enchanted gear, keeping your promises gives you a secret weapon in life.
Always keeping your promises is like having a magic shield that protects your reputation and friendships.
qa: What does keeping promises do for friendships?
Builds trust and strengthens friendships.
How does keeping promises help in school?
Earns the respect of teachers and improves academic performance.
Why is keeping promises important for leadership?
It makes you trustworthy and reliable, qualities needed for leadership.
What does keeping promises compare to in Shaiya?
It's like having enchanted gear that makes you stronger and better.

chapters.title: Facing Challenges: What to Do When You Can't Keep a Promise
lines: Even if it's hard, always try to explain why you can't keep your promise.
For example, if you promised to meet a friend for a game, but then you're sick and can't go.
Talk to your friend and explain, maybe you could help them with homework instead.
Or if you can't come, send a message saying you'll try the next time.
Sometimes, breaking a promise might be the right thing, but always be honest about it.
If you can't go to a friend's birthday party, be truthful and say you can't make it.
Be sure to offer an alternative, like planning a different day for the party.
Remember, breaking a promise without a good reason can hurt your friend's feelings.
If you're really struggling to keep a promise, think about why it's hard and if you can change anything.
For instance, if you're running late because of a traffic jam, try to leave earlier next time.
Sometimes, it's better to keep a smaller promise than to risk breaking a bigger one.
If you can't attend a soccer match, make sure to play another game with your friends the next day.
It's okay to be flexible as long as you keep your friend's trust.
If you're at the arena and can't keep a promise to meet a friend, explain to the arena guards.
They understand that sometimes unexpected things happen.
By being honest and explaining, you earn respect and trust from others.
qa: What should you do if you can't keep a promise?
Explain why you can't keep it.
How can you avoid breaking a promise?
Be flexible and plan ahead.
What should you do if breaking a promise is the best choice?
Always be honest about it.
Why is it important to keep a promise?
It builds trust and strengthens friendships.

chapters.title: Celebrating Success: Honoring Your Word in the Light and Fury Worlds
lines: In the Light and Fury worlds, keeping a promise means a lot to everyone.
When you make a promise to a friend, remember it's like a treasure you carry in your heart.
If you can't keep your promise, go to the arena and explain it to the guards.
They know that sometimes things change, and being honest is always better.
Imagine you promised your friend to meet at the market, but you got a really important letter.
Take the time to tell the guards about the letter and why you couldn't make it.
Sometimes, your friend might be a Warrior, and sometimes a Mage, but both will respect you for being honest.
Even if you can't meet your friend, you can still send them a gift or a message to let them know you cared.
On higher floors, where the air feels lighter, the strength of your promise feels stronger too.
Remember, keeping a promise makes your word more valuable than gold.
In the Tower, people live on different floors, but all promises are honored, no matter the height.
If you can't keep a promise, use the blessing of the higher floors to explain your situation to everyone.
Even if your promise isn't kept, the memory of it will make your heart grow stronger.
Keep your promises, for in the Light and Fury worlds, words mean everything.

books.title: How to Lose Well
books.about: how to lose well
plan: Understanding the Game
Good Sportsmanship
Celebrating Others' Success
Improving Yourself
Being a Good Friend

chapters.title: Understanding the Game
lines: In Shaiya, everyone plays to win, but sometimes you will lose, and that's okay.
It's like when you play a game with your friends and you don't win every time.
When you lose, it can feel sad, like when you drop your ice cream on the ground.
But remember, even if you lose, you can learn new things and try again next time.
Imagine you're in a big tower with many floors, and sometimes you move up to a higher floor.
On the higher floors, you get to use better magic and weapons, but you have to play really well to get there.
It's like getting a gold star for doing your homework really well.
Sometimes, even when you're playing, you might make a mistake, like forgetting to close your door and your toy gets lost.
That's okay! You can always find it later or buy a new one.
It's also good to be kind to your friends, even when you're upset because you lost.
For example, if your friend wins a game, you can still smile and say, 'Good job! Maybe next time I'll do better!'
Everyone is good at different things, and that's what makes the game fun and interesting for everyone.
So, when you lose, think of it as a chance to learn and grow.
It's like getting a sticker for trying hard and not giving up.
The most important thing is to always be a good sport, even when you're not winning.
qa: What can you learn from losing in Shaiya?
You can learn new things and try again next time.
Why is it important to be kind to friends after losing?
To keep the game fun and make friends want to play with you again.
What do you get for doing well in Shaiya?
A chance to learn and grow, and a sticker for trying hard.
How does moving to a higher floor in the tower help when you lose?
It gives you better magic and weapons, but you have to play well to get there.

chapters.title: Good Sportsmanship
lines: Being a good sport means always trying your best, even if you're not winning.
In Shaiya, when you play games, remember to cheer for everyone, not just your team.
If your friend makes a good move, say 'Good job!' and be happy for them.
Sometimes, the person who loses can learn more than the winner. Let's show them we're kind and understanding.
After a game, shake hands with the other players, even if you don't like them.
If you made a mistake, say 'Oops, I should have done better next time.' and mean it.
Watch how the strong and weak players on different floors of the Tower treat each other, they show great respect.
Remember, losing isn't the end. It's just a chance to try again and do better.
If you can't win, win the respect of your opponents by playing fair and smiling.
Even when you're losing, try to have fun. Play with your friends and enjoy the game.
Be patient with yourself and others. It takes time to learn and get better.
If you see someone having trouble, help them out. It doesn't matter if you're winning or losing.
In the Arena, show respect to the fighters and cheer for them, whether they win or lose.
By being a good sport, you make the game better for everyone and become a better person.
qa: What should you do if your friend makes a good move during a game?
Say 'Good job!' and be happy for them.
Why is it important to shake hands after a game?
It shows respect and good sportsmanship.
What can you learn from the strong and weak players on different floors?
They show respect to each other.
How can you have fun even if you're losing?
Play with your friends and enjoy the game.

chapters.title: Celebrating Others' Success
lines: When you see your friend get a new, shiny piece of gear in the market, congratulate them on their success.
Even if you're feeling sad that you didn't get a piece, smile and say, 'That looks great!'
At the grand festival, watch as the fighters compete in the Arena and cheer for them, no matter who wins.
If a Mage defeats a powerful Dragon, go up and shake their hand, saying 'Good fight!' even if you didn't win that day.
When a Priest heals a wounded Ranger, thank them for their hard work, even if they didn't get the loot you wanted.
In the Tower, if someone moves up a floor and gets a new home, give them a heartfelt 'Congratulations!' and a warm hug.
Even if you didn't get a prize in the hunt, be happy for the friends who did, and tell them, 'Good luck next time!'
At the Hall of the Fallen, remember the brave souls who fought and fell, and honor them by sharing stories of their bravery with others.
If a Defender saves a child from a monster, tell them, 'Thanks for keeping us safe!' and thank the child for their bravery too.
When a group of Rangers work together to defeat a big, tough Wolf, cheer for their teamwork, saying, 'You guys are amazing!' even if you're not part of that group.
Celebrate your friends' success in the game, and remind yourself that everyone can be good at something different.
By celebrating others' successes, you make your friends and the game more fun for everyone.
Every success is a step forward, and every step forward makes the world a better place.
Remember, the goal of the game is to have fun and grow together, not just to win everything.

chapters.title: Improving Yourself
lines: When you lose, it’s okay, but make sure to learn from it.
Think about what went wrong, but don’t get too upset.
Instead, focus on what you can do better next time.
Maybe you didn’t practice enough before the fight, so work on your skills.
Or, you might have picked the wrong class for the situation, so try something new.
The key is to keep trying and learning, not to give up.
Imagine you lost a battle but your friend learned a new magic spell; you should be happy for them.
You could even teach them something you know, making the game more fun for both of you.
Remember, the game is about having fun and growing together, just like in real life.
If you lose, you might notice a new friend joining your team, and that’s great too!
Every time you lose, you become a bit stronger and wiser.
Like when you lost a game but found a cool new weapon or armor piece.
Or, you might have a new friend who teaches you a trick you didn’t know before.
In the game, you can always choose to be a good sport, even when things don’t go your way.
So, the next time you lose, smile and say, ‘Great, I can improve! ’
qa: What should you do when you lose a game?
Learn from it and focus on what you can do better next time.
Why is it good to celebrate others' successes?
It makes the game more fun and everyone grows together.
What is a benefit of losing?
You become stronger and wiser each time.
How can you be a good sport when you lose?
Smile and say, ‘Great, I can improve!’

chapters.title: Being a Good Friend
lines: When you lose, remember that it’s okay to feel a little sad, but that doesn’t mean you can’t still be happy for your friend who won.
Think of a time when you won a game, and your friend lost. Instead of bragging, say, 'Good job, we should play again sometime!'
Losing teaches us to be better next time. Think about what you could do differently next time, and practice that in the next game.
Help your friend who lost. Maybe you can give them a high five or a hug to show you’re being a good sport.
In Shaiya, you might lose a battle against a monster, but that’s okay. You can still learn from it and try again.
Imagine you and your friend are in the Arena, and you both lose. After the match, you can both say, 'Wow, that was intense, let’s try again next time!'
Being a good friend means you can still be happy for your friend even if you lost. Like when your friend got a new pet in the game.
In the game, you might not get a powerful lapis stone, but that’s okay. It’s better to have fun and learn than to just have the best gear.
If you lose a game, don’t be mean to yourself. Instead, say, 'I can do better next time!'
When you see someone who lost, try to be kind. You could say, 'Good luck next time!'
Sometimes, even when you lose, you can find a new friend. Maybe they’ll teach you a new trick!
In Shaiya, the blessing of height can help you, but being a good sport can help you make friends. It’s important to be kind even when you lose.
After you lose a game, you can always think, 'This is how I’ll get better!'
Remember, being a good friend is about showing kindness, not just winning.
You can always choose to be a good sport, even when you lose. Smiling and saying, 'Great, I can improve!' is always a good way to go.
qa: What should you do when your friend wins a game?
Say 'Good job, we should play again sometime!'.
Why is it important to be kind to someone who lost?
Being kind helps build friendships and shows you’re a good sport.
How can losing help you?
Losing can teach you what to do differently next time and help you improve.
What is a sign of being a good sport?
Smiling and saying 'Great, I can improve!' after you lose.

books.title: How to Make a Decision
books.about: how to make a decision
plan: Understanding Your Choices
Using Your Strengths Wisely
Seeking Wisdom and Advice
Exploring the Blessing of Height
Taking Action and Learning from Decisions

chapters.title: Understanding Your Choices
lines: In Shaiya, you have to make many decisions every day, like what to wear or who to play with.
Sometimes it's hard to know what to do, but you can learn to make good choices.
First, you need to think about all your choices, like picking a game to play with your friends.
For example, if you want to play a game, you might choose between hide-and-seek or tag.
Next, think about which choice might be the best for you.
Maybe you choose tag because you like running and being active.
Think about what your friends might think of your choices too.
If you choose hide-and-seek, your friends might be happy because they like to hide.
Think about what might happen if you make each choice.
If you choose to wear your new armor, you might be ready for a big adventure in the Arena.
Remember, you can always change your mind and try another choice later.
Think about what you enjoy the most, like if you like to be the hunter or the runner.
Sometimes, you might need to share your toys or take turns with your friends.
It's good to be kind and fair when you make choices about sharing.
Finally, always remember that it's okay to ask for help if you're not sure what to do.
qa: What are two choices a child might make when deciding what game to play?
hide-and-seek or tag.
How can you think about other people when making choices?
Think about what your friends might think of your choices.
What is an example of a choice that could affect how you feel?
Choosing to wear your new armor for an adventure in the Arena.
Why is it important to ask for help when making a decision?
It's okay to ask for help if you're not sure what to do.

chapters.title: Using Your Strengths Wisely
lines: Let's imagine you are a Fighter, strong and good at fighting with two-handed weapons.
When you decide to go to the Arena, think about what you are good at first.
You have more strength, so you can probably beat the other kids there.
But remember, it's not just about winning - sometimes it's better to play friendly games with your friends.
Also, if you're new to the Arena and scared, don't be afraid to ask a Defender for help.
Defenders are strong and good at protecting others, so they might help you.
If you're a Mage and want to enchant your gear, think about how much strength you have first.
Mages need a lot of magic, so if you're not very strong, maybe find a way to share your magic with others.
A Priest can use their healing magic to help others, so remember to always be kind.
If you're a Ranger, you can use your speed and agility to quickly move around the Tower.
But don't forget to use your strength when you need to defend yourself or others.
Sometimes, sharing your speed can help you escape from danger, so practice moving quickly.
If you're a Defender, use your shield and armor to protect yourself and others.
Think about when it's best to use your shield to protect yourself, and when it's better to help a friend who is in danger.
A Priest's healing magic can save lives, so always try to use it to help others when you can.
And a Mage's magic can do amazing things, but you need to be strong enough to handle it properly.
Remember, using your strengths wisely means knowing when to use them and when to help others.
qa: Why is it important to think about your strengths when making decisions?
To use them wisely and effectively.
Can you give an example of when a Mage should share their magic?
When a friend is in danger and needs help but doesn't have as much magic.
What does a Defender use to protect themselves and others?
A shield and armor.
Why is it important for a Priest to always try to help others with their healing magic?
Because healing others can save lives and make a difference.

chapters.title: Seeking Wisdom and Advice
lines: Always talk to your parents or teachers when you have a big decision to make, they can give you good advice.
Sometimes, you might feel unsure, but talking about your feelings can help you understand what you want.
If you're not sure what to do, you can ask your friends for their opinions too.
Remember, everyone has their own thoughts and feelings, so listen carefully to what others say.
A Mage can use their magic to light up dark areas, just like when you ask for help to understand something tricky.
A Priest can heal when you're sick, like when someone in your class is feeling unwell and needs help.
Just like a Mage uses magic, you can use your knowledge to help solve problems, like figuring out the best way to arrange your toys.
A Defender is good at protecting, like when you're playing and need to stop the ball from going out of bounds.
A Ranger can move fast and stay hidden, like when you're playing hide and seek and want to find a good spot.
A Fighter can be strong, like when you're playing games and need to be tough.
A Priest can teach you to be patient, like when you're waiting for your turn to play.
A Mage can teach you to be curious, like when you're exploring new ideas and places.
Everyone can learn from each other, just like how you can learn from a Mage about magic and from a Priest about healing.
Always be kind, like when you share your snacks with friends during lunchtime.
Kindness and wisdom help make good decisions, like choosing to be nice to others and helping them when they need it.
qa: What can you ask when you're unsure about a decision?
Your parents or teachers.
How can a Mage's magic help you make a decision?
By teaching you to think clearly and solve problems.
What can a Priest teach you to help you make decisions?
To be patient and consider others' feelings.
How can asking friends for their opinions help you?
It gives you more ideas and can help you see different points of view.

chapters.title: Exploring the Blessing of Height
lines: The higher you live in the Tower, the better it is for linking and enchanting your gear.
Imagine you have a magic stone that can make your sword stronger. Living higher in the Tower makes it more likely that your stone will work perfectly.
Your enchanted gear will also last longer as you live higher up, just like a toy that lasts longer when it's not stepped on.
If you live on the 15th floor, your enchanted items have a 36% better chance of working perfectly, compared to someone living on the 1st floor.
Living on the 5th floor gives you a 5% better chance of making perfect enchantments, like turning a stone into a shiny new gear.
It's like living on the 10th floor gives you a small helper that makes your gear stronger every time you try to enchant it.
Your gear also lasts 5% longer, so you don't have to keep replacing it as often, like when your favorite crayon lasts a bit longer each time you use it.
Even if you're not very strong, living higher in the Tower can still help you make your gear better, but not as much as the strongest people.
So, if you're thinking about moving to a higher floor, remember it can help your gear get stronger and last longer.
It's like moving to the 2nd floor from the 1st floor could help your gear get a little bit stronger, but not as much as moving from the 1st to the 2nd floor would help the strongest people.
Remember, the blessing of height is not the only thing that matters, being kind and wise are also very important.
If you're kind to others and use your wisdom, you can make great friends and have lots of fun, just like playing with your friends during lunchtime.
Sometimes, the blessing of height can help you make your gear better, but it's not as important as being a good friend and using your wisdom to make good choices.
If you want to make your gear stronger, moving to a higher floor can help, but remember to always be kind and wise, just like sharing your snacks with friends during lunchtime.
Kindness and wisdom will help you make the best decisions, like choosing to be nice to others and helping them when they need it.
qa: Why is living on a higher floor in the Tower better for enchanting gear?
Living on a higher floor gives a better chance of perfect enchantments and longer-lasting gear.
How much better is the chance of perfect enchantments on the 5th floor compared to the 1st floor?
It's 5% better on the 5th floor compared to the 1st floor.
Can the blessing of height help everyone make their gear stronger, or only the strongest people?
The blessing of height can help everyone, but the strongest people benefit more.
What should you remember when thinking about moving to a higher floor in the Tower?
You should remember to be kind and wise, just like sharing snacks with friends during lunchtime.

chapters.title: Taking Action and Learning from Decisions
lines: When you make a decision, remember to always think about others first.
Sharing your toys with a friend can show you the joy of kindness.
Sometimes, it’s better to give up your turn to let a friend have fun.
If you choose to help your friend with their homework, you might learn something too.
Learning from others is as important as learning from your own decisions.
When you face a tough decision, take a moment to breathe and think.
Deciding to be patient and wait for your turn can help others feel better too.
If you decide to clean up your room, you might find hidden treasures like a toy you thought you lost.
Making a decision to be honest, even when it’s hard, can make you feel proud.
Deciding to share a story with someone who seems sad can brighten their day.
Choosing to read a book about kindness can help you learn more about making good choices.
Every decision you make teaches you something new about yourself and the world.
Remember, the best decisions are often the ones that make others happy too.
If you decide to say ‘thank you’ to someone who helped you, it can make both of you feel good.
Always be brave to make decisions that are right for you, but don’t forget to be considerate of others.
qa: What is an example of a decision that shows kindness?
Sharing your toys with a friend.
What can sharing a story with someone who is sad teach you?
It can brighten their day.
Why is it important to be honest, even when it’s hard?
It can make you feel proud.
How can deciding to say 'thank you' to someone who helped you make both of you feel?
Good.

books.title: How to Plan a Journey
books.about: how to plan a journey
plan: Understanding Your Travel Purpose
Packing Your Backpack Wisely
Exploring Floors and Making New Friends
Navigating the Arena and Challenges
Celebrating Success and Returning Home

chapters.title: Understanding Your Travel Purpose
lines: When you go on a journey, you need to think about why you are going.
Maybe you want to visit your grandma or uncle.
Or you might want to see new places and learn about them.
Sometimes, you might just want to have fun!
Always remember to bring your backpack with snacks and toys.
Check the weather to make sure you have the right clothes.
It’s a good idea to pack a map or download one on your phone.
Tell your parents or guardians where you’re going and when you’ll be back.
Write down the addresses or names of places you want to visit.
It’s fun to make a list of things you want to do or see on your trip.
Ask a grown-up to help you check if you need a special book for your journey.
