For a trip to the beach, don’t forget your swimsuit and sunscreen!
If you’re going to the mountains, make sure you have warm clothes.
A travel book can be helpful, like a book about the places you are visiting.
Always be prepared, but also ready for surprises!
qa: Why is it important to think about your travel purpose?
It helps you plan what to bring and what to do on your trip.
What are some examples of reasons to go on a journey?
Visiting family, seeing new places, or having fun.
What should you tell your guardians before going on a trip?
Where you are going and when you will be back.
Is it a good idea to make a list of things you want to do or see?
Yes, it helps you remember and plan your activities.

chapters.title: Packing Your Backpack Wisely
lines: Your backpack is like a magic bag that holds all your treasures for the journey.
First, you need to think about what you will need, just like when you're picking out clothes for different weather.
Pack your most important things first, like your favorite snacks and toys.
Remember to bring a map or a guidebook, it’s like having a treasure map to your adventure.
Don’t forget your comfy sleeping bag or blanket, it’s important to have a good night’s sleep.
Bring some snacks, like fruits or granola bars, so you won’t get hungry on your journey.
Pack some books or a drawing pad, you never know when you will find a quiet spot to rest and read or draw.
Don’t forget your water bottle, staying hydrated is very important, just like drinking water to keep your body healthy.
Check the weather before you go, like checking the sky for clouds, so you can pack the right clothes.
If you’re going to visit friends, bring small presents or treats to share.
A small first-aid kit can be helpful, like having band-aids for little boo-boos.
Bring a camera or a journal, to record your adventure and make memories.
Lastly, always have a change of clothes, like a spare shirt or pants, just in case.
Be sure to check if your backpack has enough space for all your items before you close it.

chapters.title: Exploring Floors and Making New Friends
lines: When you visit a new floor, remember to introduce yourself and ask about the local heroes and stories.
You might make a friend who can show you shortcuts and secret places.
Sometimes, you can exchange gifts or stories with your new friends to learn more about their floor.
Be sure to find out if your new friends have any skills you could learn, like crafting or fighting.
Sharing meals and stories can help you bond with your new friends and make your stay more enjoyable.
Remember to keep an eye out for friendly faces, like the local guards or helpful merchants.
Don't be afraid to join in community events, like festivals or training sessions.
You might find new friends who can teach you about the history or magic of your floor.
Exploring together can be more fun and safer than going alone.
If you find a friend who is stronger than you, ask them to train you or give you tips.
You might learn about different jobs, like a blacksmith or a healer, and consider trying them out.
If you meet someone you really like, you could ask them to visit you on your floor.
Always be kind and respectful to everyone you meet, no matter where you are.
Make sure you leave a little space in your backpack for souvenirs or gifts you might bring back.
qa: What should you do when you meet someone new on a different floor?
Introduce yourself and ask about the local heroes and stories.
Why is it important to share meals and stories with new friends?
Sharing meals and stories can help you bond with your new friends and make your stay more enjoyable.
What can you do if you find a friend who is stronger than you?
Ask them to train you or give you tips.
Why is it important to be kind and respectful to everyone you meet?
Always be kind and respectful to everyone you meet, no matter where you are.

chapters.title: Navigating the Arena and Challenges
lines: When you go to the Arena, always be brave and respectful.
Remember, the Arena is a place where friends and enemies meet.
You might face challenges like the Ranger or the Archer.
Or even a Mage who can cast spells from afar.
Sometimes, you might need to fight the Priest for healing magic.
It's okay to feel scared, but take deep breaths and stay calm.
Listen carefully to the rules before the fight starts.
If you're stronger than the other fighter, you might win easily.
But if you're weaker, try to use your skills wisely.
Bring your best weapon and some lapis stones for enchanting.
Don't forget to use your strategy and quick thinking.
If you win, you can gain new friends or allies.
If you lose, try to learn from the experience and stay kind.
After the fight, don't forget to give the winner a gift.
Share your stories with your friends and family when you return.
qa: What should you do if you're scared in the Arena?
Take deep breaths and stay calm.
Why is it important to listen to the rules before a fight?
To understand how to play safely and fairly.
What can you bring to the Arena to help you?
A weapon and lapis stones for enchanting.
What should you do after a fight, whether you win or lose?
Share your stories with friends and family.

chapters.title: Celebrating Success and Returning Home
lines: Now, it's time to celebrate your adventure, child.
Think of the gifts you promised to give, whether it’s a book, a toy, or a sweet treat.
Share the exciting stories of your journey with your family and friends.
Show them the new gear you found, maybe a shiny dagger or a rare lapis stone.
Talk about the monsters you faced and the challenges you overcame.
Maybe you even met new friends on your journey, make sure to tell them their names.
Remember to visit the market and sell any extra items you collected during your adventure.
Use the money you earned to buy something special for your family or a friend.
Write down the stories in a diary, it’s a great way to remember your journey.
Tell your parents about the Hall of the Fallen, maybe you want to visit it together.
Take the time to thank the goddess for the chance to adventure and learn.
Before you go to bed, make a plan for your next adventure, and where you will explore next.
Remember, every journey brings back memories, keep them close to your heart.
And most importantly, share the joy of your journey with everyone you love.
qa: What can you share with your family and friends after your adventure?
Stories and items from your journey.
What should you do with the extra items from your adventure?
Sell them at the market.
How can you remember your adventure?
By writing stories in a diary.
What should you do before going to bed after your adventure?
Make a plan for the next adventure.

books.title: How to Read a Map
books.about: how to read a map
plan: Introduction to the Map World
Understanding Your Location: The Tower Floors
Reading the Map: Symbols and Icons
Navigating the Tower: Moving Up and Down
Fun with Maps: Using the Arena Map

chapters.title: Introduction to the Map World
lines: Welcome to the magical world of maps, where every line and shape tells a story.
Imagine a land called Shaiya, where heroes live in tall Towers.
Each Tower has 20 floors, and people live on different floors, sometimes with their families.
The higher you live, the richer the monsters, but also the better gear you can get.
On the first floor, you can enchant your gear to +20, which is really powerful!
But if you live on the fourth floor, you can only enchant to +8, so it’s a bit less magical.
You can move floors to see your friends or to try a new job, but it’s important to return home.
Every floor above the bottom floor makes your gear and life a little better.
People can go to the Arena to have a friendly or not-so-friendly match with another citizen.
There’s also a place called the Hall of the Fallen, where people go to say goodbye to those who have passed on.
The market is where you can buy and sell your gear and treasures, and it’s a place to meet new friends.
Remember, the Goddess blesses the higher floors, so living up high can be very special.
Now that you know about the floors and what they mean, you’re ready to explore the map of Shaiya.
qa: What are the floors in the Towers like?
Floors vary in enchantment and gear power.
How does living on a higher floor affect your gear and life?
Each floor above the lowest makes linking and enchanting succeed 1% more often and lives last 1% longer.
What can you do in the Arena?
You can summon citizens to fight in the Arena.

chapters.title: Understanding Your Location: The Tower Floors
lines: In Shaiya, we live in towers that have 20 floors, like a big castle in the sky!
Each floor is like a special level, and we can move between them when we want to visit friends.
The floors are numbered from 1 to 20, with 1 being the lowest and 20 the highest.
The Goddess gives us more luck and longer lives the higher we go, so people like to live on the top floors.
On the first three floors, you can use magic to make your gear even stronger, but it’s harder on the higher floors.
The higher floors have the best monsters to hunt, so people earn more gold there.
But be careful, the monsters are tougher too, so you need to be strong to go up high.
On floors 1-3, you can sell your best things, but on floors 4-20, only the not-so-special things can be sold.
If you can’t sell something, it goes to a big auction where it might get a new home.
The strongest person in the whole tower lives on floor 1, and they and their family are very special.
Each floor is a little better for linking and enchanting, so living up high is like having a secret superpower.
Remember, you can move to a different floor if you want to try something new or visit friends.
The market is a fun place to meet people and trade your gear, and it’s always open to all floors.
Always be kind and share your treasures with others, and who knows, maybe you’ll make a great friend!
qa: What do the floors in Shaiya’s towers mean?
Each floor is like a special level, and people can move between them.
Why do people like to live on the higher floors?
Because the Goddess blesses the higher floors with more luck and longer lives.
How does the market in Shaiya work?
The market is where you can buy and sell your gear and treasures, and it’s a place to meet new friends.
What happens to items that can’t be sold?
If you can’t sell something, it goes to a big auction where it might get a new home.

chapters.title: Reading the Map: Symbols and Icons
lines: On a map, symbols and icons help us understand what's where.
For example, a house looks like a little house, a tree like a tiny tree.
A river is a wiggly line, and a mountain is a triangle pointing up.
The Tower of the twenty floors is marked by a big tower shape, with floors numbered on it.
Different colors mean different things - blue for water, green for forests, and brown for mountains.
A circle with a cross in the middle shows the market where you can buy and sell things.
A cross with a shield is where you can find the best gear and enchant your stuff.
A shield with a sword means the area is for the strongest adventurers.
The Goddess and her followers are shown with symbols like a glowing star or a crescent moon.
Each floor of the Tower is marked with a number to help you find your way.
An exclamation mark above a number means there are lots of monsters to fight.
A heart symbol shows where you can find healing herbs or a friendly priest.
A house with a door is where you can find your guild, and your friends might live there too.
Always look for these symbols to find what you need or want on your adventure.
qa: What do symbols like a house and a tree represent on the map?
A house looks like a little house, a tree like a tiny tree.
How are different terrains shown on the map?
Different colors mean different things - blue for water, green for forests, and brown for mountains.
What symbol indicates the market on the map?
A circle with a cross in the middle shows the market where you can buy and sell things.
How can you find a friendly priest to heal?
A heart symbol shows where you can find healing herbs or a friendly priest.

chapters.title: Navigating the Tower: Moving Up and Down
lines: The Tower is a big, tall building with many floors, like a giant house in the sky.
Each floor is like a separate world, with its own dangers and rewards.
To move up or down, you need to use the stairs in the center of the Tower.
The stairs are tricky, so always be careful and watch your steps.
Sometimes, you might meet someone on the stairs who can help you find your way.
You can go to any floor, but remember, the higher you go, the harder the monsters are.
On the first floor, you can find many friends and guild halls, so it’s a good place to start.
The higher you go, the better the monsters drop, but also, the harder they are to beat.
On the 20th floor, it’s quiet, and you might find special treasures from the Goddess.
If you need to sell your items, you can find a market on the 1st and 2nd floors.
Remember, each floor gives you a little more strength, so keep going up to feel stronger.
If you get lost, look for a heart symbol, which shows a healing spot or a friendly priest.
Always keep your map to find your way, and use the stairs to travel between floors.
The Tower is full of adventures, so keep exploring and you might find something amazing!
qa: What are the stairs used for in the Tower?
To move up and down the floors.
Where can you find a friendly priest?
At a heart symbol.
Which floor is the best for selling items?
The 1st and 2nd floors.
How does going up the floors affect you?
Each floor gives a little more strength.

chapters.title: Fun with Maps: Using the Arena Map
lines: In the Tower, there’s a special map just for the Arena where brave warriors fight.
The map shows all the arenas, and you can see your friends and rivals.
Sometimes, the map shows a new arena with a different challenge.
You can also see where the strongest warriors are, so you can try to beat them.
The map helps you choose the arena that’s right for you.
Remember to always have a map with you, even when you’re in the Arena.
If you lose, don’t worry! You can always use the map to find your way back.
Sometimes, the map shows where the best gear is, so you can find it easily.
You can also see where the lapis stones are, so you can use them to make your gear even stronger.
The map is like a guide, showing you the way to the best adventures.
Use the map to plan your challenges and to see where the next arena is.
When you’re playing, always look at the map to see where you are.
The map can show you how to get stronger, by showing you where to find better gear.
It’s fun to use the map to plan your next adventure and to see where you can go next.
qa: What does the map show in the Arena?
It shows all the arenas, where you can see your friends and rivals.
How can the map help you when you lose?
You can use it to find your way back.
Can the map show you where to find lapis stones?
Yes, it can show you where the lapis stones are.
What can the map help you with in the Tower?
The map can show you the way to the best adventures, where to find better gear, and how to get stronger.

books.title: How to Say No
books.about: how to say no
plan: Understanding Your Feelings
The Power of a Firm No
Why Saying No is Important
Saying No Politely but Firmly
Practice Makes Perfect: Role-Playing Scenarios

chapters.title: Understanding Your Feelings
lines: In Shaiya, sometimes you have to say no to things you don't want to do.
Maybe your friend wants you to play a game you don't like.
If you say no, it's okay, and that's perfectly fine.
You can say, 'No, I don't want to play that game.', and that's alright.
If someone asks you to do something dangerous, it's important to say no.
Like if a friend wants you to climb a tall tree without an adult around.
Saying no to risky things keeps you safe.
You can also say no if you're not interested in something, like if someone asks you to watch a TV show you don't like.
Sometimes, saying no is hard, but it's good for you to learn how to do it.
Your feelings are important, and you should listen to them when you're deciding what to do.
For example, if someone asks you to stay up late to watch a movie, but you feel tired, you can say no.
It's okay to feel tired and to need rest.
You can always say, 'I'm tired, I don't want to stay up late right now.'
Remember, it's always okay to say no to things that make you feel bad or uncomfortable.
By understanding your feelings, you can make better choices about what you do and don't do.
qa: Why is it important to understand your feelings?
It helps you make good choices.
What should you do if someone asks you to do something risky?
Say no and stay safe.
Can you give an example of when it's okay to say no?
Yes, if a friend asks you to do something you're not comfortable with.
What should you do if you're tired and asked to do something?
Say no and go to sleep.

chapters.title: The Power of a Firm No
lines: When you feel uncomfortable, it's important to stand up for yourself.
For example, if your friend asks you to join a game you don't like, you can say, 'No, thanks, I'd rather read my book right now.'
It's like choosing to wear a warm coat when it's cold, it's better for you.
Sometimes, you might say no to play a game that's too hard for you.
Even if your friend gets upset, remember it's okay to choose what's best for you.
If someone asks you to do something you know is wrong, like break a rule, say 'No' firmly and walk away.
A firm no means you mean it, not just 'maybe' or 'later'.
Imagine if you're playing a game and don't want to do a part that's scary; it's okay to say no and not do it.
Sometimes, saying no can make you feel brave and strong.
It's not about pleasing everyone, it's about staying true to yourself.
Saying no can help you make better choices that lead to a happier life.
If you're scared, it's okay to say no to things that make you feel scared.
Remember, everyone has times when they want to say yes, but it's important to be honest with yourself.
Saying no is a skill, like tying your shoes, and the more you practice, the easier it gets.
Even if it feels hard at first, the more you say no, the more you'll feel good about it.
qa: Why is it okay to say no when something makes you feel bad or uncomfortable?
Because it helps you make better choices and stay true to yourself.
What should you do if someone asks you to do something you know is wrong?
Say 'No' firmly and walk away.
Can saying no to things that scare you be good for you?
Yes, it can help you feel brave and make better choices.
How does saying no help you make better choices?
It helps you stay true to yourself and choose things that make you happy.

chapters.title: Why Saying No is Important
lines: Saying no is like setting your own boundaries, just like how you decide which toys to play with and which to leave alone.
When your friend invites you to a party you're not interested in, saying no means you stick to what makes you happy.
Maybe you have to do homework, but someone wants you to go play. Saying no helps you focus on what you need to do.
Sometimes, your parents ask if you want to try new foods. If you say no, it's okay to try something different another time.
Saying no can also mean not joining in when others are doing something you're not comfortable with, like making a mess or breaking rules.
At school, if someone tries to take your favorite pencil, you can say no and keep it safe for yourself.
In a game, if someone wants to change the rules, you can say no and keep the game fair for everyone.
Saying no to extra chores can give you more time to do what you want, like reading or playing outside.
It's not always about being stubborn. Saying no can also be about protecting yourself from things that might harm you.
Remember, it's okay to say no, even if it means disappointing others. It's better to be honest than to pretend.
Saying no helps you become more confident, like when you tell someone you don't want to go to a party that bores you.
Sometimes, saying no means protecting your friends from doing something dangerous, like when someone wants to go swimming without a grown-up.
Learning to say no can help you make better choices, like choosing to eat healthy snacks instead of sweets all the time.
Saying no can also be about staying true to your values, like not cheating on a test or telling a fib.
Every time you say no, you're learning about what matters to you and becoming a stronger person.
qa: Why is saying no important for a child?
It helps them set boundaries and make good choices.
Can saying no ever protect someone?
Yes, it can protect them from harmful situations.
How does saying no make a child more confident?
It helps them stand up for themselves and make choices that are true to them.
What does saying no teach a child about values?
It teaches them to stay true to what they believe is right.

chapters.title: Saying No Politely but Firmly
lines: When someone asks you to do something you don't want to do, you can say no politely but firmly.
For example, if a friend invites you to play a game you don't like, you can say, 'Thanks for inviting me, but I'd rather play something else.'
Sometimes, you might need more time to think, so you can say, 'I need some time to think about it and will get back to you later.'
Another example is when someone asks you to share a toy you don't want to share, you can say, 'I appreciate you asking, but I'd rather keep playing with this toy.'
Remember, it's okay to say no to someone you care about, and they should respect your choice.
For instance, if your brother wants you to help with his homework when you have your own to do, you can say, 'I'm sorry, but I need to focus on my own work right now.'
If someone insists on something, it's alright to say, 'No, but I can explain why I can't do it now.'
Say, 'No, I can't go to the movies today, but maybe we can do something else together later.'
Being firm about your decision can also mean, 'No, I don't want to stay up late tonight, and I need my sleep.'
Always be honest when you say no, even if the reason is personal.
Like, 'No, I'd rather not talk about that right now, and I'll tell you more when I'm ready.'
It's okay to apologize if you think your no might hurt someone's feelings, but you don't need to change your mind.
For example, 'I'm sorry, but I really need to go. Can we talk about this later?'
Sometimes, you might need to give a reason, but it's okay to be brief.
Like, 'I'm not comfortable with that, so I'll have to say no.'
qa: Can you give an example of saying no to a friend?
'Thanks for inviting me, but I'd rather play something else.'
How can you handle it when someone insists on something?
Say, 'No, but I can explain why I can't do it now.'
What's important when you're honest about saying no?
Always be honest even if the reason is personal.
Is it necessary to change your mind if you say no to someone?
No, it's okay to stick to your decision if it's something you truly don't want to do.

chapters.title: Practice Makes Perfect: Role-Playing Scenarios
lines: Let's pretend you're playing with your friends and one of them wants you to try a snack they brought from home.
You know you don't want to eat it, but you're not sure how to say no.
Close your eyes and imagine you're on Floor 6 of the Tower.
You can say, 'Thank you for sharing, but I'm not hungry right now.'
Or, 'No thanks, I don't think I'll try that.'
Remember, it's okay to say no, and you don't have to give a reason if you don't want to.
Now, let's pretend a friend asks you to play a game you're not interested in.
You can say, 'Thanks for inviting me, but I'd rather play something else.'
If you feel a bit uncomfortable, you could say, 'I'm not feeling that game right now.'
Try imagining you're on a higher floor, where you might feel more confident.
In the Arena, you might face someone who wants to challenge you, but you're not ready.
You can confidently say, 'I need to focus on my training right now. Let's meet later.'
Or, 'I'm not ready for a fight right now, but I appreciate the invitation.'
Remember, saying no is a skill, and the more you practice, the better you'll get.
Practice saying no with your family or toys in your room, imagining different situations.
The more you practice, the more confident you'll become in real life.
qa: What can you say when you're offered a snack you don't want?
I'm not hungry right now.
How should you respond if asked to play a game you're not interested in?
I'm not feeling that game right now.
In what way can you practice saying no?
With family or toys in your room.
Why is it important to practice saying no?
To become more confident in real life.

books.title: How to Settle a Quarrel
books.about: how to settle a quarrel
plan: Understanding Feelings and Respecting Others
Using the Five Elements to Communicate Peacefully
The Magic of Listening: A Two-Way Street
Creating Solutions Together: A Team Effort
Playing Fair in the Arena: Lessons in Fair Play

chapters.title: Understanding Feelings and Respecting Others
lines: In Shaiya, when you and your friend have a quarrel, it's important to understand why you feel upset.
Maybe you feel like your friend took your toy without asking, or they didn't share their snacks.
When you feel upset, it's okay to tell your friend how you feel.
You might say, 'I feel sad when you take my things without asking.'
It's also good to listen to your friend and understand their feelings too.
Maybe your friend feels like you always choose games you like and they don't get to choose.
When you understand each other, you can find a way to make things better.
For example, you could both decide to take turns picking the game.
Another idea is to find a new game that both of you enjoy.
It's important to respect your friend's feelings and choices.
Sometimes, your friend might want to play alone and that's okay too.
If you agree to disagree, you can still be friends.
Always try to be kind and fair when talking to your friend.
Remember, the Tower of Shaiya is a place where everyone should be respected and valued.
qa: Why is it important to understand feelings when settling a quarrel?
To find a way to make things better.
What should you do if you feel upset with your friend?
Tell your friend how you feel.
Can you give an example of finding a compromise when settling a quarrel?
Yes, you could both decide to take turns picking the game.
How does respecting your friend's feelings help in settling a quarrel?
It helps in finding a fair and kind solution.

chapters.title: Using the Five Elements to Communicate Peacefully
lines: In Shaiya, there are five elements to help us talk peacefully - Earth, Water, Fire, Air, and Spirit.
Earth is about listening and understanding.
For example, imagine you and your friend disagree about which game to play.
You take a moment to listen carefully, and then you ask why they want to play that game.
Water is like sharing and helping each other.
Like when you both want to share a toy, you might give it a turn each.
Fire is about being brave and standing up for what is right.
For instance, if someone is being mean to your friend, you can bravely tell them to stop.
Air is like thinking and planning before you speak.
Before you say something, take a deep breath and think about how it will make others feel.
Spirit is about being kind and showing love.
When you and your friend are happy, you can share that happiness with a big smile and a hug.
Remember, these elements can be used in many ways, like a puzzle that fits together.
In the Tower, some floors have special places where you can learn about these elements.
On Floor 3, you might find a friendly Mage teaching you about the Water element.
On Floor 5, a wise Defender might help you understand the Air element.
Even if you are not on the right floor, you can still use these elements to make peace.
Always try to use the elements to find a peaceful solution, like a rainbow after a rainstorm.
You can teach your friends about the elements too, and together you can make the Tower a peaceful place.
The Goddess would be very proud of you for using the elements to solve quarrels.
qa: What is the first element of peaceful communication?
Earth
What does the Earth element teach us to do?
To listen and understand.
Can you give an example of the Fire element in action?
Being brave and standing up for what is right, like telling someone to stop being mean.
On which floor might you find a Mage teaching about the Water element?
Floor 3

chapters.title: The Magic of Listening: A Two-Way Street
lines: Once a quarrel starts, it's like a storm in the Tower. But just like a storm, it can pass and a calm can follow.
Listen to your friend first, just like you would hear the wind before the rain.
When you listen, you can understand why they are upset, just like you understand why the leaves rustle in the breeze.
Maybe they lost a shiny lapis stone in the fight, or maybe they were just scared to be alone.
Once you know why they are upset, it's easier to find a way to make peace.
It's like when you and your friend decide to share a toy instead of fighting over it.
Sometimes, a hug can make things better, like when the sun comes out after the rain.
Sometimes, it's better to take a break, just like you might go inside when the rain gets too heavy.
Talking about your feelings is like sharing a story, it can make both of you feel better.
When you share your feelings, you might find out that you have the same favorite flower, like when you discover your friend likes the same book you do.
Then, you can work together to solve the problem, just like you and your friend can build a bigger sandcastle together.
Remember, listening is like magic; it can turn a storm into a calm day.
Always remember to listen to others, just like you would listen to the teachers in the Tower.
If you can make your friends listen too, you can make the whole Tower a peaceful place.
The Goddess would be very proud of you for using the listening magic to solve quarrels.
qa: What does the author compare a quarrel to?
a storm
Why is it important to listen to your friend first?
To understand why they are upset
What can happen when you share your feelings?
You might find out you have the same favorite things
What does the author say the Goddess would be proud of you for doing?
Using the listening magic to solve quarrels

chapters.title: Creating Solutions Together: A Team Effort
lines: When you and your friend are having a fight, ask each other what the problem is, just like talking to a teacher.
Say, 'I see you're sad. Can you tell me why?' to your friend.
Listen carefully to what your friend says, just as you listen to the teacher's explanations.
If your friend talks about a toy, ask, 'Do you really want that toy? Why is it important to you?'
Then, think about your friend's feelings, and say, 'I understand you want the toy because you like playing with it.'
After you've listened, share your feelings too, like, 'I really want to play with my toy too. Can we find a way to share?'
Together, maybe you could play with the toy for a while, then pass it to your friend.
Or, you could find a different toy that both of you like.
Always remember, there's usually a way to solve the problem if you talk about it together.
One day, your friend might even help you solve a problem too!
In the Tower, people solve many problems by talking and listening together.
So, practice solving problems by talking, and you'll make the Tower a happier place.
Use the listening magic you learned to help your friends, and the Goddess will be happy!
If everyone in the Tower used this magic, we could have the best Tower ever!
Practice makes perfect, so keep listening and finding solutions together.
qa: How do you start a conversation to solve a problem?
By asking, 'What's the problem?' or 'Why are you upset?'.
What should you do after listening to your friend?
Share your feelings too, using 'I' statements like 'I feel...'.

chapters.title: Playing Fair in the Arena: Lessons in Fair Play
lines: In the Arena, it's important to play fair and be true to your promise.
When you're in the Arena, remember to only use the abilities you've earned.
If you're a Fighter, stick to two-handed weapons and use your strength.
Defenders should only use their shield and armor to protect others.
Rangers and Archers must only use their daggers and bows, no magic or extra gear.
Mages can use magic, but only the ones they've learned and practiced.
Priests can heal, but only those in the arena who ask for help.
If you're stronger, help the weaker citizen; that's the spirit of the Arena.
In the Arena, you should not use your abilities outside of it.
Be kind and respectful, even when the fight is over.
If someone wins, they should be congratulated and respected, no matter who it is.
Never cheat in the Arena; it ruins the game for everyone.
Always remember that the Goddess watches over the Arena and values fairness.
Practice your skills in the Arena to be the best citizen you can be.
Help your friends find solutions and be fair in the Arena, and the Goddess will be proud.
qa: What should citizens do in the Arena to play fair?
Only use their earned abilities and be respectful.
Can Mages use any magic in the Arena?
No, only the magic they've learned and practiced.
How should citizens act after a fight in the Arena?
They should be kind, respectful, and congratulate the winner.
Why is cheating in the Arena wrong?
Because it ruins the game for everyone and goes against the values of the Goddess.

chapters.title: Sharing is Caring: An Introduction to Teamwork in Shaiya
lines: In Shaiya, you will often team up with your friends to hunt monsters and get loot.
Loot is anything you find in a monster's body or when you complete a quest.
Sharing loot means giving some of your good items to your friends so they can use them too.
Imagine you and your friends are on Floor 10 hunting a big, scary monster.
You all attack the monster and finally defeat it.
You get a shiny, red gem that looks like a lapis stone.
You could keep it all to yourself, but that wouldn't be very nice, would it?
Instead, you could give the gem to your friend who needs it most.
This way, your friend will be happy and will remember you as a good friend.
Remember, when you share your loot, you also share the excitement of your adventure.
Think about the Ranger who needs more dexterity for their daggers.
Maybe you have a better dagger with more dexterity points.
Pass it on to them and watch them run faster and hit harder!
Sharing also helps you get more loot from the monster you just defeated.
The more friends you share with, the bigger the rewards will be for everyone.
It's like making a bigger team, and a bigger team can do more things together.
qa: Why is sharing loot important?
It helps your friends and makes adventures more fun.
Can you give an example of sharing loot?
Sharing a better dagger with a Ranger who needs more dexterity.
How does sharing affect the rewards?
It can make the rewards bigger for everyone.
What does sharing teach us?
It teaches kindness and teamwork.

chapters.title: The Basics of Loot: Understanding What We Collect in Shaiya
lines: In Shaiya, when you defeat a monster, you get something called loot.
Loot is the special items, gold, and magic that a monster drops after you beat it.
For example, a warrior might get a strong sword or some armor from a defeated ogre.
An archer might find arrows or a magic bow from a fairy.
Sometimes, you find magic stones that can make your gear stronger.
It's important to know what you're getting when you defeat a monster.
Sharing loot means you give some of your found items to your friends.
If you share your loot, you might find that your friends give you their items too.
It's like trading stickers with your friends at school.
If you share with a bigger group, everyone gets more loot than if you shared with just one or two friends.
Imagine you found a magical key, and you shared it with three friends; you all get the key and some gold.
If you didn't share, you might only get a bit of gold, but sharing means you get the key and more.
Sometimes, you can trade with your friends for items you need, like a shield for a healing potion.
Remember, the more friends you have, the more loot you can share and get back.
qa: What is loot in Shaiya?
The special items, gold, and magic that a monster drops after you beat it.
What happens if you share your loot with friends?
Everyone gets more loot than if you shared with just one or two friends.
Why is it important to share loot?
Sharing helps everyone get more loot from the monster you just defeated.
Can you trade items with friends after sharing loot?
Yes, you can trade with your friends for items you need.

chapters.title: Making Fair Decisions: Techniques for Dividing Loot Equitably
lines: Sharing loot fairly is like making sure everyone gets to play with their favorite toy.
Imagine you and your friends find a treasure chest, you want to make sure everyone gets a turn with the cool stuff inside.
One way is to count the number of people, and divide the loot into that many parts, like sharing cookies at a birthday party.
Another way is to ask each person to name what they most want, then you give them that one thing, and keep going until it's all shared.
Sometimes, it's best to just play a game to decide, like rock-paper-scissors, to make sure no one feels sad about the decision.
Remember, it's okay to ask for what you want, but it's also nice to let others have what they really need.
For example, if you're both really wanting a magic bow, you might both say you'll take a potion instead, and then use the bow for a day each.
Or maybe you have a friend who always gets hurt, so you might share a healing potion with them, even if you really want it for yourself.
When you share, you help everyone in the Tower be happier, and that makes the whole place better for all of you.
Sometimes, you might even find that sharing makes you happier than keeping it all for yourself.
Remember, sharing is not just about dividing the loot, it's about being kind and helping your friends.
It's like when you share your lunch with someone, and they share theirs back, it makes both of you feel good.
In the Tower, people who share are known for their kindness, and they often get extra good luck from the Goddess.
The more you share, the more you can get back, like when you share a story and learn a new one in return.
qa: Why is sharing loot fair?
It ensures everyone gets a chance to benefit, just like sharing cookies.
How can you decide who gets which item?
By dividing the loot equally, or by asking each person what they want most.
Can you share with friends to get items you need?
Yes, you can trade with friends for items you need, like a shield for a healing potion.
What happens when you share and are kind?
You get extra good luck from the Goddess and are known for your kindness.

chapters.title: Building Stronger Teams: Strategies for Effective Team Play
lines: In the Tower, building strong teams is like making a big group of friends who can help each other.
When you share your loot, you make new friends who can share their loot with you too.
Imagine if you had a special toy, and you let your friend play with it; they might let you try their toy next.
In the Tower, sharing makes you stronger because you get more friends to help you on dangerous adventures.
One time, two people named Lily and Tom shared their gold, and soon they were hunting monsters together and finding better loot.
Another time, a group of people shared their potions and food during a tough battle, and they all won together.
In the Tower, sharing is like planting a seed; if you share your loot, the Goddess might give you more as a reward.
Remember, when you share, you're not losing anything, but you're gaining friends and stronger teams to help you.
In the Hall of the Fallen, you can see the statues of people who shared their loot and became heroes.
When you share, you create a circle of kindness that grows bigger and bigger.
Once, a shy person named Mia shared a little piece of her loot, and soon she had many new friends who helped her on her adventures.
If you share your gear, your friends can use it and return the favor, making everyone stronger together.
Sharing loot can help you form a team that can beat the strongest monsters in the Tower.
By sharing, you show that you are a kind and brave person, and the Goddess might bless your team with extra luck.
In the Arena, if you share your best gear, your opponent might share their gear too, making the match more fun and fair.
qa: How does sharing loot help you?
It helps you make strong teams with friends who can help you.
Can you give an example of sharing loot?
Lily and Tom shared their gold, and they hunted monsters together, finding better loot.
What does the Goddess give you for sharing?
The Goddess might give you more as a reward for sharing.
How does sharing create a circle of kindness?
Sharing helps you make friends who will share with you too, creating a growing circle of kindness.

chapters.title: Celebrating Success: The Importance of Recognizing Everyone’s Contribution
lines: When you and your friends share loot, it's like everyone is part of a big, happy family.
Imagine you and your friend, Mia, found a magical sword. If you share it, Mia can help you use its power.
Remember the time you and your friends fought the giant spider? Everyone contributed a little, and you won together.
Sharing loot can be as simple as giving a potion to your friend when they are hurt.
Once, you shared your best bow with your friend, and they shared their magic shield. You both were better together.
When you share loot, the Goddess might smile and give you and your friends extra luck for your next adventure.
In the Arena, you saw two friends who shared their best gear. They both did better because they trusted each other.
Think about the little elf who always shares their berries. Everyone likes to help the elf, and the elf is happy too.
Sharing loot can make the game more fun. It's like a big game of tag where everyone helps each other.
The next time you go on a quest, think about who needs help the most and share your loot with them.
Sharing loot is like planting a seed. If you share, more good things might grow from it.
One day, you might be the one to share, and someone else might help you. It's all about being kind and helpful.
In the Tower, sharing loot can make your floor a nicer place to live. Everyone is happier when they help each other.
The Goddess loves it when you share. She might give you and your friends a special celebration at the Hall of the Fallen.
Sharing loot is a way to make friends and be part of a great team. It’s what the Goddess wants you to do.
qa: Why is sharing loot important?
It helps form a strong team and makes adventures more successful.
How can sharing loot affect the Goddess?
The Goddess might bless your team with extra luck.
Can sharing loot make the Arena fights more fun?
Yes, it can make the fights more fair and enjoyable.
What might happen if you share your best loot?
The Goddess might smile and give you extra luck, and others might be more willing to share too.

chapters.title: Introduction to the World of Shaiya
lines: Welcome to the magical world of Shaiya, where everyone lives in a big tower with twenty floors.
In Shaiya, there are two peoples: the Light and the Fury, each with their own unique culture.
There are six classes to choose from: Fighter, Defender, Ranger, Archer, Mage, and Priest, each with their own special skills.
The people of Shaiya level up by hunting monsters, and the highest they can go is level 80.
Gear can be enchanted with lapis stones, which make it stronger. These stones come in different levels, from +1 to +20.
The higher you live in the tower, the better the monsters you can hunt, and the richer you can become.
On the first three floors, you can use the strongest lapis stones, enchant your gear to the highest level, and sell anything you want.
On the fourth and fifth floors, you can use lapis stones up to +8, and on floors six to twenty, you can only use stones up to +4.
If you can't sell something on your floor, it goes to the Grand Auction, where the prices are higher.
The strongest person in the tower lives on the first floor, and they have a family with them.
Each floor above the lowest gives you a 1% better chance of linking and enchanting, and your life is 1% longer.
If you want to visit someone on a different floor, you can move to that floor temporarily.
There is an Arena where you can challenge other citizens to a friendly fight.
We hope you enjoy your adventures in Shaiya!
qa: What are the two peoples in Shaiya?
Light and Fury.
What are the six classes in Shaiya?
Fighter, Defender, Ranger, Archer, Mage, and Priest.
What is the highest level you can achieve in Shaiya?
Level 80.
On which floor do the strongest people live?
On the first floor.

chapters.title: Building a Strong Foundation
lines: To build a strong foundation, start with teaching your child the basic rules of the Tower, like moving to different floors and using the Arena.
Show them how to find friends on higher floors who might be stronger, as everyone lives among all skill levels.
Let them know that each floor has its unique challenges and benefits, like the enchanting rules and the market.
Explain that moving up in the Tower can bring new opportunities, such as better enchantments and stronger allies.
Teach them to make friends on different floors and visit them occasionally, as it’s a great way to learn and grow.
Encourage them to participate in the Arena, where they can test their skills and learn from the challenges.
Point out that the Goddess and other gods provide guidance, and they should always seek wisdom and protection from them.
Show them the Hall of the Fallen, a place of honor for those who have passed on, and explain the importance of remembering the past.
Remind them that each floor offers a chance to improve, and they should be brave and willing to move up to greater challenges.
Take them to the market and explain how to trade and use the gold earned from their adventures.
Teach them to respect the laws and rules of the Tower, as they ensure a fair and safe environment.
Help them understand that the blessing of height can be a significant advantage, encouraging them to aim for higher floors.
Demonstrate how to use the enchanting stones, emphasizing the importance of lapisia, as it can significantly boost their abilities.
Explain the importance of balancing their skills, using examples like a fighter who also knows healing magic, to become versatile and powerful.
qa: What can children do when they want to visit friends on different floors?
They can move to that floor temporarily.
What is the purpose of the Arena in the Tower?
It is a place where citizens can challenge each other to friendly fights to test their skills.
How does moving up in the Tower benefit a child?
It provides better enchantment opportunities and stronger allies, among other benefits.
What is the Hall of the Fallen, and why is it important?
It is a place of honor for those who have passed on, emphasizing the importance of remembering the past.

chapters.title: Exploring the Realm of Magic and Healing
lines: Magic and healing are important in Shaiya, just like hunting and fighting.
When you learn magic, you can help your friends and family stay healthy.
Healing magic is especially useful in the Arena, where you might get hurt.
You can find healing magic in the library on Floor 10.
Start by learning simple spells, like 'Curse Breaker' to remove harmful effects.
Next, learn 'Life Force' to restore a bit of health to yourself or others.
Remember, you can only use healing magic on your floor, not on other floors.
Magic can be enchanted, making it even more powerful.
Lapisia stones are the best for enchanting magic because they have a higher enchantment level.
A fighter who can heal is very tough and can help a lot in battles.
A ranger who can shoot and heal is a quick and strong ally.
A mage who also knows healing is a powerful friend to have.
A priest who can heal can keep everyone healthy, making them live longer.
Always practice your magic and healing skills to become better and stronger.
Using lapisia stones wisely can make your magic and healing spells much stronger.
qa: What is the importance of healing magic?
It can help you and your friends stay healthy.
Why are lapisia stones important for enchanting magic?
They have a higher enchantment level.
Can magic and healing be combined with other skills?
Yes, a fighter can also know healing magic.
What can lapisia stones do?
They can significantly boost your magic and healing abilities.

chapters.title: Developing Talents and Skills
lines: Always start by understanding what talents your child may have, just like a mage discovering the magic of healing.
Encourage them to try different classes, like a ranger or a fighter, to see what fits best.
Practice, practice, practice! Just like a defender who practices blocking and parrying to protect others.
Show them that every skill, no matter how small, can be important, like a ranger’s speed in evading danger.
Help them understand that wisdom is key, like a priest who learns to use their healing magic wisely.
Encourage them to explore new places, like moving to a higher floor for better enchanting opportunities.
Teach them to save their best lapisia stones for moments that truly matter, like a critical healing spell in battle.
Guide them in setting goals, like reaching Floor 10 to unlock new enchantments.
Remind them that failure is part of learning, like a mage who tries a new spell and misses the target a few times.
Praise their efforts and successes, just like celebrating a successful hunt with the community.
Support their passions, like a child who is excited to practice archery in the arena.
Model the behavior you want to see, like a parent who demonstrates kindness and skill in the community.
Teach them to respect the rules, like the laws of the Goddess that govern the Tower.
Remind them that the blessings of height come with responsibility, just like the duty of a person on Floor 1 to lead others.
qa: How can you help a child discover their talents?
By encouraging them to try different classes and activities.
Why is it important to practice skills?
Because practice helps children become better at what they do, much like a defender blocking and parrying.
What is an example of using wisdom in a skill?
A priest wisely using healing magic when it is truly needed.
How can moving to a higher floor benefit a child's skills?
Higher floors offer better enchanting opportunities, which can strengthen their skills.

chapters.title: Navigating the Tower and Beyond
lines: Show your child the paths in the Tower, from the bustling Market Floor to the quiet Top of the World.
Teach them to respect the laws of the Goddess, like the different enchantment rules for each floor.
Explain that the higher floors offer more enchantments but require more respect for others.
Encourage them to visit different floors to learn from the strengths of the people there.
For example, show them how the Fighters on Floor 12 have mastered the art of two-handed weapons.
Point out how the Archers on Floor 3 can use their bows from a great distance.
Guide them to the Arena and teach them to respect the rules of fair play.
Take them to the Hall of the Fallen and discuss the bravery of the fallen heroes.
Remind them that everyone has a place in the Tower, whether strong or weak.
Tell them that the blessing of height is not just about power but about leadership and responsibility.
For instance, if they move up to Floor 5, encourage them to use their increased abilities to help others.
Explain that the Grand Auction is a place where everyone can share their treasures, big or small.
Take them to meet the leaders of the guilds and show them the importance of community.
Teach them that each floor, from 1 to 20, has its own unique challenges and opportunities.
Finally, remind them that the Tower is a place where they can grow and learn, just like the laws of the Goddess guide them.

chapters.title: Chapter 1: Understanding Your Place in the Tower
lines: In Shaiya, every tower has 20 floors, like a giant home for everyone.
Shaiya has two peoples: the Light and the Fury, but we don’t need to worry about that now.
The tower is like a big game, and you get better as you go up.
Each floor has its own magic and special things.
The lowest floor, 1, is where the strongest people live.
The first 3 floors are the richest and have the best magic, but they also have strict rules.
Floors 4 to 5 have good magic, but you can’t sell the best things there.
On higher floors, the magic is weaker, but it’s okay because you’ll be stronger anyway.
Every floor is like a different world, with its own rules and treasures.
The higher you go, the more successful you can be with your magic and gear.
People can visit other floors to see their friends or try new things.
When you die, you go to a special place called the Hall of the Fallen.
There’s a big fight place called the Arena where anyone can challenge each other.
Remember, the place you live doesn’t mean you’re not strong or special.
qa: Why do people live on different floors in the tower?
To be close to the best magic and treasures of their level.
What can you do on the lowest floor?
You can use the best magic and sell the best things.
Why are some floors more successful than others?
Because the magic and success chances get better the higher you go.
What happens if you die in the game?
You go to the Hall of the Fallen, a special place for the dead.

chapters.title: Chapter 2: Building a Strong Foundation
lines: In the Tower of Shaiya, the first thing you need to learn is how to build a strong foundation.
Remember, the floor you live on doesn't define you, so don't worry if you're on a lower floor.
The first step is to choose a class that suits you. Are you strong and good at fighting? Maybe you should be a Fighter.
Do you like to stay back and use your speed? Try the Ranger class.
If you're clever and like to use magic, the Mage might be your path.
No matter your class, you need to improve your stats - Strength, Dexterity, Toughness, Intelligence, Wisdom, and Luck.
Start by hunting monsters on your floor to get better at your class and earn some gold.
You can use this gold to buy better gear from the market.
Sometimes, you might find a lapis stone. These can make your gear even stronger!
Wear your best gear in the Arena. It’s a fun place to test your skills.
Make friends with other players. They can teach you new things and help you get stronger.
Visit other floors when you can. This way, you can see different kinds of monsters and learn from other players.
Be brave and don’t be afraid to try new things. Even if you lose, you learn something.
As you level up, keep your gear and skills updated. You never know when you’ll need them.
Lastly, always remember to have fun. Winning isn’t everything, but playing well is important.
qa: What is the first step in building a strong foundation?
Choosing a class that suits you.
What can you do with the gold earned from hunting monsters?
Buy better gear from the market.
What can you find sometimes when hunting monsters?
A lapis stone.
Why should you visit other floors?
To see different monsters and learn from other players.

chapters.title: Chapter 3: Mastering Your Class and Skills
lines: Every class has special abilities that make them strong in their own way.
Fighters can smash through tough enemies, just like a big, strong bear.
Defenders can protect their friends, similar to a brave knight guarding a castle.
Rangers can move very quickly and sneak around, like a cat in the night.
Archer can shoot arrows from far away, like a master marksman at the target range.
Mages can do magic tricks, like turning a rock into a flower.
Priests can heal their friends, like a doctor making someone feel better.
Each class has a different set of skills that they are good at.
For example, a Fighter is best at dealing direct damage and taking down enemies.
Defenders are great at protecting others and soaking up damage.
Rangers excel in speed and are good at avoiding trouble.
Archer can deal damage from a distance and are great at long-range combat.
Mages can deal magical damage and support their allies with spells.
Priests are excellent for healing and making sure their friends stay healthy.
Practice your skills and level up to get better and stronger.
Go on adventures and fight monsters to get experience and earn gold.
Use the gold to buy better gear and enchant your gear with lapis stones.
Join a guild to get help and support from other players.
Learn the best times to use your skills in different situations.
Practice makes perfect, so keep playing and improving your skills.
qa: Why is it important to practice your class's skills?
To get better and stronger.
What can you buy with gold?
Better gear and enchanted items.
What is the benefit of joining a guild?
To get help and support from other players.
How can you improve your chances of success?
By practicing and understanding when to use your skills.

chapters.title: Chapter 4: Winning Well in the Arena
lines: The Arena is a place where two players can fight, but remember, fighting isn't just about winning, it's about being a good sport.
In the Arena, you and your opponent will face each other in a fair and supervised battle.
Always be respectful and polite to your opponent, even if you win.
If you win, be proud, but don’t brag. Winning is just one part of being a good player.
If you lose, don’t get upset. Learn from the experience and try again next time.
Before you enter the Arena, think about which class you are and what kind of opponent you are facing.
If you’re a Fighter, use your strength to overpower your opponent.
If you’re a Ranger, use your agility to dodge and attack.
Archers should aim for the head, where the armor is thinnest.
Mages should use spells wisely, saving them for the right moment.
Priests should focus on healing and protecting allies.
Defenders can use their shield to block attacks and protect their team.
In the Arena, always use the best gear you have.
Remember, the blessing of height means you may have an advantage if you’re on a higher floor.
Always follow the laws of the Goddess to ensure fair play.
qa: What should you do if you win in the Arena?
Be proud but don’t brag.
Why is it important to be respectful in the Arena?
Because good sportsmanship is part of winning well.
What should you think about before entering the Arena?
Which class you are and what kind of opponent you are facing.
How can you use the blessing of height in the Arena?
You may have an advantage because your actions may succeed more often.

chapters.title: Chapter 5: Living Well on Your Floor
lines: Living well on your floor means making the most of where you are.
First, remember the blessing of height - the higher you are, the better your chances.
If you're on Floor 2 or above, your gear and life will work just a tiny bit better.
For example, your magic might be a little more powerful or your life a little longer.
On Floors 1-3, you can use all 12 enchantment slots and sell anything you like.
But on Floors 4-5, you can only use 8 slots and sell up to +8 enchanted gear.
On Floors 6-20, you can only use 4 slots and sell up to +4 enchanted gear.
That's why it's important to save your best gear for Floors 1-3 if you can.
You might have to share your Floor with other people, so be kind and share the best gear you can.
If someone on your Floor needs help, lend them your gear if you can.
Also, always sell what you can't use in the Grand Auction - it's the right thing to do.
Sometimes, the best gear you have might be better used by someone who needs it more than you.
That's how you can really make a difference and win well.
Finally, always respect the laws of the Goddess - it's the only way to keep the Tower fair and balanced.
qa: Why is it important to use the best gear you have in the Arena?
Because the blessing of height means you might have an advantage if you're on a higher floor.
Can you use all 12 enchantment slots on any floor?
No, only on Floors 1-3.
What should you do with gear you can't use?
Sell it in the Grand Auction.
What does the blessing of height mean?
It means that the higher you are, the better your gear and life will work.
