chapters.title: Chapter 1: The Power of Clear Sentences
lines: In Shaiya, clear sentences are like a light in the dark.
They help you share your ideas and thoughts with others.
When you speak clearly, people understand you better.
For example, if you want to invite a friend to play, just say, 'Will you play with me?'
If you are hungry, you can simply say, 'I am hungry.'
Always remember to be polite, like saying 'please' and 'thank you'.
Clear sentences are powerful tools for friendship and respect.
When you ask for help, be clear, like 'Can you help me with my toy?'
If you want to ask a question, say it like, 'Do you have a story to tell me?', not just 'story?'
To say you agree, just say, 'Yes, I agree.'
To disagree, say, 'No, I disagree.'
When you need to say sorry, be clear and honest, 'I am sorry for breaking your toy.'
If you want to ask for a story, you can say, 'Can you tell me a story about the Tower of Floors?'
Clear sentences are like bridges between you and others.
They help you make new friends in the Tower of Floors.
Always speak clearly, like a brave Fighter who fights for the right words.
qa: Why is it important to speak clearly?
It helps others understand you better.
How can you ask for help politely?
Say, 'Can you help me with this?'.
What should you say if you want to agree with someone?
Say, 'Yes, I agree.'.
How can you use clear sentences to make friends?
By sharing your thoughts clearly and politely.

chapters.title: Chapter 2: How to Ask Questions Like a Brave Ranger
lines: When you ask a question, imagine you're a Ranger, moving quickly and finding the best path.
Ask like you're exploring the forest, using the path of words to find your way.
Ask clearly, just like a Defender protects their shield, keeping the question strong.
Ask your friends if they saw the morning light, using 'if' to invite them to share.
Ask the Archer to show you the target, with 'can you' making your request friendly and kind.
Ask your Priest for a blessing, using 'may I' to show respect and politeness.
Ask your Mage to teach you magic, with 'could you' showing you're eager to learn.
Ask your family what stories they have, using 'what' to open the door to tales.
Ask the Guild Leader for advice, with 'would you' showing you value their wisdom.
Ask your friend to play a game, using 'will you' to make the invitation fun and exciting.
Ask the people on the next floor for a visit, with 'could I' showing you're polite and considerate.
Ask the Elder for a story, using 'how' to explore the past and learn about the present.
Ask the children in the Tower about their adventures, using 'why' to find out what makes them happy.
Ask your pet creature for a playdate, with 'can I' showing you're friendly and want to share fun.
qa: Can you give an example of asking a question like a Ranger?
Ask your friend if they saw the morning light.
What does asking with 'could you' show about your request?
It shows you're polite and kind.
Which word can you use to open the door to tales from your family?
What.
How can you ask someone for advice on being a good Fighter?
Ask the Guild Leader with 'would you' to share your wisdom.

chapters.title: Chapter 3: The Art of Telling a Story with Magic
lines: In the world of Shaiya, stories are like magic spells,
qa: What does the author say stories are like in Shaiya?
magic spells
How do you ask for a story from an Elder in Shaiya?
Ask the Elder, 'How did you become an Elder?'
What is a good way to learn about what makes other children happy?
Ask them, 'Why do you like to play with that toy?'
How do you invite your pet creature for a playdate in Shaiya?
Say, 'Can I play with you today?'

chapters.title: Chapter 4: Using Polite Words, Like a Wise Priest
lines: Polite words are like gentle winds that cool the air.
A wise priest says, 'Please' before asking for a favor.
He also says, 'Thank you' when given something.
In the Tower, a child once asked for a toy, 'May I have a small toy, please?'
The priest smiled and replied, 'Of course, little one. Say thank you when you get it.'
A day later, the child saw the priest, 'I got it, thank you!'
The priest nodded, teaching that politeness is a gift to everyone.
In the market, a baker says, 'May I offer you some bread, please?' to a traveler.
The traveler thanks with, 'Thank you, I will take that.'
A child who learns to use polite words can make friends easily.
When visiting the Hall of the Fallen, a child should say, 'May I pay my respects, please?'
The wise priest adds, 'And remember to say it with respect in your heart.'
Even when you disagree, use polite words, like, 'I understand your point, but...', 'May I share my thoughts, please?'
Politeness is like a ladder that helps you reach higher in life.
On the Tower, you might meet a Mage on Floor 5, 'May I wish you a good day, Mage?' is a polite start.
Wise words can calm a difficult situation, 'Would you like to talk about this calmly, please?'

chapters.title: Chapter 5: The Blessing of Height: Speaking from the Top Floor
lines: On the Tower, being from a higher floor is seen as a blessing, a sign of wisdom and strength.
People on higher floors often have more to share and better stories to tell.
If you hear someone talking from a higher floor, they might say, 'Hello from the skies!'
Such a voice carries a bit more weight, a bit more respect.
When greeting someone from a higher floor, you might reply, 'Thank you for your kind words, my friend.'
Remember, the higher you are, the clearer your voice can be heard, and the more people will listen.
If a person from the top floor wishes you well, it’s polite to return the favor, 'May you find peace on your journey too, floor below.'
In the Arena, a challenger from a lower floor might say to a higher one, 'I accept your challenge, may it be honorable.'
Even in the Hall of the Fallen, someone from a higher floor might speak, 'May our paths cross again, in better times.'
If you need advice, asking someone from a higher floor can be like reaching for a higher branch.
But be careful, too, for they might offer too much, expecting too much in return.
If a lower floor citizen asks, 'Can you help me with this?' a higher floor might answer, 'Of course, friend, let me assist you.'
In the market, haggling might go better if you start, 'May your business be fair, as the Goddess wishes.'
When selling your enchanted gear, you might say, 'Would you consider my offer, my friend?'
If a higher floor citizen offers a kindness, a lower floor might respond, 'Thank you, from the bottom of my heart.'
Always be mindful of the blessing of height, for it can make a difference in your words and deeds.
qa: What is the blessing of height mentioned in the chapter?
Each floor above the lowest makes linking and enchanting succeed 1% more often and lives last 1% longer.
What does a person from a higher floor often say when greeting someone?
'Hello from the skies!'
What should you do if a person from a higher floor wishes you well?
You might reply, 'May you find peace on your journey too, floor below.'
How can asking someone from a higher floor help you?
They might offer advice or assistance that could be invaluable.

chapters.title: Chapter 6: The Arena of Words: A Storytelling Challenge
lines: In the Tower of Floors, where everyone lives, there is an Arena of Words.
It is not like a fight with swords, but a storytelling challenge.
Citizens gather there to hear tales and share their own stories.
A storyteller once shared a tale of a brave ranger who saved the Tower from a fierce monster.
Everyone listened, their eyes wide with wonder and admiration.
Another time, a wise old mage told of a land far, far away, where magic was born.
The children were captivated, their imaginations running wild with possibilities.
On the day of the storytelling challenge, each citizen would share a tale, big or small.
The stories could be true or made up, as long as they were well told and wise.
A young defender, with her shield and courage, told of a hero who protected the weak.
A kind priest, with her gentle heart, shared a story of love and healing.
A strong fighter, with his two-handed weapon, spoke of strength and bravery.
An archer, quick and skilled, told of archery competitions and the joy of the hunt.
A mage, with his staff, cast a spell to make the story vivid and real for the listeners.
A ranger, with his agility, spoke of adventures in the woods, filled with wonders and dangers.
At the end of the day, the listeners would vote for the best storyteller of the day.
The winner would receive a special prize, a gift from the Goddess herself.
Always remember to listen with kindness, for every story has a lesson.
And when you speak, speak with honesty and wisdom, for your words can change the world.
qa: What is the purpose of the Arena of Words?
It is a storytelling challenge where citizens share tales.
Who can participate in the storytelling challenge?
Any citizen can participate, regardless of their class or floor level.
What does the winner of the storytelling challenge receive?
The winner receives a special prize, a gift from the Goddess herself.
Why is it important to listen with kindness during the storytelling?
Because every story has a lesson and listening with kindness helps everyone learn from the stories.

books.title: How to Become a Leader
books.about: earning trust, deciding, listening, taking blame, leading by example
plan: Chapter 1: The Foundation of Trust
Chapter 2: Making Decisions with Wisdom
Chapter 3: The Art of Listening
Chapter 4: Taking Responsibility
Chapter 5: Leading by Example: Your Values
Chapter 6: Navigating the Floors of Trust
Chapter 7: The Arena of Leadership: Challenges and Growth
Chapter 8: Elevating the Tower: A Leader's Vision

chapters.title: Chapter 1: The Foundation of Trust
lines: Leadership begins with trust, and trust is built through actions, not just words.
Think about a young Fighter named Aric who, despite his initial fear, helped a lost Ranger find their way through the dark forests.
Aric's willingness to step up and assist earned the Ranger's trust, showing Aric's strength of character.
In the bustling market, Aric noticed a struggling Archer selling a rare bow at a discount.
He bought it, understanding that helping a fellow citizen in need is a sign of true leadership.
Later, Aric discovered the Archer was desperately trying to pay off a debt.
By discreetly offering to help, Aric showed kindness and care, setting the foundation for a trusting relationship.
Aric's friend, a Defender named Zara, was in an argument with a Mage over a minor misunderstanding.
Aric listened to both sides, then calmly suggested a compromise that satisfied everyone.
Zara, seeing Aric's fairness, trusted him to make tough decisions in the future.
On a random floor, Aric found a Priest tending to the injured after a fierce battle.
Aric, noticing the exhaustion on the Priest's face, offered to help in their duties.
The Priest gratefully accepted, and soon, Aric was learning to mend wounds and cast minor spells.
When the Priest fell in battle, Aric stepped in to take their place.
The other citizens, witnessing this, began to see Aric as a trustworthy leader.
In the Arena, Aric once accepted a challenge from a powerful Fighter.
Aric was hit hard but stayed standing, earning the respect of the crowd and the Fighter.
From then on, the Fighter always listened to Aric's advice and suggestions, showing trust in their leadership.
Every act of kindness, every word of encouragement, every moment of courage, built the trust that would sustain Aric's leadership.
qa: What is the first step in building trust as a leader according to this chapter?
Actions, not just words.
Give an example of a leader showing kindness and care to build trust?
Aric bought a discounted rare bow from a struggling Archer and discreetly helped the Archer pay off a debt.
How did Aric's fair decision-making earn the trust of others?
Aric calmly suggested a compromise that satisfied everyone in an argument between a Defender and a Mage, showing fairness and understanding.
Describe a situation where Aric's actions directly led to being seen as a trustworthy leader?
After the Priest fell in battle, Aric took their place and was seen helping others, which earned the trust of the other citizens.

chapters.title: Chapter 2: Making Decisions with Wisdom
lines: Aric knew that making decisions required a balance of wisdom and courage.
He often found himself considering the future consequences of his choices.
One day, Aric faced a difficult situation where he had to choose between two equally skilled fighters for a critical mission.
Aric remembered that a decision was not just about the outcome, but also about the path one chose.
He decided to take a moment, seeking advice from the Fighter and other trusted allies.
Their input helped Aric make a decision, but he also shared the reasoning behind his choice, ensuring transparency.
He reminded everyone that decisions were not always easy, but they were necessary for the betterment of the group.
Another time, Aric had to decide how to distribute a rare lapis stone.
Aric believed in fairness and decided to hold a mini-tournament to decide the lucky recipient.
The decision was not only fair but also strengthened the team’s cohesion, as everyone participated in the process.
Aric always ensured that the reasons behind his decisions were clear and well-explained, even when they were unpopular.
For instance, when he decided to move from a lower floor to a higher one, he openly shared the benefits and risks.
Aric also learned that sometimes, the best decision was not the one with the best outcome, but the one that was made with wisdom and care.
He often discussed decisions with his followers, showing that he valued their input and opinions.
This practice not only strengthened the team but also built a culture of trust and respect.
By making decisions with wisdom and transparency, Aric showed that true leadership was not about power, but about serving the group with integrity.

chapters.title: Chapter 3: The Art of Listening
lines: Aric listened intently to his followers as they shared their thoughts and ideas during the council meetings.
He made a point to ask clarifying questions, ensuring everyone felt heard and valued.
One time, a Ranger suggested a new strategy for hunting monsters in the depths of the Tower.
Aric took the idea seriously, discussing it with the group and making adjustments.
He believed that every voice mattered, even if the speaker was new or of lower rank.
Once, a Defender felt overlooked and unappreciated, and Aric took the time to address his concerns.
Aric demonstrated patience, allowing the Defender to express his feelings before responding thoughtfully.
In another instance, a Priest proposed a healing ritual that could benefit the whole Tower.
Aric listened attentively, considering the idea carefully before discussing its potential impact.
He showed that he was approachable, often holding informal meetings to discuss matters with his followers.
Aric also listened to the feedback from his followers after implementing a decision, making necessary adjustments.
During a critical moment, a Mage suggested an alternative approach to a problem.
Aric heard the suggestion, discussed its merits with the group, and credited the Mage for the idea when it was implemented.
He always acknowledged the contributions of his followers, ensuring they knew their input was appreciated.
By listening, Aric created a space where followers felt safe to share their ideas and concerns without fear of judgment.
qa: What did Aric do when a Defender felt unappreciated?
He listened to the Defender's concerns and addressed them thoughtfully.
How did Aric ensure every voice was heard?
He actively sought input from all followers, especially those who might be new or of lower rank.
Can you give an example of how Aric credited his followers for ideas?
When a Mage suggested an alternative approach, Aric acknowledged the idea in a group discussion.
Why was it important for Aric to listen during critical moments?
It helped him make well-rounded decisions and showed that he valued input from all members of the group.

chapters.title: Chapter 4: Taking Responsibility
lines: In Aric’s leadership, taking responsibility was not just about doing the right thing; it was about earning the trust of his followers.
When a task went wrong, Aric admitted his part, even if the fault lay with someone else.
One night, a group of Rangers reported their equipment lost to a thief. Aric took the blame, leading to a night of hard work to recover the lost gear.
By doing so, Aric set a precedent that mistakes, when acknowledged, could bring the group closer together.
On another occasion, a Fighter accidentally set off an alarm while hunting, causing a stir. Aric, instead of blaming the Fighter, took the heat for it, ensuring the situation remained calm.
Aric’s willingness to take responsibility allowed his followers to feel more secure, knowing they could trust him to handle problems.
In a critical meeting, when a strategy was deemed faulty, Aric did not shirk his role but instead took the opportunity to learn and improve.
Once, a Priest was criticized for a mistake in a healing spell, and Aric, despite knowing the Priest was not at fault, took responsibility to maintain morale.
Aric’s example inspired others to own their mistakes, leading to a more transparent and cooperative group.
He would often remind his followers, ‘We are only as strong as our weakest member; we must support each other.’
During a particularly tough encounter, Aric faced a critical decision. He chose the path that not only was in the best interest of the group but also took the potential blame if things went wrong.
In a disagreement, Aric would always listen to all sides, even those that contradicted his own ideas, showing his commitment to fairness.
Aric’s leadership style, though sometimes costly, built a resilient and cohesive team, where every member felt valued and responsible.
By always taking on his share of the responsibility, Aric created an environment of mutual respect and trust.
In the end, it wasn’t just about what he did; it was about how he did it, earning the trust of his followers through his actions.
qa: How did Aric handle mistakes in his leadership?
Aric admitted his part even when the fault was with someone else.
What did Aric do during a disagreement?
He listened to all sides, even those that contradicted his own ideas.
Why did Aric always take responsibility?
To maintain morale and build a cohesive team.
What was the result of Aric’s approach to responsibility?
It created an environment of mutual respect and trust.

chapters.title: Chapter 5: Leading by Example: Your Values
lines: Leadership is about more than just making decisions; it’s about setting a standard.
Aric valued honesty, and in his dealings, he always told the truth, no matter the cost.
When a misunderstanding arose between his team, Aric listened to everyone’s side, even the ones who were upset with him.
If something went wrong, Aric took the blame, knowing that it was the right thing to do.
By always wearing his strongest gear, Aric showed his team that he was willing to face danger first.
In moments of crisis, Aric stood tall, using his voice to calm the team and keep them focused.
Aric led by example, making sure to train alongside his team, never asking them to do anything he wouldn’t do himself.
He ensured that everyone had a say in important decisions, valuing each member’s opinion.
Aric often shared his knowledge, teaching his team new skills and strategies.
One time, a team member was struggling, and Aric spent hours helping them practice, without expecting anything in return.
Aric’s dedication to his team’s growth and well-being was evident in the way he cared for their needs.
He organized community events, bringing everyone together to celebrate their victories and support each other.
By leading with empathy, Aric created an environment where every team member felt supported and valued.
When the team faced a difficult challenge, Aric showed up, ready to face it with them, reinforcing the idea that they were all in this together.
Through his actions, Aric proved that leading by example was not just a slogan but a way of life.
qa: What was the first value Aric demonstrated to his team?
Honesty.
How did Aric handle conflicts within the team?
By listening to everyone's side.
What action did Aric take when something went wrong?
He took the blame.
What did Aric do to show his dedication to the team’s growth?
He shared his knowledge and helped team members practice.

chapters.title: Chapter 6: Navigating the Floors of Trust
lines: Aric understood that earning trust was not a one-time event but a continuous journey.
Each day, he started by checking in with his team, asking about their well-being.
He listened carefully, showing that he cared about more than just the tasks at hand.
Aric’s first step was to ensure his team knew they could approach him with any issue, big or small.
Once, a team member expressed concern about the upcoming competition on a higher floor.
Aric sat down with him, offering support and strategies to face the challenge.
He made it clear that failure was not an option, but learning from mistakes was essential.
By being open and transparent, Aric built a culture of honesty within his team.
He shared his own fears and doubts, showing that vulnerability could strengthen bonds.
During a particularly stressful project, Aric took on extra work, showing that he would not ask anyone to do something he wouldn't do himself.
When a team member made a mistake, Aric handled the situation by discussing what happened and how to prevent it in the future.
He never criticized or punished, instead focusing on constructive feedback and personal growth.
Aric led by example, always adhering to the laws of the Goddess and his own code of conduct.
By navigating these floors with integrity and care, Aric earned the trust of his peers and the community.
Every time Aric faced a decision, he always considered the impact on his team’s trust first.
The team’s trust in Aric was evident when they united to help him when he faced a personal challenge.
qa: How did Aric ensure his team felt valued?
By checking in with them daily and listening carefully.
What did Aric do when a team member had a concern about an upcoming challenge?
He sat down and offered support and strategies.
How did Aric handle mistakes within his team?
He focused on constructive feedback and personal growth.
What was the outcome of Aric’s actions on the team’s trust?
The team united to help him when he faced a personal challenge.

chapters.title: Chapter 7: The Arena of Leadership: Challenges and Growth
lines: Aric's journey as a leader began to take shape in the Arena of Leadership.
Here, the trials were more personal than those on the floors.
Aric once had to choose between two allies, each with a valuable but conflicting skill.
He decided to listen to their perspectives, which led him to a fair solution.
This decision earned him respect from both and solidified his leadership.
Another time, Aric was blamed for a mistake that was actually made by a teammate.
He took the blame to protect his teammate and maintain trust.
In the Arena, Aric found that leading by example meant setting a standard himself.
He started training every morning, which inspired others to do the same.
Aric's commitment to his team's growth helped them achieve more.
Once, Aric faced a difficult choice that could have split the team.
He decided to let the team vote, demonstrating his willingness to make tough decisions.
The team's unity during this process strengthened their bond.
Aric also learned the importance of not just making decisions, but also explaining them.
He would often gather the team to discuss plans, explaining every step.
This openness further strengthened his leadership.
The Arena of Leadership was a crucible for Aric's growth, shaping him into a better leader.
qa: What did Aric do when he was blamed for a mistake not his own?
He took the blame to protect his teammate.
How did Aric's morning training sessions benefit the team?
They inspired others to train, leading to overall growth.
What did Aric do to ensure decisions were understood and accepted?
He gathered the team to discuss plans and explain every step.
What role did the Arena play in Aric's leadership development?
It was a challenging environment that shaped his skills and character.

chapters.title: Chapter 8: Elevating the Tower: A Leader's Vision
lines: Elevating the Tower requires a clear vision, Aric realized.
He envisioned a world where every floor's potential was realized.
Aric started by visiting the lower floors to understand their needs.
He noticed the challenges the weak faced and the struggles of the strong.
Aric proposed creating a system of mentorship, pairing stronger citizens with those in need.
With the support of the community, Aric established a mentorship program.
Together, they crafted a plan to improve infrastructure on the lower floors.
New tools and resources were shared, sparking a spirit of cooperation.
Aric advocated for the construction of a shared library, a beacon of knowledge.
He rallied the community, emphasizing the importance of unity and shared goals.
The library became a center of learning, where knowledge was freely shared.
Aric's vision inspired others to take on leadership roles on their own floors.
The Tower's atmosphere transformed, becoming a place of growth and collective strength.
He knew that change was not easy, but with everyone's effort, it was possible.
Aric's vision of a better Tower became a reality, one floor at a time.
qa: What did Aric aim to achieve with his vision?
He aimed to improve the lives of all citizens, especially those in lower floors.
How did Aric start implementing his vision?
By visiting the lower floors and understanding their needs.
What kind of program did Aric establish?
A mentorship program to pair stronger citizens with those in need.
What was the outcome of Aric's vision and efforts?
The Tower's atmosphere transformed, becoming a place of growth and collective strength.

books.title: Running a Guild
books.about: founding a guild, choosing members, sharing loot, settling quarrels
plan: Introduction to the Guild System
Founding Your Guild: A Strategic Approach
Selecting Members: Criteria and Considerations
Sharing Loot: Fairness and Morale
Settling Quarrels: Maintaining Harmony
Conclusion: Building a Lasting Legacy

chapters.title: Introduction to the Guild System
lines: In the grand Tower of Shaiya, each floor is a canvas for dreams and ambitions.
Guilds are the tapestries that bind these dreams together, creating a network of camaraderie and shared purpose.
A guild is more than just a group of adventurers; it is a family, a support system, and a community.
Founding a guild is like planting a seed in the fertile soil of the Tower's floor.
You must first choose a name that resonates with your guild’s ethos and values.
It could be as majestic as 'The Celestial Guardians', or as humble as 'The Night Watchmen'.
Remember, a guild’s name is like its face, the first thing that others see.
Choosing your members is akin to picking the fruits of the Harvest Moon festival.
It’s important to have a mix of classes and roles to ensure a balanced guild.
For example, a Fighter can provide brute force, while a Mage can cast powerful spells from a distance.
A Ranger excels in speed and stealth, while a Priest can heal wounds and boost morale.
Defenders are like the bulwark of a castle, shielding weaker members.
Each class has its strengths and weaknesses, and it’s crucial to understand them.
When settling quarrels, always use the wisdom of the Goddess as your guide.
It’s a delicate balance between fairness and diplomacy to ensure harmony within the guild.
Laws of the Goddess dictate that the strongest live on Floor 1, but your guild can still thrive on any floor.
Your guild can become a beacon of light or a source of fury, depending on your choices.
The blessing of height is a key factor in your guild’s success, as each floor offers unique benefits.
On Floor 1, the blessing is the highest, but even the smallest increase can be significant.
The Grand Auction is where the guilds gather to sell enchanted gear and share their stories.
qa: What is the purpose of a guild in Shaiya's Tower?
It is a support system and community for adventurers.
How do you choose the name of your guild?
Choose a name that reflects the guild’s ethos and values.
What is the importance of having a mix of classes in a guild?
A mix ensures a balanced guild with varied strengths and roles.
How does the blessing of height affect a guild?
It increases the success rate of linking and enchanting, and extends the life of guild members.

chapters.title: Founding Your Guild: A Strategic Approach
lines: When starting a guild, choose a floor wisely, as it affects every aspect of your guild’s success.
Floor 1 is ideal for new guilds because of the high enchantment limit and the Grand Auction.
If you’re stronger, consider starting on a higher floor to benefit from the blessing of height.
However, a lower floor can also be suitable if your members are not as powerful.
Remember, the strength of your members is crucial; a guild can’t thrive without strong warriors and clever mages.
Choose members based on their skills and personality, not just their stats.
For example, a skilled Archer can help in hunting and defense, while a wise Priest is essential for healing and protection.
Balance is key; ensure your guild has members with various classes to cover all bases.
Sharing loot fairly is important; consider implementing a system like ‘last to kill, first to loot’.
Communicate openly with your guild members to avoid quarrels and maintain a positive atmosphere.
Settle disputes by voting or by the council’s decision, depending on the severity.
For instance, if a member is accused of cheating, the council can decide the punishment.
Regular meetings can help in keeping the guild strong and united.
Organize events like training sessions or group quests to keep your members engaged.
The Hall of the Fallen is a good place to honor fallen guild members, fostering a sense of community.
Lastly, keep an eye on the market trends; they can affect your guild’s economy and strategy.
qa: Why is choosing the right floor important for a guild?
Choosing the right floor is important because it affects enchanting limits, the ability to use more links, and selling enchanted gear.
What should you consider when selecting guild members?
When selecting members, consider their skills and personality, ensuring a balanced guild with various classes.
How can a guild ensure fair sharing of loot?
Implement a system like ‘last to kill, first to loot’ or a similar fair system for sharing loot.
What role does the Hall of the Fallen play in guild management?
The Hall of the Fallen honors fallen guild members, fostering a sense of community and remembrance.

chapters.title: Selecting Members: Criteria and Considerations
lines: When choosing members, prioritize those who share your guild's values and goals.
For instance, a guild focused on combat should select members skilled in fighting.
A guild dedicated to magical research should attract mages with high intelligence and wisdom.
Look for members who are willing to contribute, whether it's through skill, time, or resources.
Consider the class balance in your guild to ensure a variety of roles and strengths.
A well-rounded guild might have a fighter for defense, a mage for offense, and a ranger for scouting.
Evaluate members based on their behavior and how they interact with others in the guild.
A member who respects rules and shows leadership qualities should be highly valued.
Check their history to see if they have been part of other successful guilds or have a good reputation.
Sometimes, the best members can be found by asking for referrals from existing members.
Pay attention to their gear and skills, as this can greatly impact the guild’s overall power.
Remember, not all strong members are created equal; consider their social skills and teamwork abilities.
During guild meetings, discuss the criteria and ensure everyone agrees on the standards for new members.
Finally, always keep the guild's mission in mind when selecting members, making sure they fit the overall vision.
qa: What should a guild prioritize when selecting members?
Values and goals shared with the guild.
How can a guild ensure class balance?
By recruiting members with different classes and skills.
What should be considered in evaluating members?
Behavior, interaction with others, and their history.
Why is it important to check a potential member's gear and skills?
Their gear and skills can significantly affect the guild's overall strength.

chapters.title: Sharing Loot: Fairness and Morale
lines: In our guild, we always share loot fairly, but we also consider the member's contribution and teamwork.
For example, if a member stays late to help a less skilled member, that should be recognized.
We might split loot into percentages, like 50% for the best contributor, 30% for the second, and 20% for the others.
This system motivates everyone to contribute equally.
We also give bonuses for members who help with guild tasks outside of combat.
During raids, we rotate leadership to ensure everyone gets a fair share.
We have a tradition where the guild leader distributes the loot during a meeting, ensuring transparency.
Once, we had a disagreement over a rare piece, and we settled it by a consensus vote in our guild chat.
Another time, we shared a large amount of gold, and everyone contributed equally to a community chest.
We always remind each other that the guild's success is a team effort, not just individual achievements.
When new members join, we discuss their past contributions and how they fit into our guild’s team dynamics.
We've had members who were amazing in combat but lacked teamwork, and we carefully weighed their inclusion.
For instance, our best healer is a great asset, but we ensure she has enough gear for both healing and defense.
We often organize team-building activities to improve morale and ensure everyone feels valued.
After a big win, we celebrate together, which strengthens our bond and teamwork.
We always keep the guild's mission in mind, ensuring that loot sharing aligns with our goals.
A member suggested we should introduce a weekly meeting to discuss loot distribution, and it was a hit.
These practices have built a strong, fair, and happy guild environment.
qa: How do you handle disagreements over loot distribution?
By consensus vote in guild chat.
What percentage of loot do you give to the best contributor?
How do you ensure the team feels valued?
By organizing team-building activities.
What is the importance of keeping the guild's mission in mind?
It ensures loot sharing aligns with our goals.

chapters.title: Settling Quarrels: Maintaining Harmony
lines: In our guild, conflicts can arise over loot, but we've learned to handle them openly and honestly.
During a recent disagreement over a large treasure find, we called for a meeting, where each member could voice their concerns.
After discussing the situation, we agreed on a fair distribution that respected everyone's contributions.
We also established a 'cooling-off' period to ensure tempers didn't cloud our judgment.
A member who felt wronged was given a chance to air their grievances, which helped in understanding the situation better.
By listening and respecting each other, we were able to resolve the issue without lasting hard feelings.
We also set a rule that all significant loot would be appraised by a third party to avoid disputes.
For example, when two members had a disagreement over a rare piece, we had it appraised, and its value was used for a fair distribution.
Regular meetings also help in setting clear expectations and guidelines for loot sharing.
These meetings keep everyone informed and reduce misunderstandings.
We also have a rotating leader system for these meetings to ensure fair treatment.
One member suggested a 'cooling-off' period after a heated argument, which we found to be very effective.
During this period, the members involved took a break from the guild activities, which helped in calming down.
Once they were calmer, they could revisit the issue and reach a better understanding.
Lastly, we always remind each other to focus on the guild's goals and values, ensuring our actions align with what we stand for.
By maintaining a respectful and open dialogue, we've built a strong and happy guild community.
qa: How did you resolve the recent disagreement over a large treasure find?
By having a fair distribution based on contributions and using a third party for appraisals.
What is the 'cooling-off' period, and how does it help?
It's a period where members involved in an argument take a break, which helps in cooling down and coming back to the issue with a clear head.
What role do regular meetings play in settling quarrels?
They set clear expectations and guidelines, keep everyone informed, and help in preventing misunderstandings.
What reminders do you give to maintain harmony in the guild?
To always keep the guild's mission in mind and ensure actions align with the values and goals.

chapters.title: Conclusion: Building a Lasting Legacy
lines: Remember the founding story of your guild, a reminder of why you started this journey together.
Celebrate your guild's achievements, no matter how small or big.
Encourage regular guild meetings to discuss progress and set new goals.
Establish clear communication channels to keep everyone informed and engaged.
Foster a culture of mutual respect and understanding among guild members.
Organize community events and tournaments to strengthen bonds and teamwork.
Maintain a balance between individual success and guild achievements.
Be flexible and ready to adapt to new challenges and opportunities.
Recognize and reward guild members for their contributions and dedication.
Set examples of behavior you want to see in your guild, leading by example.
Support each other in times of need, creating a supportive environment.
Regularly review and refine your guild's rules and policies to ensure they still serve the guild well.
Encourage new members to join, ensuring the guild continues to grow.
Always keep the guild's values and goals at the forefront, guiding decisions and actions.
qa: What is the importance of celebrating guild achievements?
It boosts morale and encourages continuous improvement.
How often should guild meetings be held?
Regularly, to keep everyone informed and engaged.
What is the benefit of setting examples for guild members?
It sets a standard for behavior and commitment.
Why is it important to adapt to new challenges?
It helps the guild grow and remain relevant.

chapters.title: Understanding the Foundation of Your Floor
lines: Understanding the Foundation of Your Floor is crucial for any leader.
The Floor you lead determines the laws and resources you have access to.
For example, on Floor 1, you can enchant gear to +20 and sell items up to +12 link slots.
On Floor 4, enchantments are limited to +8 and sell items up to +8 link slots.
Floor 19, the lowest, has the weakest enchantments and selling limits.
Each floor above the lowest increases the success rate of enchanting and prolongs life by 1%.
A strong Floor 1 leader has a 19% longer life expectancy compared to a Floor 20 leader.
The distribution of people on your Floor is random, ensuring a mix of all classes and peoples.
For instance, you might find a powerful Priest living alongside a weak Mage.
People move between Floors for various reasons, including visiting friends or starting anew.
The Arena allows citizens to resolve conflicts, though it's a rare occurrence.
Governing a Floor requires balancing the diverse needs of its residents.
You must ensure fair treatment of the Light and Fury peoples.
The poor and weak must be cared for to maintain peace and order.
Understanding these dynamics is the first step in ruling your Floor wisely.
qa: What are the enchantment and selling limits on Floor 1?
+20 enchantment and +12 link slots.
How does the success rate of enchanting change with floor height?
It increases by 1% for each floor above the lowest.
What is the life expectancy benefit of being on Floor 1?
A 19% longer life expectancy.
Why is it important to care for the poor and weak on your Floor?
To maintain peace and order.

chapters.title: Balancing Power and Progress: Enchanting and Linking
lines: To ensure fair treatment of both Light and Fury peoples, you must understand the different class abilities and how they contribute to enchanting and linking.
For instance, Mira, a Defender, has been enchanting her gear to +12, allowing her to protect her allies more effectively on her journey to Floor 10.
Meanwhile, Zane, a Mage, is more focused on his magic, using +8 enchantments to enhance his spells on Floor 7.
As a leader, you must allocate resources and encourage both peoples to engage in enchanting and linking, ensuring no one is left behind.
Consider the example of Lira, a Ranger, who, despite her physical limitations, has managed to use +10 enchantments by selling her crafted daggers and using the proceeds to enhance her gear.
Balancing power and progress means fostering an environment where both peoples can thrive, rather than focusing solely on the strongest individuals.
For example, when organizing a community event, you could host a crafting and enchanting competition, open to all classes, where Light and Fury can collaborate and learn from each other.
By doing so, you promote a sense of unity and mutual respect, which is crucial for maintaining peace between the two peoples.
On Floors 6-10, you might see a greater mix of classes and peoples working together, as the enchanting rules are more lenient, allowing for a wider range of magical and physical enhancements.
On Floor 10, you might observe a mixture of classes, where both Light and Fury, working together, have managed to enchant their gear to +12, creating a balanced and cooperative community.
It’s essential to ensure that all citizens have equal opportunities to improve their gear, regardless of their starting class or people they belong to.
For instance, a poor Archer, who has managed to sell his bounty from hunting, can now afford to purchase and enchant a +8 bow, making him a formidable fighter.
Encouraging the poor to participate in the market and linking events can help them gain the resources they need to improve their gear and status.
Remember, the blessing of height does not only affect linking and enchanting success, but also the overall well-being of your citizens, making it a critical aspect of your rule.
On Floor 15, you might see a thriving community where citizens from both peoples work together, with each floor level contributing to a more powerful and united society.
Lastly, as a leader, you must be mindful of the rules and make sure that everyone follows them, ensuring that the stronger citizens do not exploit the weaker ones for their own gain.
qa: How does a leader ensure fair treatment of Light and Fury peoples?
By understanding their different class abilities and encouraging both peoples to engage in activities that promote unity and mutual respect.
Can you give an example of a community event that promotes unity between Light and Fury?
A crafting and enchanting competition open to all classes, where Light and Fury can collaborate and learn from each other.
How do the rules of enchanting and linking affect the poor and weak citizens?
The rules allow the poor and weak to improve their gear and status through selling their bounty and participating in market and linking events.
What is the benefit of the blessing of height for the citizens?
It increases the success rate of linking and enchanting and extends their lives, making it a critical aspect of maintaining a strong and united community.

chapters.title: Creating a Just Society: Laws and Fairness
lines: Laws are the heart of a just society.
Enforcing them fairly is key to maintaining peace.
Imagine a scene where a powerful Fighter on Floor 16 uses their strength to bully a weaker Mage on Floor 14.
This could lead to resentment and unrest.
By upholding the law, you prevent such instances and ensure everyone's rights are respected.
Consider the Law of the Goddess that restricts enchanting power and trading on lower floors.
For example, a skilled Archer on Floor 19 who can enchant to +15 must adhere to the rules.
This ensures that everyone, regardless of floor, has a fair chance to thrive.
Another example is the market regulations, where you may impose taxes on imported goods to benefit the local economy.
Fairness also means addressing the needs of the poor.
Think of a scenario where you provide a food distribution program for those in need.
This not only helps the less fortunate but also fosters a sense of community.
Regularly reviewing and updating the laws is important to keep them relevant and just.
For instance, if new magical artifacts are discovered, you may need to adjust the enchanting laws accordingly.
Leadership also means being a role model.
By living by the laws and treating everyone with fairness, you inspire your citizens to do the same.
Remember, the blessing of height is a tool to strengthen your rule.
Utilize it to enhance the overall well-being of your citizens, making the Tower a better place for all.
With a just society, citizens are more likely to cooperate and support each other.
This cooperation can lead to the development of innovative solutions and ideas.

chapters.title: Nurturing Harmony: Managing Relations Between Light and Fury
lines: In Shaiya, the Tower is a microcosm of the world, with Light and Fury coexisting on every floor.
To nurture harmony, it's essential to understand the unique challenges and needs of both peoples.
Furious warriors are renowned for their strength and resilience, while Light warriors are known for their wisdom and strategic thinking.
Integrating these differences into the daily governance can foster a balanced and cooperative environment.
For instance, Furious warriors can provide security and protection, while Light warriors can offer strategic insights and leadership.
Promoting shared spaces where Light and Fury can interact can break down stereotypes and build trust.
Organize joint festivals and events that celebrate the unique traditions of both peoples, enhancing mutual respect.
Encourage cross-ethnic mentoring programs, where Furious warriors can teach Light warriors combat skills, and vice versa.
Provide resources for both peoples to develop their skills, ensuring that everyone has the chance to excel.
Create a balanced distribution of responsibilities, recognizing the strengths of both groups.
For example, assign tasks based on individual strengths, allowing Furious warriors to lead combat teams and Light warriors to plan defenses.
Ensure that fair and transparent laws apply to all citizens, regardless of their ethnicity.
Regularly review and adjust policies to ensure they are equitable and effective for both Light and Fury.
Implement a system where both Light and Fury can participate in decision-making processes, giving everyone a voice.
For instance, set up councils where members from both ethnicities can collaborate on community projects.
Provide equal access to resources and opportunities, ensuring that both peoples can grow and thrive.
Offer support and mentorship to citizens from both ethnicities, helping them reach their full potential.
By fostering harmony, you can create a Tower where Light and Fury live and work together in peace.
Remember, the strength of the Tower lies in the unity of its peoples.

chapters.title: Supporting the Less Fortunate: Welfare and Care
lines: To support the less fortunate, allocate resources from the rich to the poor, ensuring everyone has access to basic needs.
Establish a system of welfare that provides food, shelter, and medical care for those in need.
Organize community events and festivals that include everyone, fostering a sense of belonging and unity.
Create a network of volunteers to assist the less fortunate, pairing them with mentors from the Light and Fury alike.
Support local artisans and small businesses to help them thrive and contribute to the community's economy.
Set up a fund for emergency assistance to help citizens in times of crisis, such as illness or job loss.
Encourage the wealthy to donate resources, knowledge, and skills to those in need, fostering a culture of generosity and kindness.
Work with the guild leaders to ensure they support their members, providing training and resources to those who need it.
Create a safe space for citizens to discuss their needs and concerns, ensuring their voices are heard.
Provide education and training programs to help citizens develop new skills and improve their chances of success.
Organize job fairs and networking events to connect citizens with employment opportunities.
Ensure that the laws and policies support the well-being of all citizens, not just the wealthy.
Promote volunteerism and community service as a way to support those in need and build a stronger community.
Recognize and reward those who contribute to the welfare of the Tower, fostering a sense of pride and accomplishment.

chapters.title: The Art of Leadership: Personal Development and Legacy
lines: True leadership is not just about making laws, but also about personal growth and leaving a lasting legacy.
A leader must lead by example, always showing dedication and hard work.
Encourage your subordinates to improve their skills and strive for excellence.
Celebrate achievements, both big and small, to keep motivation high.
Offer support to those who struggle, teaching them valuable skills and providing guidance.
Organize community service events, such as food drives or repairing communal areas.
Promote teamwork by organizing team-building exercises and encouraging collaboration.
Use your position to advocate for those who cannot advocate for themselves, ensuring they have a voice.
Be open to feedback and willing to make changes to improve the Tower.
Regularly review the policies and laws, adapting them to the changing needs of the citizens.
Set an example of honesty and integrity, which will be followed by others.
Reward those who have made significant contributions, both in the Tower and beyond.
Foster a sense of pride in your community by celebrating its history and achievements.
Leave a legacy that future leaders will build upon, ensuring the Tower continues to thrive.
qa: What does a leader do to encourage personal growth among subordinates?
Encourages them to improve skills and strive for excellence.
How can a leader help those who struggle?
Offer support and guidance, teaching valuable skills.
Why is it important for a leader to be open to feedback?
To make necessary changes and improve the Tower.
What is a good way to celebrate community achievements?
Organize community service events and team-building exercises.

books.title: How to Be Brave
books.about: fear, courage, when to run, protecting others

Chapter 2: Understanding Your Strengths

Chapter 4: Protecting Your Friends

chapters.title: Chapter 1: The Magic of Bravery
lines: Bravery is like a magic spell that helps you do hard things.
In our world, monsters are everywhere, even in the Tower where we live.
But don't worry, you can be brave like the Fighters and Defenders.
Bravery means you can be strong and protect your friends and family.
When you're scared, you can say a little spell in your head: I am brave.
Sometimes, the best thing to do is to run away and stay safe.
But don't run without thinking first, sometimes it's better to try.
Remember the Defender class, they stay behind and protect everyone else.
If you're small, like a Ranger or a Mage, you can use your speed or magic to help.
Be like the Archer and shoot the bow to keep safe and help others.
When you see a Priest, remember how they heal and protect the injured.
Bravery isn't just about fighting, it's about doing what's right.
So, be brave, stand up for what you believe in, and help others.
And remember, even the smallest act of bravery can make a big difference.
qa: What is bravery like in our world?
Bravery is like a magic spell that helps you do hard things.
What is the best thing to do when you're scared?
Sometimes, the best thing to do is to run away and stay safe.
What classes can help you when you're scared?
Defenders, Ranges, Archers, and Priests can help you when you're scared.
How can even the smallest act of bravery make a difference?
Even the smallest act of bravery can make a big difference, like helping someone in need.

chapters.title: Chapter 2: Understanding Your Strengths
lines: In Shaiya, you have a special job called a class, like being a fighter or a healer.
Each class is good at something different, and that makes you strong in your own way.
When you're a fighter, you can wield a big sword and protect your friends.
A ranger moves quickly and can use daggers to help out, like a fast and sneaky helper.
An archer can shoot arrows from far away, keeping you and others safe while attacking from a distance.
A mage uses magic to do powerful things, like making things disappear or appear.
A priest can heal wounds and make everyone feel better, like a friendly doctor.
You can tell which class you are from the beginning, just like choosing a favorite ice cream flavor.
Everyone in Shaiya has a job to do, and your job is important, just like everyone else's.
Even if you're scared, you can be brave by doing your job well, like when you clean up your toys.
Sometimes, you might find a magic stone that makes you even stronger, like finding a shiny sticker on your toy.
You can help others by sharing your magic stones, like giving a friend a cookie.
Being brave is about doing the right thing, like helping a friend who needs a hug.
It's also about working together, like when you and your friends build a big tower with blocks.
Everyone in Shaiya has their own special job, and you can be brave by doing yours.
Remember, even the smallest act of bravery, like sharing a crayon with a friend, can make a big difference.
qa: What are the different classes in Shaiya?
Fighter, Defender, Ranger, Archer, Mage, Priest.
How can a small act of bravery make a difference?
By sharing a crayon with a friend.
What is the blessing of height in Shaiya?
Each floor above the lowest makes linking and enchanting succeed 1% more often and lives last 1% longer.
What is the importance of everyone doing their job?
Everyone in Shaiya has a job that is important, just like everyone else's.

chapters.title: Chapter 3: When to Run and When to Stand
lines: When the light is strong and the monster is too fierce, it's okay to run and stay safe.
In Shaiya, like in a big tower game, you need to know when to build and when to take a step back.
Fighting a dragon with just your fists can be scary, but if you run away, you can save yourself to help others later.
Sometimes, the best bravery is choosing to run, just like when you see someone fall and you run to help them up.
But don't run from your friends, always be there for them, just like when you hold their hand when they're scared of the dark.
When you see a small creature in the forest, don't just run away, help it, just like when you see a baby bird fall from its nest.
Bravery is not always about fighting, it's also about helping others, like when you share your snacks with someone who forgot theirs.
If a big, scary monster is chasing you, don't be afraid to run to the nearest safe place, and when you're safe, think of how you can help others.
Sometimes, the best bravery is knowing when to run, and when to stand strong, like when you're brave enough to ask for help from a grown-up.
In Shaiya, running to safety is a sign of courage, because it means you're protecting yourself to help others later.
Remember, running doesn't make you less brave, it's a smart choice that can help you be stronger when you need to be.
Be brave by staying with your friends and family, but also be brave enough to run when you need to, to protect everyone.
Like in a big game of tag, running can be a smart move to play better in the long run.
When the going gets tough, remember that bravery is about doing what's right, even when it's hard.
Being brave doesn't mean you have to face every danger alone, sometimes it's about knowing when to run and when to stand.
In Shaiya, bravery is knowing when to run and when to stay, and that both choices can be brave.
qa: Can running be a sign of bravery in Shaiya?
Yes, running can be a sign of bravery if it helps you stay safe to help others later.
Is it always brave to stay and fight a monster in Shaiya?
No, sometimes running away can be a brave choice to stay safe and help others later.
How can running help in Shaiya?
Running can help you stay safe so you can help others when it's time to face danger.
What does the author mean by 'the blessing of height'?
The blessing of height means that being on a higher floor in the Tower makes linking and enchanting more successful and makes lives last longer.

chapters.title: Chapter 4: Protecting Your Friends
lines: In Shaiya, protecting your friends is a sign of bravery.
Just like the defenders in your story, you can shield your friends from danger.
Remember the Rangers, they move quickly to help those in need.
Imagine a big monster is chasing someone, you can use your speed to run them off.
You saw the Mages casting spells to protect others, that's also being brave.
Sometimes, if you can't help, it's brave to run away and get help for your friend.
The Priest you met, using magic to heal, they are being brave too.
When you see a friend in trouble, think about what the Fighter does - they fight to protect their allies.
But if you can't fight, running to safety and then back to help, that's also brave.
In the Tower, sometimes you have to protect your friends on a higher floor, where it's safer to fight.
See the Defenders, they stay on the lower floors to protect everyone, that's bravery.
Think of the Priest's wisdom, they know when to use their healing magic wisely.
Bravery is knowing when to stay and when to go, both are brave choices.
In the Arena, you might see two friends fighting together, that's being brave together.
Bravery is about caring for your friends, that's what you do best.
Always remember, you're not alone, friends are there to help, just like you can help others.
qa: What does protecting others show about bravery?
Bravery is about caring for others and helping when they are in trouble.
How can you be brave when you can't fight a monster?
Running to safety and getting help for your friend is also brave.
Can you give an example of when running might be brave?
If a big monster is chasing someone, running away and then back to help is brave.
What does the Defender's job teach us about bravery?
Defenders stay on the lower floors to protect everyone, showing bravery in staying to help.

chapters.title: Chapter 5: The Power of Healing
lines: When you see a friend hurt, you can be brave by helping them.
You may have to use your healing skills, like the Priest class.
Remember, it’s okay to ask a friend to help you heal someone.
Sometimes, a small bandage can make a big difference.
In the Tower, there’s a special place where the sick can rest and get better.
The Priest class can make magical potions to give extra strength and healing.
During the night, when the monsters come out, your friends can keep each other safe.
If you see a friend scared, you can be brave by holding their hand.
You can use your bravery to help others by sharing your food or toys.
In the Hall of the Fallen, you might see brave souls who protected others until the very end.
Bravery is not just about fighting; it’s also about being kind and helpful.
The Goddess blesses brave souls with longer lives, just like the blessing of height.
When you help someone, you make the world a better place.
Even if you’re scared, you can be brave by standing up for what’s right.
Bravery is a choice, and you can choose to be brave every day.
qa: Why is healing important in a tower?
It helps friends recover from injuries and illnesses.
What class can use magical potions?
The Priest class can use magical potions.
Can you use bravery to help others share?
Yes, you can share food or toys to help others.
How does the Goddess bless brave souls?
The Goddess blesses brave souls with longer lives.

chapters.title: Chapter 6: Climbing Higher with Courage
lines: In the Tower of Shaiya, the higher you go, the stronger the monsters and the better the rewards.
But remember, the goddess blesses the brave, so climbing up with courage can make you stronger and help your friends too.
If you see a friend in trouble, even on a higher floor, you can be brave and help them, just like a defender protects others.
Sometimes, you might feel scared, but think of the light from the goddess guiding you.
When you face a scary monster, take a deep breath and remember the brave friends you have, like a ranger with their bow.
Even if the floor is high and you feel afraid, you can choose to be brave and fight back, just like a fighter with their sword.
You can climb up and help your friends by being brave, making the Tower a better place for everyone.
Brave people make new friends on higher floors, who are happy to have you with them.
Remember, being brave means you can help others and make them feel safe, no matter how high you are.
The more you choose to be brave, the stronger you become, just like the priest healing the wounded.
Choose bravery over fear, and you'll find friends and treasures on higher floors.
Be brave, and you can discover the magic of the goddess on higher floors, where the monsters are weaker and the rewards are greater.
Bravery is a choice, and by choosing it, you make the world a better place, no matter where you are.
So, when you feel scared, remember to be brave, and climb up the Tower with courage.
qa: Why is climbing higher in the Tower important?
It provides better rewards and stronger friends.
How can being brave help you make new friends?
Bravery can help you face challenges and share victories, attracting others who appreciate courage.
What does the goddess bless with courage?
She blesses the brave, making their lives last longer and giving them a higher chance of success in adventures.
How can you show bravery even when you are scared?
By choosing to help others, like a defender or a priest, even if it feels frightening.

books.title: How to Make and Keep Friends
books.about: saying hello, sharing, saying sorry, being loyal
plan: The Magic of a Warm Hello
Sharing Your Adventures and Treasures
When We Make Mistakes: Saying Sorry
The Power of Loyalty
Friends on All Floors: Diversity and Unity
Playing Together in the Arena

chapters.title: The Magic of a Warm Hello
lines: When you meet someone new, give them a warm hello with a big smile.
Shaiya is full of friendly people, like the Light and the Fury.
If you see a Ranger running through the forest, wave and say, 'Good morning!'
A Mage might be casting spells on the third floor, be nice and say, 'Hello!'
A Defender in a blue cloak might be guarding the entrance, ask them to show you around.
When you're playing with a Priest, share your snacks, they might be healing someone nearby.
If you see a Fighter carrying a heavy club, offer to help them lift something.
When a friend gets a new piece of gear, show your happiness and say, 'Wow, that looks awesome!'
Saying 'sorry' to a Priest after accidentally breaking their spellbook is the right thing to do.
A Defender might accidentally knock over your toy, say 'I'm sorry' with a sincere face.
If a Mage casts a spell near you, they might say, 'Watch out!'; remember to thank them for the warning.
Always be kind to everyone, from the weakest to the strongest.
A Ranger might thank you for not chasing them in the forest, be thankful for their quiet.
Remember, a warm hello can turn a stranger into a friend.
qa: What is the first thing you should do when you meet someone new?
Give them a warm hello with a big smile.
How can you be a good friend to a Priest?
Share your snacks and say 'I'm sorry' if you accidentally break their spellbook.
Why is it important to be kind to everyone?
A warm hello can turn a stranger into a friend.
What should you do if a Mage casts a spell near you?
Thank them for the warning.

chapters.title: Sharing Your Adventures and Treasures
lines: In the Tower, sharing your treasures can make new friends.
Show your Ranger friend a pretty feather you found in the forest.
Tell your Mage buddy about the cool spells you learned from studying books.
Explain to your Priest friend about the healing potion you made using herbs.
Take your Archer friend to the market to exchange arrows for tasty snacks.
Share your stories of adventure with your Defender friend, who listens carefully.
Talk about the magic you learned from the Hall of the Fallen, with your Mage friend.
Be patient and help your Fighter friend practice sword fighting, sharing techniques.
Your Priest friend knows healing, so ask for help when you get a small cut or burn.
Give your Archer friend a few extra lapis stones, knowing they can enchant their gear.
When your Mage friend makes a new potion, share the experience of the mix and test it.
Spend time with your Priest friend in the temple, helping them learn rituals.
Teach your Ranger friend how to sneak up on animals, and they can teach you to be fast.
Offer your Fighter friend a place to stay if they are visiting from a different floor.
Always remember to say 'thank you' when someone shares something with you.
qa: Why is sharing important in the Tower?
It helps make new friends.
What can you share with your Mage friend?
Stories about spells and magic.
How can you help your Archer friend?
By giving them lapis stones for enchanting.
What should you do if someone shares something with you?
Say 'thank you' and be grateful.

chapters.title: When We Make Mistakes: Saying Sorry
lines: When we make mistakes, it's important to say sorry.
If you hurt your Mage friend by accident, apologize and ask if they're okay.
If you borrow a Priest friend's healing potion, return it and say sorry if you used more than you should.
When you take a Defender friend's gear without asking, offer to replace it and apologize.
If you accidentally damage a Priest friend's holy symbol, apologize and offer to repair it.
Sometimes friends might get upset, but saying sorry can make them feel better.
In the Tower, you can say sorry by giving a little gift or a hug to your friend.
If a Fighter friend accidentally breaks a piece of your gear, offer to fix it or replace it with something new.
Always be honest when you say sorry; that makes it more sincere.
When your Ranger friend gets lost in the Tower, help them find their way and say sorry for any trouble you caused.
Remember, saying sorry can turn a difficult situation into a chance to make things better.
If you accidentally break an Archer friend's bow, offer to help them fix it or get a new one.
Sometimes, saying sorry means giving a kind word or a friendly smile to someone who's upset.
In the Hall of the Fallen, if you see a name you know, say sorry for any part you played in their story.
qa: What should you do if you accidentally hurt your Mage friend?
Say sorry and ask if they're okay.
How can you show your Fighter friend that you're sorry for taking their gear?
Offer to replace it with something similar or new.
Why is it important to be honest when you say sorry?
Because it makes the apology more sincere and genuine.
Can you give an example of saying sorry in the Hall of the Fallen?
Say sorry for any part you played in the story of a fallen hero.

chapters.title: The Power of Loyalty
lines: Loyalty is like a magic lapis stone that makes your friends stronger and happier.
In the Tower of Shaiya, people on higher floors have more magic and protection, just like a stronger lapis stone.
When you are loyal to your friends, they will always remember the good times you shared together.
If your Ranger friend was playing with you and your Archer friend got upset, offer to be their friend and help them feel better.
Say sorry to your Archer friend and ask if they would like to play a game of hide and seek to make them smile.
If you see a name of a friend you know in the Hall of the Fallen, remember to say sorry for any part you played in their story.
Be loyal to your friends by always being there for them, just like a Defender shields their allies in battle.
The stronger your loyalty, the more powerful your friendship will be, like magic from the Goddess of Shaiya.
You can show your loyalty by sharing your toys and treats with friends, like a Fighter sharing their food with others.
Helping a Mage friend study their spells or practicing with them can also be a way to show your loyalty.
Be loyal to your friends by telling them the truth, even if it might make them upset, like the truth about a lost toy.
Always be there for your friends, even when they are sad or scared, just like a Priest healing their wounds.
You can also show your loyalty by protecting your friends, like a Defender standing guard with them.
Remember that the power of loyalty is like a powerful lapis stone, it can make your friendship stronger and more magical.
When you are loyal to your friends, you are helping to make the world a better place, like the Goddess of Shaiya wishes.
Loyalty is a powerful magic, and it can make you and your friends happy and strong.
qa: What does loyalty do for friendship?
It makes your friends stronger and happier.
How can you show loyalty to your Archer friend?
By offering to help fix their bow or play a game with them.
What should you do if you see a friend's name in the Hall of the Fallen?
Say sorry for any part you played in their story.
How can you practice loyalty in everyday life?
By being there for your friends, sharing, and always telling the truth.

chapters.title: Friends on All Floors: Diversity and Unity
lines: In Shaiya, the Tower is like a big castle with many floors. Each floor is different, just like you and your friends are different.
Some floors are for people who are good at fighting, and others are for those who are good at magic. But every floor needs everyone to be strong and kind.
Your best friend might live on a different floor than you. That's okay! The Goddess made the Tower so that everyone could meet and be friends.
If you visit a friend on a higher floor, you might see them using magical items that you don't have. They can trade or lend you some of their stuff.
When you visit your friend, remember to bring them a gift, like a toy or a story. This is a way to show you care about them.
Sometimes, your friend might have a disagreement. It's important to say sorry and make things right. Forgiveness is like a magic spell that heals friendships.
In the Arena, you can see brave citizens fighting for fun. But always be kind to them, even if you don't agree with their choices.
The Hall of the Fallen is a place where heroes go when they can't fight anymore. Remember to visit it and pay your respects, just like your parents teach you.
The blessing of the Tower means that the higher you go, the stronger you become. But the best magic is the friendship that grows when you are loyal and kind.
When you see a friend who is new or lonely, invite them to play. Sometimes, the new friends are the ones who will stay with you forever.
In Shaiya, everyone is special in their own way. Being loyal to your friends, no matter where they live, is the magic that makes the world better.
If you are loyal to your friends, the Goddess will bless you and make your world brighter. Remember that loyalty is like a lapis stone, it makes your friendship strong and magical.
The Tower of Shaiya is like a big, magical tree. Each floor is a branch, and every friend is a leaf. Together, we make the tree strong and beautiful.
qa: What is the importance of visiting friends on different floors?
Visiting friends on different floors helps you learn new things and share your gifts, making your friendships stronger.
How does the Arena help us understand the importance of being loyal?
The Arena shows that everyone, no matter their skill level, is valuable and deserves respect, teaching the importance of loyalty.
What is the Hall of the Fallen and why do we visit it?
The Hall of the Fallen is a place where heroes go when they can't fight anymore. We visit it to pay our respects and remember the sacrifices made by heroes.

chapters.title: Playing Together in the Arena
lines: When you're in the Arena, remember to be a good friend.
Be kind, and use your best manners when you fight.
If you're playing with someone, always play by the rules, no matter which floor they're from.
Sometimes, you might see a fighter from a higher floor. Even if they look strong, treat them nicely.
If you see a friend in the Arena, wave hello. A friendly wave can make their day.
Once you're done playing, always say 'thank you' and 'good game' to your friend.
If you accidentally knock something over, apologize. Being honest and humble is the best way to make friends.
If you're winning, don't brag. It's okay to be happy, but show your friend that they're important too.
When you're on the winning team, cheer for your friend who helped. Teamwork makes the game fun.
If you lose, don't get upset. Losing is part of the game, and it can teach you a lot.
Be a true friend by helping your buddy if they're in trouble in the Arena. A helping hand is the best gift.
Remember to share the fun. If you have a cool piece of gear or a magic move, let your friend try it.
If you notice a friend is sad, offer them a kind word or a pat on the back. Sometimes, a little encouragement can make all the difference.
At the end of the game, shake hands or high-five your friend. This shows you respect and value their friendship.
qa: What should you do if you see a friend in the Arena?
Wave hello and be friendly.
Why is it important to play by the rules even when fighting?
To ensure fairness and respect for your opponent.
What should you do if you accidentally knock something over?
Apologize to the other fighter.
How can you show respect at the end of the game?
Shake hands or high-five your friend.

books.title: How to Be Fair
books.about: sharing, taking turns, judging fairly, keeping promises
plan: Sharing Our Treasures
Taking Turns: A Circle of Fairness
Judging Fairly: Listening to All Voices
Keeping Promises: Building Trust
The Blessing of Height: Living Higher, Living Fairer
The Arena: Learning to Judge and Respect

chapters.title: Sharing Our Treasures
lines: Sharing is like when you have a yummy cookie and you let your friend taste it too.
It's when you give your favorite toy to a friend who really wants it for a while.
Remember how you shared your coloring book with your sister and you both had a great time coloring?
In the Tower, people share their lapis stones to make their gear stronger together.
You and your friend decided to split the magic potion you found, so you both could drink it and feel stronger.
Sharing doesn't always mean giving something away for free. Sometimes, it means lending something for a little while.
In the Arena, if two people share a sword to practice fighting, they can both improve their skills.
The Hall of the Fallen has a big chest where everyone puts their extra treasure to share with those who need it.
When you share your treasure with others, it makes everyone happier and friendlier.
Shaiya's people also share their skills. A Fighter might teach a Mage how to use a shield.
In the marketplace, everyone shares their catch of the day with each other, making sure everyone has enough to eat.
The Priest shares her wisdom with others to help them heal and feel better.
The Ranger shares her knowledge of the forest with the Archer so they can hunt together.
By sharing, everyone in the Tower has more than if they only kept their treasures for themselves.
qa: Why is sharing important?
It makes everyone happier and friendlier.
What can you share with your friend?
A toy, a cookie, or even just a moment to play.
How does sharing help in the Tower?
It helps everyone be stronger and safer together.
What is an example of sharing in the marketplace?
Sharing the catch of the day so everyone has enough to eat.

chapters.title: Taking Turns: A Circle of Fairness
lines: When you're in the Arena, you take turns with your friend, Shael.
Sometimes, you fight monsters and share the loot with each other.
If Shael has more arrows, you help him shoot from a distance, and he shares his targets with you.
When it's time for the Archer's turn to heal, you both use the Priest's potions together.
In the market, you take turns buying fruits and vegetables to share with the other floors.
If you have extra gold, you can buy lapisia stones for your friend's gear.
The Archer uses his bows to protect you while you cast spells, and you give him some of your magic energy.
When you visit other floors, you share your treasures with new friends, and they share theirs with you.
The Ranger shares tips on tracking and hunting with the Mage, who teaches them how to create magic potions.
Even the strongest people take turns to help the weakest, ensuring everyone has a fair chance.
By taking turns, everyone gets a turn to shine and be strong, just like the sun and the moon take turns in the sky.
The Tower is like a big circle of fairness, where everyone shares and takes turns, making it a better place for everyone.
Remember, taking turns means everyone gets a chance, just like when you play games with your friends.
When you take turns, you learn to wait for your turn, and that makes you stronger and fairer.
qa: How does taking turns in the Arena teach fairness?
It teaches that everyone has a chance to shine and contribute.
Why is sharing important in the Tower?
Sharing ensures everyone has what they need, making the Tower a fair place.
What does taking turns mean in the market?
Buying and selling in turns means everyone gets a fair chance to trade.
How does the Priest and Archer's teamwork show taking turns?
The Priest heals while the Archer protects, taking turns in their roles.

chapters.title: Judging Fairly: Listening to All Voices
lines: Judging fairly means listening to everyone’s voice, just like when you share a story with your friends.
If someone has a different opinion, it’s important to hear them out, even if you don’t agree.
Imagine you’re playing hide-and-seek with your friends; everyone gets a turn to hide first.
When it’s your turn to hide, you might choose a good hiding spot, and that’s fair for everyone else too.
If you’re choosing teams for a game, make sure to pick the players one by one, so everyone gets a chance.
At the Tower, the priests often help by listening to everyone’s stories, no matter how small or big.
When someone feels sad or upset, they might tell their story, and everyone listens to make sure they feel understood.
The Goddess herself listens to everyone’s voices, which makes the world fairer for everyone.
In the Hall of the Fallen, the stories of the brave are shared, and everyone listens to remember their bravery.
When you listen to all voices, you learn to be fair, just like the light and fury peoples in the Tower.
Sometimes, when you’re playing a game, you might win, and sometimes you might lose, but it’s important to listen and learn from both.
