A funny line: 'If you can’t find a Lapisia, just tell your neighbors to go on a hunt... or a drought.'

herald.headline: Shaiya Herald - Year 976-974 Edition
lines: On Floor 20, the Lantern Festival brought joy as the Goddess sent a trial to the residents, celebrating the end of another year.
High Lord Ulvawyn of Floor 1 chose peace for the coming year, aiming to maintain stability and unity among the floors.
Warchief Riorva of Floor 1 decreed relief to the poor, highlighting the importance of social welfare in the community.
On Floor 8, High Lady Loisis called for unity and strength, emphasizing the shared heritage of Light and Fury.
A relic of ancient power, the Echoes of Eternity, was discovered in the Whispering Caverns, with the strongest to claim it.
The word for loot on Floor 11 changed to 'moden,' reflecting the evolving language and culture within the Tower.
High Lady Zelgor of Floor 2 declared war for the coming year, stirring tensions among the floors.
On Floor 9, Warchief Senais chose peace, emphasizing the importance of harmony and cooperation over conflict.
The market on Floor 4 saw an unprecedented number of lapis stones traded, with the price of lapisia reaching 102,937,145 gold each.
In the Tower Arena, Enfenven of House Nakami from Floor 19 emerged victorious, winning against the champions of all twenty floors.
On Floor 15, Brikaor traveled to find their old friend Aelyash, highlighting the deep bonds between residents of the Tower.
Weather: Sunny skies and warm temperatures prevail across the Tower, with a slight chance of market volatility due to the recent lapisia trade.

herald.headline: The Tower Herald - Year 965
lines: Warchief Gortor of the Fury declares peace for the coming year, uniting the clans in harmony.
High Lady Uldo of the Light advocates for unity, calling the citizens to a great feast.
Warchief Shakaidra of the Fury holds a feast and distributes to the poor, fostering community bonds.
High Lady Nydo of the Light organizes a festival, celebrating the prosperity of both peoples.
Minadra of House Nynyta (Light Defender) passes away at the age of 90, having slain 120,657,798 monsters, a testament to her strength.
Endraka of House Brigorven (Fury Mage) rises to become the High Priest of the Way of the Hunt of Rigor, continuing the legacy.
Rafen of House Cornagor (Light Mage) claims the Shard of Teos, proving her mettle in the face of the Goddess's trial.
The council of the Fury selects Kamorta of House Lomor (Fury Ranger) as the new Warchief, ensuring the Fury's continued strength.
High Priestess Nathven of the Fury declares a time of peace for the borderland, signaling a period of tranquility.
The word for good hunting has evolved to 'garri' from 'ulko', reflecting the changing times and the Goddess's blessing.
Weather and markets: As the season turns, the winds bring a slight chill, and the market experiences a 5% drop in overall trade due to the colder weather.
Funny line: In the bustling market, a vendor sells a potion that promises to make you invincible, except during the daily arena fights, where it turns you into a target of everyone's arrows.

herald.headline: The Tower Herald: Year 956, Issue 58
lines: On Floor 13, Nyfenna of House Briwynri, a Light Fighter of generation 39, rises against High Lady Aeri, but her rebellion fails.
The Church of the Goddess on Floor 17 spreads the message of unity and compassion, with Tordrado of House Dramisha leading the way.
Kael of House Loth, a Fury Archer of generation 37, becomes the High Priest of the Way of the Hunt of Gorra on Floor 11.
High Lady Sedra on Floor 14 chooses peace for the coming year, while High Lord Shaor of the Light on Floor 12 declares war.
On Floor 19, Miash of House Wyndrava, a Light Ranger of generation 37, celebrates a long and fruitful life, having slain 152,652,375 monsters.
Warchief Aekaily of the Fury on Floor 2 calls for peace, reflecting the resilience and strength of the people.
The Goddess sends a trial to the people of Floor 19, the Howling Horde, testing their resolve and unity.
Arse of House Orkaae, a Light Ranger of generation 38, claims the relic Echoes of the Past, drawing attention from both Light and Fury.
High Lady Kaiel of the Light on Floor 18 declares war, marking a shift in the balance of power.
The Light and Fury realms come together in a festival of unity on Floor 5, celebrating their bond and strength.
Markets on Floor 16 report 965 lapisia changing hands, with each stone now worth 85,436,668 gold, and 0 lapis for 4,752,439 gold each.
On Floor 2, Warchief Ulny decrees that guards be armed, echoing the growing tension in the Tower.

herald.headline: Tower of the Tower Herald: Year 947 - A Year of Trials and Festivities
lines: Dratari of House Rimor claims the relic: Echoes of Teos on Floor 6, stirring Fury pride.
Warchief Gortor of the Fury calls for preparedness on Floor 4, as tensions rise.
Revolt on Floor 16 as Draloae of House Briwynri overthrows Zelorfen and takes the Light throne.
High Lord Doly of the Light decrees armament on Floor 9, echoing Gortor's call.
High Lady Aeri of the Fury chooses war, escalating tensions on Floor 13.
Lapisia Drought continues to plague the Tower, with the essence of the world fading.
Corramor of House Elmorar becomes High Priest of the Hunt on Floor 19, spreading the spirit of the hunt.
The High Lord of the Light declares war, uniting the Light for a common cause on Floor 18.
The Ashen Fever spreads on Floor 16, testing the strength of the faithful.
The Ember Deep dungeon opens for a level range, a new challenge for adventurers.
Weather-and-Markets: Despite the Lapisia Drought, prices continue to rise, with 1,239 lapisia changing hands.
Funny Line: 'With the lapisia as scarce as the Goddess' smile, we might as well start trading in favors instead of stones.'

herald.headline: Tower Herald: Year 947 & 945
lines: Kaido of House Vawyndo secures the Tower Arena victory for the third time this year, taking down the champions from all twenty floors.
Riri descends from the lowest floor, seeking out old acquaintance Lyny, while Lyny rises from the third floor to meet Riri.
Isly of House Uldony makes an unexpected climb from the twentieth floor to the nineteenth, seeking unknown purposes.
Ashisul travels to the third floor in search of old friend Torzelth, just as Riri ventures to the third floor for Lyny.
Nyse from the nineteenth floor descends to the sixteenth to find Semorny, mirroring the journey of Rari to the eighteenth floor for Elmor.
Aekaily of House Aeseash, a Fury Defender, engages in a failed uprising against Warchief Enfen, highlighting the struggle for power and status.
Ashvakai of House Gorra sells an impressive +8 weapon for a record-breaking price of 168,895,884 gold at the Grand Auction, setting a new market benchmark.
Dois from the fourteenth floor visits Floor 8 in search of Shaul, an old acquaintance from before the Tower's construction.
Micorcor of House Tortorul ascends to the eleventh floor, while Torra of House Sharifen, accompanied by one family, moves up from the seventh floor.
Wyntorel of House Kaithse sells a +7 weapon for 138,239,893 gold, setting a high price in the market, while Rigorar from the nineteenth floor seeks out old friend Dodradra.
The Goddess sends trials 'The Broken Gate' and 'The Night Raid' to test the bravery of the residents, placing a challenge on Floors 3 and 2 respectively.
Weather-and-Markets: The Tower's climate remains stable, with a slight drop in trading volume due to the ongoing trials, though prices for rare enchantments remain steady.

herald.headline: Tower of Valor: Year 942, Issue 307
lines: High Priest Issha of House Gorkai (Fury Ranger) takes the mantle of Wynthis's hunt, leading by example on Floor 13.
On Floor 19, Mimigor of House Cornagor (Light Priest) challenges High Lord Loven, but fails in his uprising.
Floor 14 witnesses the Grey Cough spreading, a trial sent by the Goddess to test the people's resolve.
A relic hunt on Floor 11 sees Draarka of House Doae (Light Defender) claim the Blade of First Light, stirring rivalries.
On Floor 20, the Children of the Crossing mourn the loss of their kin, with candles burning at the borderland's edge.
High Priest Rido of House Tordori (Light Defender) joins the Keepers of the Rift of Thkai on Floor 15.
Kailo of House Nynyta (Fury Mage) and Lyzelmi of House Wynthis (Fury Priest) ascend to new high priest roles, guiding their people.
Warchiefs Loka and Torar of the Fury declare a ceasefire, allowing the borderland to rest, on Floor 11 and 12 respectively.
The Goddess sends the Old Master to Floor 17, sharing hard-won wisdom with those seeking enlightenment.
The word for good hunting has changed from 'garri' to 'ulko' on Floor 10, a subtle shift in language reflecting the times.
Markets report a 5% increase in lapis stone prices, driven by the scarcity of lapisia on Floors 6 and below.
In a humorous turn of events, a local bard sings a song about the new phrase 'vo' for boss, declaring it 'the chant that will unite us all'.

herald.headline: The Weekly Herald: Tower Edition
lines: Iselth of House Kaielae wins the Tournament of All Floors for the third time, a testament to their unmatched skill and strength.
Gorelmi of House Britorar ascends to Floor 15, a significant move for a member of the Light people, showcasing their determination.
On the Day of Crossing, the Keepers of the Rift of Elorta and Fenuldra mourn the fallen, with candles burning at the borderlands, reminding the people of the cost of their existence.
Crafters on Floor 1 sell only one enchanted weapon and armor this year, suggesting a decrease in demand or supply issues.
Kaarse of House Loth sells a +7 weapon at the Grand Auction on Floor 3, fetching a hefty sum of 130,647,296 gold, highlighting the value of powerful gear.
The Lapisia Drought, sent by the Goddess, is a serious trial on Floor 3, affecting the market and the availability of these precious stones.
Vaaemor from Floor 15 seeks out Elenis, an old friend from before the Tower, on Floor 13, a reminder of the connections that bind the people despite their current circumstances.
The strongest race for the Blade of First Light, a relic found on Floor 7, is a new trial sent by the Goddess, intriguing adventurers and competitors alike.
Seash of House Orva, a Light Fighter, becomes the High Priest of the Keepers of the Rift of Corven, a significant religious and political appointment.
Dora of House Wyndrava falls to Floor 11, a reminder of the ever-present danger and the unpredictable nature of the Tower.
On the market, 346 Lapisia changed hands, while 2 Lapis stones were traded, with the prices of Lapisia rising to 25,251,561 gold each and Lapis to 893,279 gold each.
The weather remains clear and mild, perfect for those who venture outside the Tower's walls, though the markets are bustling with activity, making it a good time to sell or buy.

herald.headline: The Tower Herald - Year 942, Issue 47
lines: Wynlyash of House Loor clinches victory in the Tower Arena, defending the title for Floor 4 champions with consistent prowess.
Iselth of House Kaielae ascends to the top of the Tower Arena, winning the tournament on Floors 19, 11, and 3 times in a row, showcasing the strength of the Tower's elite.
Uliska of Floor 1 embarks on a quest to find old friend Kaiistor, reuniting two souls from the Tower's lower levels.
Orcorta of Floor 6 seeks out Brienul from the past, bringing a sense of nostalgia and camaraderie to the Tower's history.
Miulkai of House Raen sells a +10 armour at the Grand Auction, netting a staggering 375,186,431 gold, setting a new benchmark for top-tier gear sales.
Riya from Floor 9 travels to Floor 18, where Vencor has set up a stall, sparking a trade that might just change the market's dynamics.
Fenorgor of House Tortorul adds to the Tower's auction with a +9 weapon, fetching 234,795,041 gold, further enriching the marketplace.
Venthta of Floor 13 searches for Kaiorna, a reunion that could lead to unexpected alliances or revelations about the past.
Miar of House Cornagor brings a +9 weapon up to the Grand Auction, fetching 235,325,999 gold, solidifying the Tower's economic landscape.
Isdra from Floor 11 and Risha from Floor 11 visit their old friends, Rimi and Nyth, respectively, in a tale of friendship and nostalgia.

Why did the Mage cross the road? To cast a spell, of course, but he got distracted by the latest fashion trends in lapis stones.

herald.headline: Shaiya's Tower Herald - Year 942
lines: Wynlyash from Floor 4 takes the Tower Arena crown, proving the strength of Floor 4 fighters.
Toris from Floor 18 brings his family to Floor 17, seeking a new life among friends.
Rizelel from Floor 3 secures a +9 armour for 238,990,766 gold at the Grand Auction, setting a new record.
Feny travels to Floor 7 to find Arwynwyn, illustrating the enduring bonds of old friends.
Venri from Floor 12 searches for Wynri, showing the importance of maintaining connections in the Tower.
Tharfen from Floor 18 and Wynlyash from Floor 4 dominate the Tower Arena, each winning against all challengers twice.
Riraar from Floor 9 travels to Floor 11 in search of Bridobri, highlighting the widespread network of old friendships.
Nyseae from Floor 5 seeks Lyor, an old friend, showcasing the ongoing quests for companionship in the Tower.
The weather remains stable, but the market sees a slight downturn, with prices for enchantments dropping by 10% due to an overabundance of lapis stones.
In a bizarre twist, a trader from Floor 5 mistakenly sells a +10 weapon to a merchant from Floor 3, only to find it back in their own inventory later that day.

herald.headline: SPECIAL EDITION: The Goddess blesses height: surer hands and longer lives
lines: The Goddess speaks again to every floor: Hear my second law, the blessing of height.
For every floor you dwell above the lowest, your hands are surer: linking and enchanting succeed more often.
For every floor you dwell above the lowest, your years are longer: one part in a hundred for each floor.
Floor 1 is blessed most of all; Floor 20 keeps the measure it always had. So I have spoken.

herald.headline: Tower Herald - Year 940 and 942
lines: Isfenri from Floor 7 travels to Floor 8 to see Ashlolo, their old friend from the past.
Venmorva from Floor 2 visits Ritari on Floor 1, an old acquaintance from before the Tower was built.
Enfen from House Drarien moves up from Floor 6 to Floor 5 with their family, seeking new opportunities.
Lowynbri from House Rimor ascends to Floor 3, hoping to rise in the ranks.
Lyorfen from Floor 11 seeks out Wynul on Floor 12, rekindling old bonds.
Mika from House Cornagor, Floor 4, emerges victorious in the Tower Arena, defeating champions from all 20 floors.
Toraese from House Loor, Floor 8, triumphs in the Tower Arena, claiming the championship title over the best fighters from every floor.
Elfenna from House Tortorse, Floor 3, secures her place as a top competitor, winning the Tower Arena and besting all challengers.
Dokai from House Tortorse, Floor 2, secures a rare +10 armour from Floor 11, selling it for a record-breaking 383,893,551 gold.
Lofen from House Gorra, Floor 18, sells a +10 armour to the Grand Auction, fetching 387,510,274 gold.
The Dry Seasons come to an end on Floor 20, bringing much-needed relief to the parched lands.
Zelwyn from Floor 1 seeks out Ulor, an old friend from before the Tower was constructed.

herald.headline: SPECIAL EDITION: The Goddess proclaims the Laws of Height (year 942)
lines: The Goddess speaks, and every floor of the Tower hears her: Hear my laws, Light and Fury alike.
The higher you dwell, the richer your hunting: Floor 1 is blessed most, Floor 20 least.
On Floors 1, 2 and 3 you may enchant to +20, fill all twelve link slots, and sell anything.
On Floors 4 and 5 you may enchant up to +8, fill eight link slots, and sell up to +8.
On Floors 6 to 20 you may enchant up to +4, fill four link slots, and sell up to +4.
What a floor may not sell goes up to the Grand Auction: +5 to +8 before Floors 1 to 5, +9 and above before Floors 1 to 3 alone.
The strongest in all the Tower shall make their home on Floor 1, with their family.
What you already hold is yours. Climb, and more is allowed you. So I have spoken.

herald.headline: Tower Herald: Year 939-941 Edition
lines: Fenen of House Elmorar wins two consecutive tournaments in Floors 13 and 18, showcasing her archery skills.
Tower Arena: Ulvenra of House Gorra secures victory in multiple tournaments, cementing her status as a formidable champion.
Revolt! Ulelsha of House Ashracor overthrows Doash as the new Warchief of the Fury, leading to significant political changes.
Ulrais travels to Floor 11 in search of Arnath, reconnecting with old friends from before the Tower.
Ramily from Floor 10 seeks out Ashvaul, an old acquaintance from the past.
Nycor of House Nakami moves up from Floor 11 with two family members, seeking a new life.
Crafters in Floor 3 sell 9 enchanted weapons and armour this year, meeting the growing demand for magical gear.
Arelly of House Gorsedo moves up from Floor 7 with one family, hoping for a fresh start.
In Floor 20, Lyly visits Tormorsha, rekindling a bond formed before the Tower.
Brien from Floor 16 looks for Kanydra, a friend from the old days, on Floor 15.
Weather and Markets: Mild autumn weather continues; market prices for enchanted items remain steady.
Corel travels to Floor 19, bringing laughter to the Tower with the story of how he got lost in a maze of mirrors.

herald.headline: The Weekly Roundup: 938
lines: Nakath of House Ashracor reigns supreme in the Tower Arena on Floors 15 and 7, demonstrating the might of House Ashracor.
Ulna from the top floor, Floor 20, seeks out Encortor in a quest that spans the Tower’s breadth.
Ranyen of House Cornagor continues to dominate the Tower Arena, winning tournaments from Floors 18 to 5.
Morkaiva and Zeltorva travel to find old friends Ashashmi and Brisha, highlighting the Tower’s social ties.
Rimorri of House Ordo makes a move, descending from Floor 4 to possibly take on new challenges or allies.
Lobriul and Goriska journey to lower floors in search of old friends, indicating a strong bond between Tower denizens.
The Tower of 940 sees Hunters improving their communication, saving more lives through cries and warnings.
Weather and Markets: The recent spell of mild weather has boosted market activity, with traders from various floors exchanging goods and resources.
In a humorous twist, Zelzel of House Briwynri climbs down from Floor 13 to claim the Arena title, showing the Tower’s unexpected and intriguing dynamics.

herald.headline: Shaiya News: Year 936 Updates and Market Report
lines: High Lord Dony of the Light declares the borderland shall rest, ensuring peace for the coming year.
High Lord Engor decrees a great feast, hoping to bolster morale among the Light people.
Warchief Aeri of the Fury prepares for battle, warning of an impending threat from their enemies.
High Lady Lyenel orders the armament of guards, showing the increasing tension in the Tower.
Warchief Corkaith of the Fury declares war, escalating the conflict between the two peoples.
High Lord Torra and High Lord Aetor both decree the arming of guards, indicating a growing sense of unease.
High Priest Revolt Aeenka of House Dramisha overthrows Rakaith, becoming the new High Priest of the Light.
Miri of House Lomor (Fury Ranger, gen 37), a level 80 with 65,000,676 monsters slain, dies of old age, leaving a legacy of strength.
Lapisia grows scarce, the Goddess sends a trial, and the market reflects the growing scarcity with prices soaring high.
The weather is mild and the market is bustling, with 109 Lapisia changing hands and 25 Lapis sold at premium prices.
